articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis for Grapes Leaf Disease Diagnosis Using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Grape leaf diseases significantly impact vineyard productivity and grape quality, necessitating efficient and accurate diagnosis methods. Unfortunately, when performing manual inspection, it can be inconclusive and extremely time- consuming which underlines the importance of an automated approach. In this paper, a comparative assessment of four deep learning models, DenseNet, MobileNet, EfficientNet B7, and AlexNet has been conducted for the diagnosis of the grape leaf disease. The performance of each model is assessed by accuracy, precision, recall, and, F1-score that is relevant to its applicability in the practical agriculture-related environment. The chief innovation of this work is therefore based on main open issues as imbalanced datasets and variations on the environment that can hinder the reliability of current models. The problem of model and feature resilience is addressed by applying data augmentation techniques, including GANs, to ensure that the models can generalize from one vineyard condition to another. The findings also show that the approach that uses EfficientNet B7, DenseNet, and transfer learning & ensemble method can provide higher accuracy and robustness for using in vineyard. The research presented here benefits from the progress of smart agriculture in providing a practical and effective solution for distinguishing grape leaf diseases.

articleTitle: Assessing the Job Satisfaction of Teachers Using Deep PSO in Educational Institutions with Special Reference to Chennai District
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Background: The degree of job satisfaction of teachers determines both the quality of instruction and the atmosphere of learning advantageous for them. Several factors have affected teachers’ job satisfaction in Chennai District: workload, salary, opportunity for professional development, and work-life balance. Although this is a serious issue, little systematic analysis using advanced computer methods is done. Sometimes conventional methods of gauging job satisfaction—such as questionnaires and qualitative interviews—show limited scalability and subjective bias. Novelty: This work aims to evaluate and investigate teacher job satisfaction in Chennai District’s educational institutions by means of a Deep Particle Swarm Optimisation (Deep PSO) technique, therefore overcoming these limitations. Objectives: The major objectives are to optimise enjoyment by means of targeted therapies and identify significant components affecting it. Findings: This work uses Deep PSO, a hybrid method combining Particle Swarm Optimisation (PSO) with deep learning methodologies, to evaluate data acquired from 500 teachers scattered over numerous educational institutions in Chennai District. While the Deep PSO model finds complex patterns and connections in the data using multi-layered neural networks, the PSO approach maximises the weights and biases of the model to increase forecast accuracy. The model estimates job satisfaction based on several criteria: workload, pay scale, professional development opportunities, and institutional support. Based on respective values of 0.43 and 0.31, respectively, the Deep PSO model’s findings reveal that job satisfaction’s most significant determinants are workload and professional development opportunities. With an $\mathbf{8 7. 6} \%$ prediction accuracy, the model beat accepted methods by 12.4%. Furthermore, projected to increase general job satisfaction by 18.7% are specific recommendations to minimise workload by 15% and increase chances for professional development by $\mathbf{2 0 \%}$.

articleTitle: Analysing LSTM and Transformer Models for Chatbot Development: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In today’s digital landscape, the development of chatbots plays a pivotal role in enhancing user engagement across various applications. This paper conducts a comparative study between Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Transformer models for chatbot development, focusing on their efficacy in generating contextually coherent responses. LSTM, known for its sequential data processing capabilities, is compared with Transformers, which excel in capturing long-range dependencies and context understanding. Leveraging the Hugging Face Transformers library and TensorFlow/Keras for implementation, we evaluate metrics such as accuracy, perplexity, and computational efficiency on structured conversational datasets. Through empirical experiments and evaluations, this study provides insights into optimal model selection and training strategies to improve chatbot performance in real-world applications. The findings contribute to understanding the strengths and limitations of each architecture, informing best practices for developing robust conversational AI systems.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Asthma Management: Random Forests Leading the Way
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Asthma is a chronic respiratory disease characterized by shortness of breath, wheezing, and the potential for severe, life-threatening attacks. Effective management of asthma is crucial, as inadequate control can lead to serious exacerbations. A reliable system for predicting the likelihood of asthma or asthma attacks can significantly improve patient care. This work employs the Random Forest algorithm to analyse patient health records for asthma prediction. Random Forest, a robust machine learning technique, utilizes an ensemble of decision trees to enhance the accuracy and reliability of predictions. This method is particularly effective in managing complex data and classification tasks. The proposed model achieved an accuracy of 75% in predicting asthma risk. The results demonstrate that Random Forest is a viable method for constructing predictive models in healthcare, with the model assessing factors such as age, medical history, environmental conditions, and genetic predispositions to identify individuals at risk of developing asthma or experiencing asthma attacks.

articleTitle: Classification of Different types of Soil using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The present study aims to add a new dimension in the classification of soil using deep learning in conjunction with the conventional methods. In this regard, a CNN model has been developed and trained using a small, publicly available dataset for classifying five specific classes of soils. The proposed model had an accuracy as high as $\mathbf{9 0. 5 2 \%}$, proving the efficiency and swiftness of the model for soil classification. In future works, the dataset will be improved with crowdsourcing to increase diversity and better coverage. The un-annotated status for the dataset can be relaxed with online data augmentation techniques. This study will help develop a completely automatic, efficient method for soil classification, which has broad applications in agriculture, geotechnical engineering, and environmental monitoring.

articleTitle: Role of Environmental, Social and Governance on Firm Value using Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) aspects of company value are attracting more and more attention among legislators, stakeholders, and investors. ESG criteria provide a full assessment of a company’s ethical behaviour and long-term viability, therefore influencing its financial performance, risk profile, and reputation. The study spans ten years (2013-2023) using a 500 -company dataset spanning a spectrum of industries. Apart from traditional financial benchmarks including market-to-book ratio, return on assets (ROA), and return on equity (ROE), input variables comprise ESG ratings. By means of a radial basis function (RBF) kernel, training the SVM model helps to capture the non-linear relationships between business value and ESG performance. Cross-valuation guarantees model robustness; hyperparameter adjustment maximizes the correctness of the model. Business value and ESG scores demonstrate a statistically significant positive link. Forecasting company value, the SVM model gets an accuracy of 87.5%, a precision of 85.2%, a recall of 88.4%, and an F1 score of 86.8%. Higher ESG score businesses have a 12% larger market-to-book ratio than those with lower scores, suggesting that ESG performance helps to explain corporate valuation. The findings demonstrate their ability to increase corporate value and provide empirical evidence supporting the inclusion of ESG factors into investment decisions-making processes.

articleTitle: A Study of NLP and AI-Driven Online Text-to-Video Generation Platforms in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The rapid growth of the Internet has introduced various online video production platforms that facilitate content creation for small businesses, education, and social media. However, selecting the right platform based on user needs remains challenging due to varying features and limitations. This study aims to address this challenge by conducting a comparative analysis of five popular text-to-video generation platforms: Pictory, Lumen5, Invideo, Design.ai, and Synthesia. We analyze these platforms based on features such as free trial versions, supported languages, media libraries, and customization options. The contribution of this paper lies in providing a structured comparison to assist users in selecting appropriate platforms for their content creation needs. Additionally, this study explores how Natural Language Processing (NLP) and AI-driven technologies enhance automatic video generation, highlighting the strengths and limitations of each platform for different use cases, such as social media, education, and business.

articleTitle: A Robotic Arm Vehicle using Voice Recognition for Physically Challenged People
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In Today’s world, all the work is automated by robots. The Robots have become a significant part of today’s world, improving many people’s lives, especially those who are physically challenged. This research paper presents a unique method for helping people with physical disabilities: A robotic arm vehicle using voice recognition for physically challenged people. Two remarkable features of the robot are its design and its adaptability in handling objects accurately. The comparative research demonstrates improved performance, such as faster job completion and increased grasping efficiency, when compared to older methods. Additionally, by integrating AI, the robotic arm gains the flexibility needed to operate in real-world environments. This finding might lead to more autonomous and effective assistive technology for personal support and healthcare applications.

articleTitle: Enhancing Agricultural Productivity Through Convolutional Neural Networks Based Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Plant disease detection is a cornerstone of sustainable agriculture, directly influencing crop yield and quality. Early detection and timely intervention are crucial for mitigating these impacts. This study investigates the potential of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to automate and enhance crop disease detection. CNNs, capable of learning intricate spatial patterns from image data, provide a promising alternative to traditional disease diagnosis methods. The paper delves into the technical aspects of CNN-based plant disease detection, including popular frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch. These tools provide a user-friendly environment for building, training, and deploying CNN models, streamlining the process of implementing AI solutions in agricultural settings. The advantages of CNNs for plant disease detection are multifaceted. Their hierarchical architecture enables automatic feature extraction, reducing the need for manual engineering. Additionally, CNNs are robust to variations in image conditions, making them suitable for real-world agricultural applications. To further improve performance, various techniques are integrated into CNN-based systems. Data expansion and model adaptation methos are utilized to expand the variety and size of training datasets, resulting in more precise and generalized models. In conclusion, CNNs offer a promising approach to automating and improving plant disease detection, contributing to sustainable agriculture and food security. By harnessing the capabilities of AI, farmers and researchers can make informed decisions to safeguard crops and maximize yields. These techniques increase the diversity and size of training datasets, leading to more accurate and generalized models, with studies reporting achievements of up to $\mathbf{9 7 \%}$ accuracy. The potential integration of CNN-based systems into precision agriculture frameworks to optimize resource allocation and enhance overall crop health.

articleTitle: Image Fusion For Improved Situational Awareness In Military Operations Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Image fusion is an essential technique used in various military applications to provide a comprehensive view of the target area by integrating multiple images from various sensors. This technique helps in detecting threats, identifying targets, and analyzing the situation to make informed decisions. The use of image fusion in military areas enhances the performance of the systems by providing high-resolution images that can be used to obtain valuable insights. The application of image fusion in military areas involves the use of various sensors such as thermal, infrared, and visual sensors, which capture images with different spectral and spatial resolutions. The images are then fused to create a single image that provides more detailed information about the target area. Image fusion techniques involve various algorithms, including multi-resolution analysis, wavelet transforms, and others, which are used to combine the images. In military areas, image fusion is used for a variety of tasks such as surveillance, reconnaissance, and target detection. The use of image fusion enables military personnel to detect threats more efficiently and provides them with the ability to analyze the situation with more clarity. Furthermore, image fusion allows for better situational awareness and facilitates quick decision-making. In conclusion, the application of image fusion in military areas has significant benefits in detecting threats and other resolution work-based performance.

articleTitle: Advancing Soil Management and Crop Yield Optimization: A Comprehensive Review of Precision Agriculture Techniques Using Machine Learning, Deep Learning and IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Agriculture is a vital sector in the economy of every nation, with its contributions markedly impacting the gross domestic product. The efficacy of agricultural operations and crop management predominantly hinges on attaining optimal yields and advantageous market conditions. Effective agricultural yield management necessitates continuous monitoring and intelligent decision-making. Artificial Intelligence (AI) offers a robust, automated method for crop surveillance and production forecasting. This paper examines the contribution of deep learning and its hybrid methodologies, such as Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Deep Neural Networks (DNN), and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), to the improvement of agricultural output. It emphasizes the importance of RNNs and hybrid networks in agriculture, showcasing their enhanced performance relative to other models such as ANNs and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The study’s results were meticulously examined, and prospective future applications of these technologies in agriculture were discovered and deliberated.

articleTitle: Waste Classification and Monitoring Using Yolov8 A Deep Learning Object Detection Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: With rapid urbanization and population growth, effective waste management has become an important issue worldwide. Increasing waste generation poses serious risks to the environment, economy, and public health, necessitating the adoption of best waste management practices. This research proposes a new method for object detection using YOLOv8, the latest version of the “You Only Look Once” (YOLO) real-time object detection algorithm. YOLOv8 was selected for its ability to quickly and accurately identify different types of waste, including plastic, metal, and organic waste, which is crucial for improving the recycling process and promoting a safer environment. However, our preliminary findings indicate that the accuracy of the classification function (mAP50: 59%) is lower than expected. This issue may stem from factors such as limited diversity in the training data, insufficient data for some specific types of waste, and challenges in identifying common objects within images. By addressing these limitations, we aim to improve the model’s performance, making it more effective for waste management. Our model can identify and classify waste products, such as plastic, metal, paper, and organic waste, using deep learning and neural networks. However, while maintaining overlap accuracy, it appears slightly less competitive. Despite these limitations, the model demonstrates potential to enhance waste management processes by increasing the speed and accuracy of waste identification and classification. Its accessibility offers a cost-effective and scalable tool for real-time waste management. This research will contribute to knowledge creation in sustainable urban waste management, paving the way for improved environmental practices and public health protection.

articleTitle: Smart Lawn Mower with Stability Control using AVR Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This paper describes a robotic lawn mower that precisely and intelligently mow grass on playgrounds and lawns. To carry out the mowing operation, a collection of concurrently operating behaviors is defined. The dynamics of the terrain are obtained by utilizing a variety of accelerometers. AVR microcontroller utilizes the data from the sensors to adjust the mower’s mechanisms in order to precisely remove grass. The controller will be relatively easy to use, making it accessible to all regular human users. Design will place a high priority on energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Onion Crop Cultivation & Prediction of Yields by Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The rising worldwide populace prompts the Indian government to upgrade food supply the executives for a long time to come. Reasonable farming practices are critical for guaranteeing steady food creation while protecting the climate against unsafe synthetics, accomplished through mechanical progressions in administration. This study presents a complex multi-phantom imaging framework customized for accuracy farming. Including a RGB camera and Pi NoIR camera worked by a Raspberry Pi installed a robot; this framework catches ethereal pictures for investigation. The pictures are communicated to a Java application for handling, including honing and resizing. Ongoing information is utilized to register the Standardized Contrast Vegetation Record (NDVI), working with crop wellbeing appraisal. Utilizing Profound Learning (DL) strategies, the framework successfully distinguishes onion crop development stages from the gained dataset. The detail the execution of a dynamic profound brain network model for this reason. The framework exhibits a great presentation precision of $\mathbf{9 7 . 6 3 \%}$ for a cluster size of $\mathbf{2 4}$ and $\mathbf{9 8 . 4 5 \%}$ for a bunch size of 56.

articleTitle: Soil Condition Analysis Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This study provides a complete overview of the use of deep learning techniques in soil condition analysis and crop selection in the agricultural area. Deep learning, a type of machine learning, has emerged as a potent tool for modelling intricate data patterns, making it ideal for assessing complex soil characteristics critical to crop development and yield. Deep learning algorithms, using artificial neural networks, can effectively process a variety of data sources, including satellite imagery, sensor readings, historical records, and weather data, to provide insights into soil moisture content, nutrient levels, soil texture, and other relevant features. Furthermore, deep learning models can assist in crop selection by incorporating characteristics like as seasonality, regional climatic patterns, and the distinction between Kharif and Rabi crops, which are crucial for improving farming techniques and increasing output. This paper examines the most recent research in this topic, focusing on major approaches, problems, and future directions. It also investigates the implications of implementing deep learning in agriculture, including its capacity to enhance food security, transform contemporary agricultural practices, and mitigate environmental damage.

articleTitle: Natural Disaster Sustainability Forest Fire Detection System Based on Computer Vision Using Smart IoT Sensor Networks and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Forest Fire pose significant threats to ecosystems, human life, and property. Early detection and rapid response are crucial for effective firefighting and mitigation efforts. In this paper, we propose a novel forest fire detection system leveraging smart sensor networks and deep learning techniques. Our system employs computer vision algorithms to analyze real-time video feeds from strategically placed cameras in forested areas. Deep learning models, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) are utilized to detect and classify fire-related patterns in the video streams. The proposed system aims to enhance the speed and high accuracy of forest fire detection, thereby enabling prompt intervention and minimizing the devastating impacts of such natural disasters. The accuracy and efficiency results produced ANN is 89% and CNN is 95%. This technology is used to minimize forest fire losses.

articleTitle: Two-Phase Deep Q Learning Network for Secure Healthcare Model in the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) embodies a revolutionary networking technology that links both living beings and inanimate objects. Its utilization is rapidly growing across diverse sectors, particularly in healthcare, where it is instrumental in enabling healthcare providers and individuals to monitor and diagnose diseases. It is crucial to ensure the security of healthcare data on IoT devices to prevent intermediary attacks and unauthorized access. This study explores the increasing security challenges associated with IoT in the healthcare field. To enhance the security and privacy of healthcare data, we propose a combination of the Two-Phase Deep Q Learning Network (TPDQN) and the Deep Learning Network (DLN). The DLN is primarily focused on authenticating certified IoT devices to prevent intermediate attacks, while the TPDQN is designed to detect and mitigate Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks and malware as they traverse multiple locations. The effectiveness of the proposed solution is measured using metrics such as mean square error (MSE), longevity, accuracy, throughput, and energy consumption, demonstrating improved performance relative to existing solutions.

Author Keywords: and Two-phase Deep Q learning network

articleTitle: INTOCS: Neural Network Inspired Oversampling based Secure and Optimized Transaction Framework for Credit Card
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Online transactions have transformed commerce and international trade but have brought up new difficulties, especially regarding fraud detection and security. The exponential rise in digital transactions has made reliable fraud detection systems using machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques which are leveraged to detect and mitigate fraud thereby increasing the security of transactions. The paper suggested a model in which data preprocessing using standard scalar along with SMOTE for data balancing is proposed. Data is split into 80-20% train test data based on credit card transactions. An artificial neural network is used to determine credit card fraud. Activation function followed by batch normalization blended with Adam Optimizer and cross-entropy is used to process the computation. Furthermore, classification parameters obtained an Accuracy of 99.95%, Precision of 99%, Recall of 99%, and F1Score of 99%. The result obtained by the proposed method outperforms the existing approach that focuses on secured transactions and helps both the client and server.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms for Smart Healthcare: Breast Cancer Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Background: Breast cancer continues to be a significant concern for women worldwide, emphasizing the crucial role of early detection in improving treatment outcomes. The machine learning techniques play an important role in early detection of breast cancer. Detection of breast cancer with traditional techniques is time-consuming and does not provide accurate results. So to enhance the accuracy of detection and to decrease time taken, an automatic breast cancer technique is required. This work introduced innovative machine-learning algorithms for the detection of breast cancer. Machine learning algorithms used in this paper are Neural Networks (NN), Logistic Regression (LR), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), and K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) with a widespread set of related parameters. The dataset taken for the work contains many patient demographics, clinical details, and histopathological information to train and validate machine learning algorithms. For the evaluation of the work accuracy and loss are calculated. The Logistic Regression outperformed with remarkable accuracy 97.4%, over the mentioned five other algorithms. All five models are compared to verify and validate the experimental results. The proposed work requires very less human intervention and attained high accuracy in considerable time. In future, for validation and its applications in clinical settings, the author can design a hybrid technique that can handle real-time clinical data.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Prediction from Risk Factors Using Ensemble Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: While women age, the prevalence of breast cancer rises and affects women of all races. Breast cancer kills more females than any other cause of cancer-related death. Risk Analysis for Breast cancer prediction is an important problem in medical research, and the objective of this research is to propose an ensemble approach to address the issue of breast cancer prediction using appropriate risk factors. This work will explore existing techniques and identify various risk factors causing breast cancer. Breast cancer risk analysis may be anticipated using machine learning techniques. The approach involves gathering a dataset of patients, pre-processing the dataset to eliminate unnecessary information and reduce dimensionality, normalizing features, and dividing the dataset into training and testing sets. For treatment to be successful, breast cancer detection is essential. Breast cancer recurrence can be identified using several means such as physical examinations, mammography, ultrasounds, and blood tests. However, machine learning models can aid in predicting the likelihood of breast cancer recurrence using various clinical and molecular features. By identifying high-risk individuals, treatment approaches may be tailored to each individual, lowering the chance of cancer and improving patient outcomes. The proposed research work will incorporate the identified risk factors and the extracted features to accurately predict breast cancer. The Breast Cancer Surveillance Consortium Dataset is used to evaluate and validate the efficacy of the suggested work. Random Forest gave the best results with $\mathbf{7 5. 2 \%}$ accuracy.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Disease Prediction implementing Artificial Intelligence and Machine learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Many coronary heart-associated problems are emerging at a speedy pace and new sicknesses and issues are being recognised. Coronary heart ailment influences a huge population in contemporary international wherein existence is converting from active to comfortable. We stay in an era of rapid food, which accumulates LDL cholesterol, diabetes and many different factors that sooner or later affect the heart in some way. Diagnosing heart disease is very vital and in itself is the most complex assignment in the clinical discipline. Illnesses including most cancers may be detected and the stage also can be anticipated using a schooling dataset of most cancer cell pictures. Furthermore, heart diseases can be expected primarily based on components like cholesterol, diabetes, heart rate etc. Prediction of coronary heart illnesses is hard and very unstable. This work located that in some cases, problem fixing does not rely upon a single approach. This paper presents the discussion about the comparative study of various methods of Machine Learning (ML) in the medical field concerning coronary disease.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Review for Video Surveillance Based Suspicious Human Activity Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The detection of potentially illicit behaviors from recorded video footage is an emerging field of study in the domain of image processing and computer vision. Detecting suspicious activities is essential for maintaining the security of both businesses and communities. Surveillance cameras are primarily utilized in public areas to monitor and guarantee security. To provide continuous monitoring of public spaces, it is crucial to utilize intelligent video surveillance systems capable of properly detecting and classifying human actions in real-time as either benign or potentially threatening. This study presents a state-of-the-art review that highlights the general progress made in the last several years in spotting suspicious behaviors from surveillance recordings. article briefly summarize the problems and challenges related to identifying questionable human behaviors. This article aims to provide researchers in this subject with an overview of the literature on a number of suspicious activity recognition systems, including an overview of their general architecture.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based Plant Disease Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Many problems like inadequate storage conditions, unfavourable market conditions, sudden weather changes etc. pose a serious challenge to global food security. One of the major problems contributing to the same is plant diseases. This indicates that to minimise crop loss a rapid and accurate diagnosis is called for but such strategies entail the use of traditional methods which are elaborate and often inaccurate. The plant disease detection and diagnosis system use a convolutional neural network (CNN) which has been trained on a large set of images of plant’s leaves to provide accurate diagnosis of $\mathbf{3 7}$ diseases taken of Mango, Tomato and Potato plants. This research discusses how the system was developed and optimised on the methods of farming.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Technology for Process Control Stations
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In today’s modern era, digitalization is viewed as a prospect to reach higher productivity levels and mass customization of products. The age of the digital era enhances industry 4.0 technologies and allows easy interconnection of multi-functional and multi-disciplinary devices. It reviewed and proposed an integration of virtual software of SIEMENS origin, such as COMOS Plant view, SIMATIC Manager, and SIMIT, for creating digital twin process control systems in process industries. The virtual representation of the industry helps us avoid any major mishaps. It allows monitoring and controlling the whole process station from a single workstation. COMOS offers a wide range of virtual tools. The data feed can be monitored by SIMIT and interlinked with the SIMATIC Manager. When all these systems mentioned above are integrated, the proposed design offers an easy, alterable simulation of the virtual environment, which can be adopted and used for testing and simulation before the real setting up of equipment in the industry. Digital twins of process control stations simulate the station and optimize the processes before the installation. Also, the process can be executed parallel to take necessary actions.

articleTitle: DenseNet121 v. VGG16: Comprehensive Performance Analysis and Accuracy Comparison in Human Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: From surveillance to healthcare and human computer interaction, this is a crucial field in computer vision with uses. In order to enhance the quality of life, the authors of present work have aimed to investigate the efficiency of the densely linked convolutional neural network, DenseNet121, on video sequence-based human activity identification. DenseNet121’s architecture allows this model to connect all the layers directly, so enabling gradient flow and recycling features, hence increasing its capacity to learn complex temporal and spatial patterns underlying human activities. After training a model for the benchmark human action dataset, the writers got an accuracy of 89.34%. These results highlight DenseNet121’s precise identification and classification of human activities capability. Having large effects in improving automated surveillance, athletic performance optimization, and patient monitoring in healthcare situations, results suggest that DenseNet121 can be a very strong foundation towards the creation of state-of-the-modern human action detection systems for society. More research will be conducted to improve the model’s performance and generalize it into several practical settings.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Classification Algorithms for Predicting Liver Cirrhosis Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Among the majority of people in this world, liver cirrhosis is the primary cause of death. There are several factors that damage the liver and lead to this disease. For instance, alcohol abuse, obesity, and an undetected hepatitis infection. It is the cause of numerous other conditions, including aberrant nerve disorder, blood while coughing and vomiting, liver tissue and kidney disease, jaundice, and hepatic encephalopathy. Identifying this disease is quite difficult and costly. Thus, the objective is this process to assess effectiveness the several machine learning (ML)models with the aim of lowering high expenses associated with the diagnosis of liver cirrhosis through prediction. This paper used six different approaches: Random Forest (RF), K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), Decision Tree (DT), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naïve Bayes (NB), and Logistic Regression (LR).A range of measuring units, like as recall, f-1 score, accuracy, and precision, was used to evaluate various classification procedures. The Logistic Regression had the highest accuracy with 95%.

articleTitle: A Transfer Learning-Based Approach for Multi-class Classification of Pulmonary Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The prevalence of pulmonary diseases is experiencing a notable escalation. The year 2019 witnessed a global phenomenon characterized by the swift emergence and expansion of COVID-19, which gave rise to a state of heightened concern on a worldwide scale. The timely detection of pulmonary diseases is of utmost importance due to the potential fatality associated with these conditions. The utilization of chest X-ray (CXR) is prevalent in the healthcare industry, as it offers a rapid and accurate diagnosis. This research paper presents a proposed deep learning (DL) architecture to achieve numerous classifications of COVID-19, Viral Pneumonia, as well as Normal cases. To ensure a balanced representation of data, a composite dataset was constructed by merging two publicly accessible datasets. The dataset utilized in our study constitutes a total of 4500 chest X-ray data, with an equal distribution of 1,500 images for each class. In the context of classification, our research has employed four pre-trained models, namely InceptionV3, InceptionResNetV2, ResNet101V2, and Xception. These models have been selected due to their established performance and effectiveness in various classification tasks. By utilizing these pre-trained networks, we aim to leverage their learned features and weights to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of our classification system.

articleTitle: An Efficient, Affordable and Reliable SMPS Battery Chargers for Automobile Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: As we are utilizing Conventional vehicles, Electric Vehicles require charging the batteries, so the chargers for batteries are becoming more and more crucial within the automobile industry. While the current chargers mostly rely on bulky and inefficient transformer models, this proposed work aims to explore the integration of Switched-Mode Power Supply (SMPS) technology. The method employed in this work is that replaces the charging based on transformers with SMPS technology, with the goal of improving efficiency, reducing size, and reducing heat generation. The result of the project has a successfully developed battery charger that utilizes SMPS technology. It has achieved increased efficiency, reduced size, and lower heat generation in comparison to traditional models. Furthermore, the revised charger exhibits a simpler and more affordable circuit, catering to a wider consumer base. As a result, this product can be used in both workshops and automobile showrooms with more efficiency at an affordable cost.

articleTitle: Detection of Prohibited Items in X-ray Images using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Automated baggage screening is crucial for safety and surveillance as it ensures precise and effective scrutiny of luggage at places like airports, and railway stations. This paper presents a deep learning-based approach to identify prohibited items such as HandGun, Knife, RazorBlade, and Shuriken within luggage by utilizing YOLOv8 model from Xray images. YOLOv8 one of the most advanced object detection algorithms. By integrating cutting-edge image processing techniques with machine learning techniques, the suggested system automates the scanning process and instantly identifies potential threats of these contraband items. The proposed model utilizes YOLOv8 object detection algorithm and works on X-ray images taken from GDXray database. The F1 score of 0.98 was achieved by the proposed model on test dataset. This automated approach is an essential component of contemporary security infrastructure because it strengthens security measures and increases operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Optimizing Tabular Vector-Borne Disease Surveillance with Machine Learning Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Vector-borne diseases (VBDs) represent a critical global health challenge due to the rising incidence and potential for serious outcomes. This study aims to enhance VBD surveillance by leveraging machine learning classification techniques to identify and predict vector-borne diseases based on symptomatology. Using a comprehensive dataset sourced from Kaggle, multiple classification algorithms, including Support Vector Machines, K-Nearest Neighbors, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Multi-Layer Perceptron, were applied and evaluated. The results demonstrate that the Multi-Layer Perceptron model achieved the highest accuracy, underscoring its effectiveness in disease classification. The findings of this study support the advancement of public health initiatives, enabling proactive disease management through optimized VBD prediction and classification.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Various Federated Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A method for data privacy maintenance while training machine learning models across decentralized devices is Federated Learning (FL). It comes under the category of decentralized field of machine learning. The decentralized approach faces various challenges, one of them is aggregating model updates which come from diverse and potentially unreliable sources. This study provides a comparison review of various algorithms for privacy preservation, and maintaining security and also talks about the various federated averaging techniques. These techniques are essential for an efficient model aggregation. This research paper also provides an analysis of strengths, weaknesses, and various application areas of federated learning. This paper has included the maximum techniques available for federated learning by comparing their datasets and various other parameters. This paper also provides insight into the related future work that is proposed in various research articles.

articleTitle: AI Shield: Early Heart Failure Detection with SVM Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Support Vector Machine (SVM) is an effective method for predicting health outcomes, particularly in managing complex health data. Despite the fast-paced nature of modern life, it is improbable that the prevalence of heart failure was as high in the past as it is today. Heart failure refers to a condition where the heart is unable to pump blood efficiently, which can lead to significant health complications. SVM serves as a powerful tool for predicting individuals at risk for severe vascular issues and estimating when these problems may arise. SVM has demonstrated an impressive accuracy rate of $79 \%$ in classifying a wide range of health conditions and associated risk factors. This high level of accuracy suggests that, when used appropriately, these predictions could transform healthcare practices by enabling early detection of heart problems, potentially preventing them from advancing into critical conditions. Additionally, this approach holds the potential to reduce healthcare costs by identifying risks early. The findings underscore the value of integrating advanced computational techniques, such as SVM, in the early detection and management of heart failure. Furthermore, the research contributes to enhancing the overall understanding of how to improve health monitoring strategies.

articleTitle: UNNATI: Enhancing Quality Education in Rural Areas through AI, AR & digitalization
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Quality and accessible education is a basic human right. Article 26 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) declares that everyone has the right to proper and excellent education. It plays an integral part in an individual’s empowerment, economic as well as social progress. However, the educational system in rural areas is still in developing and deprived state. It leads to a significant disparity in terms of accessing standard education and available opportunities as compared to urban regions. Despite several global efforts, statistical data reveals a huge difference in the quality of education and opportunities between urban and rural regions. Hence, our paper presents an innovative approach to enhance the overall quality of education and provide practical learnings and opportunities in rural areas. The proposed solution leverages AI, Augmented reality (AR) and digitalization to enhance hands-on and interactive learning experiences for the rural students. It also uses Augmented Reality (AR) to address issues like agricultural education, an important aspect of rural life.

articleTitle: Designing an Automated Smart Green House and Controlling Based on IOT-Enabled Intelligent Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the agricultural field, optimization of land area and manpower is the challenging task of all farmers. The cost and time to spend for creating the farming with all necessary natural resources are not done properly due to their lacking knowledge and communication in the agriculture field. Problem Statement: Most of the farmers are followed the traditional agricultural methods to do crop cultivation and only a few of them are using the latest techniques. IoT is the framework used to provide automated control over agricultural land and monitoring using sensors on the plants. Perhaps, sensors are generated whole plant data then sent to the centralized controller for analytics to make decision making by the farmers. It takes a long time while plant growth is affected in the case of short-term plant cultivation. Methodology: To overcome this issue Smart Green House concept is introduced in the agriculture field for the improvement of plant growth within a stipulated time. It is possible to enhance the quality of the system with an IoT-enabled framework and controlled by a Smart Green House Intelligence Decision Support System (SGHIDSS). The system is working with several sensors placed on a greenhouse in various places and takes the decisions of actions like water supply, nutrition level automatically. All the sensors and control systems are working in an automated environment which leads the greenhouse technique to get successful for small farmers. Findings: This research work provides the framework or model for small-scale farmers and individuals to implement the smart greenhouse in their areas easily. Also, it provides less manpower and a small amount of natural resources for developing agriculture.

articleTitle: Development of an IoT based Screening and Sanitizing System for Protection against Communicable Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Due to the recent outbreak of communicable diseases like Nipah virus, Severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS-CoV-1), Coronavirus, monkeypox etc, it has become a necessity to use sanitizers, non-contact thermal guns and many other sensors to check the vital stats of any/ every person entering an official complex or an isolation ward or even one’s house. Furthermore, devices like non-contact sanitizers and ultraviolet based decontamination chambers can be used to strengthen the first wall of defense, but due to the expensive nature and limited usability these devices individually are not an ideal choice. The main aim of the proposed system is to eliminate the need of multiple products for screening humans for coronavirus as well as for non-contact spraying of sanitizers on the hand and the ultra violet sanitization of materials. In the developed system the IoT (Internet of Things) feature is added which enables the critical parameters readings that determine the health state of an individual to be recorded and maintained over the cloud interface. The proposed system ensures contactless screening of a person and the vital stats obtained from the interfaced sensors are transmitted in real time using IoT. Therefore, the primarily detection of the symptoms in a person that may arises due to the communicable disease in a remote manner and the need for contactless sanitization motivates to develop the proposed system.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Firewalls: Empowering Intrusion Detection with ML and DL
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Given the increasing frequency of network-based threats, strong intrusion detection systems (IDS) are essential for safeguarding digital assets. Traditional rule-based IDS often struggle to keep up with evolving cyber threats, highlighting the need for more adaptive solutions. This study introduces a Next Generation Firewall (NGFW), which integrates machine learning and deep learning techniques to improve IDS performance. By employing ML algorithms like Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forests, and Deep Neural Networks (DNN), alongside DL models such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), the NGFW significantly enhances detection capabilities, flexibility, and accuracy. A comprehensive review of the literature demonstrates the effectiveness of ML and DL in IDS. The proposed approach involves systematic data collection, preprocessing, feature extraction, and model evaluation using metrics such as accuracy, precision, and recall. Experimental results show that CNNs achieve particularly low false-positive rates when detecting malicious activities. Additional real-world testing further validates the NGFW’s role in strengthening cybersecurity defenses. The classification report achieved high precision, recall, and F 1 -scores above 97 percent across all categories, with an overall accuracy of 97.29 percent. These findings advocate for further research into intelligent cyber defenses, emphasizing the value of ML and DL in developing more adaptable and resilient IDS.

articleTitle: Real-Time Credit Card Fraud Detection using deep Learning based framework
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: It is one of the most important features in financial security that must be done to prevent fraudulent users and malicious agents from swiping credit cards. The extensive use of credit cards for online transactions has legitimized payment fraud. Traditional fraud detection methods: One of the reasons conventional fraud detectors are rendered obsolete is that newer variants of malicious tools and techniques evolve faster than they can be detected. This paper proposes a deep learning approach for real-time credit card fraud detection to resolve this problem. The framework is built using deep learning, which helps to accurately and quickly detect fraud in your real-time data. The system uses advanced deep learning algorithms to analyze real-time transactional data and detect anomalies. Being trained in a data-driven method, the deep learning-based framework can adapt when encountering new fraud patterns. For this reason, it can identify anomalies in fraudulent activities with high accuracy. It also has real-time analytics for large data volumes, so it is suited to financial organizations with a high volume of transactions. Among other pros, this architecture allows far higher throughput for a given latency than traditional approaches. It could also lower the time to respond to fraud detection and potentially reduce financial loss from fraudulent acts. In summary, real-time credit card fraud detection via a deep learning-based framework is one of the most promising ways to secure financial transactions and guard consumers against being affected by this or any other type of online threats.

articleTitle: Cardio Predict: A Smart System for Predicting Heart Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: cardiovascular disease is the leading disease globally, and hypertension, diabetes, among other lifestyle factors contribute to it. Traditional diagnostics mainly focus on retrospective biometric assessment; such diagnostics will not offer sufficient prediction capabilities for proactive management without invasive procedures. In this paper, we propose a machine learning-based risk stratification from noninvasive, age-based assessments aiming at early detection of cardiovascular disease risks in asymptomatic people. This was made possible by leveraging a comprehensive dataset from Kaggle that was used in evaluating different models of ML over the given data with high emphasis laid on logistic regression because, unlike random forest and KNN models, this has exemplary predictive capability. In summation, what this piece of research is able to contribute is an identification of a good non-invasive robust predictive approach that’s likely to be applied for use in the clinical space in improving effectiveness in earlier intervention as well as that of patients’ outcome.

articleTitle: Immersive Learning in Healthcare: Development and Implementation of the AR Anatomy Trainer
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The incorporation of augmented reality (AR) in healthcare and medical training is transforming the business by offering inventive solutions that enhance education, improve surgical accuracy, and boost patient involvement. The creation and execution of the “AR Anatomy Trainer,” an augmented reality (AR) application specifically developed to provide medical students with interactive and highly realistic anatomical visuals. The curriculum seeks to narrow the divide between theoretical knowledge and applied abilities by employing development tools such as Unity 3D, Blender 3D, Adobe Photoshop, and Vuforia. The AR Anatomy Trainer enables students to visually observe, anatomically dissect, and comprehensively study the anatomy of the human body in an immersive environment, leading to a substantial enhancement in comprehension and long-term memory retention. It also examines various applications of augmented reality (AR) in clinical practice, such as its utilization in aiding surgeons with improved visibility during surgeries, facilitating remote medical training, and enhancing patient education through interactive AR experiences. The literature review encompasses a comprehensive analysis of recent research conducted, with a specific emphasis on the profound influence of augmented reality (AR) within the healthcare sector. The development process is described, highlighting a systematic approach from the first idea to the final implementation, guaranteeing the construction of a user-friendly tool with instructional value. It highlights the potential of augmented reality (AR) technology to enhance medical training and patient care, leading to additional advancements and improved healthcare results.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Deep Learning Techniques in Cattle Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Accurate identification of individual livestock is extremely important for proper care and herd disease management. Livestock identification contributes to breed management, productivity monitoring and reduce labour cost through automation. Cattle identification with deep learning using biometric and facial recognition is more accurate, consistent than traditional branding or ear tags which may go missing or get damaged. Due to the enormous amount of data that is sent through quickly, an electromagnetic technique like RFID may be able to marginally speed up the process over hand sorting, but it will never be able to attain the same levels of analysis as Deep Learning. This adds up for behavioural analysis, continuous health monitoring and automated decision-making that will eventually lead to increased yields and herd management. This study compares the capabilities of state-of-the-art deep learning systems and looks ahead at future research in this area. In this study, opencows2020, dataset is used, which comprises of 4243 images of Holestian frestian cattle, that are divided into 46 categories are used to compare the performance of the deep learning models AlexNet and ResNet-50 with the DeiT transformer. The DeiT transformer performed better than the other two versions, according to the study.

articleTitle: A Smart Approach to Pneumonia Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Pneumonia is an infection that results in swelling and the buildup of pus or fluid in the air sacs of one or both lungs. Bacteria, viruses, and fungi are among the infectious organisms that can cause this illness. Depending on the causative organism, the patient’s general health, and any underlying diseases, pneumonia can vary greatly in severity and treatment. Different kinds of pneumonia exist, such as community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) and hospital-acquired pneumonia (HAP). Diagnosing usually requires a physical examination and imaging exams, with treatment depending on the cause—antibiotics are used for bacterial pneumonia, while supportive care is given for viral pneumonia. Prevention involves getting vaccinated and practicing good hygiene habits. Prompt diagnosis and treatment are crucial for vulnerable populations to avoid serious complications from pneumonia. This study seeks a method to detect pneumonia by using Deep Learning (DL) techniques that concentrate on the behavior and attributes of proposed chest x-ray images. The aim of this work is to implement various deep learning models such as Convolutional neural network (CNN), VGG-19, MobilenetV2 etc., for classifying a chest X-ray image as either pneumonia or normal case. The results demonstrate that CNN achieves the highest accuracy of 99.77%.

articleTitle: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence in Computer Science to Manage Stress and Anxiety: Applications and Innovations
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This study explores the effectiveness, ethical considerations, and demographic influences of AI-based interventions in managing stress and anxiety. AI technologies, including Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Biometric Monitoring, have shown promising results in reducing stress and anxiety across diverse populations. Machine Learning algorithms excel in predictive analytics, enabling early detection and intervention, while NLP tools offer real-time cognitive-behavioural therapy (CBT) and emotional support through AI-powered chatbots. Biometric Monitoring provides objective physiological data, further enhancing the precision of stress management strategies. However, the effectiveness of these interventions is influenced by demographic variables such as age, gender, socio-economic status, and cultural background, with younger, tech-savvy users and those of higher socio-economic status showing greater engagement and benefit. Also, the mobile application named “sahayya” has been discussed along with its merits. Discussing how technology can be put to better use.

articleTitle: Cloud Based Data Analytics for Business Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This comprehensive review paper delves deeply into the realm of cloud-based data analytics platforms, underscoring their crucial role in propelling Business Intelligence (BI) forward during an era characterized by an unprecedented surge in data volumes. Faced with the deluge of data, organizations are increasingly relying on these platforms as indispensable tools to tap into the hidden potential of data and facilitate well-informed decision-making. The paper methodically traces the evolutionary path of cloud-based BI analytics platforms, shedding light on their diverse advantages and the substantial challenges they pose. It also elucidates the emerging trends in this dynamic landscape, outlining how these platforms are poised to reshape the future of BI. By conducting a thorough review of the existing body of literature, this paper imparts valuable insights into the defining attributes of these platforms, effective strategies for their adoption, and the critical factors that underpin their effectiveness. Additionally, it explores the pivotal role these platforms playing enhancing the flexibility, scalability, and cost-efficiency of BI processes. Moreover, in addition to furnishing an in-depth analysis, this review identifies significant gaps in current research and provides thoughtful recommendations for future avenues of exploration. These recommendations are intended to promote the continued growth and refinement of cloud-based data analytics platforms within the broader context of BI.

articleTitle: Hybrid Steganographic and Encryption Approach using Color Analysis for Secure Image Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Digital privacy and secure communication are under increasing threats, making strong methods of protection of sensitive data ever more important. Steganography is the art of concealing information within seemingly innocuous media, but the traditional techniques usually cannot resist advanced steganalysis methods. One such hybrid steganographic method has been proposed, embedding encryption onto color analysis for serving the dual purpose of ensuring more security and making the data hidden less perceivable. This technique tries to enhance both imperceptibility and resistance towards detection by embedding encrypted messages into strategically selected parts of the image where modifying is less likely to be detected by both the naked eye observer and the automated detection mechanisms. This is achieved by carrying out a color analysis that selects the optimal embedding regions with regard to texturing complexity and luminance contrast. In this work, a proposal for secure transmission is also developed using steganalysis keys that allow only the authorized parties to decrypt and reach the hidden information. Consequently, the strong point of this approach considers this to be a highly secure and imperceptible means for covert data communication, suitable for applications in the military, government, and digital watermarking.

articleTitle: Integrating Cloud And Edge Computing For Scalable Iot Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The data from the Internet of Things (IoT) is essential in the modern data-driven digital economy since it inspires many new business models supplying a wide spectrum of services both ubiquitous and intelligent. The data transmitted using edge computing technologies is investigated in this paper. Under the framework of the trust model of the research, the data exchanged between the source block and the destination block generates direct, indirect, and reciprocal trust. Although cloud computing can serve as a paradigm for safe data flow, the results of the study revealed that a trust-based approach can avoid cloud intrusion. The simulation runs on numerous test beds using the presently in use cloud technique. The results clearly illustrate that the trust-based approach is effective in protecting data moved across edge computing.

articleTitle: Mobile-Friendly Plant Disease Detection and Classification using Metadata and Asymmetric Knowledge Distillation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The increasing interest in the mobile applications of real-time plant disease detection systems has given rise to new difficulties in building computational models that can perform with high accuracy with limited resources. This paper presents an inventive concept that leverages metadata and asymmetric knowledge distillation to improve the use of mobile applications for detecting and classifying plant diseases. It is reported that a teacher model (ResNet – 50) trained on environmental factors (e.g. temperature, humidity, and soil) enriched dataset was converted to a student model (MobileNet) which is mobile deployable. The knowledge embedded in soft labels of the teacher model was distilled and taught to the student model allowing it to practice high accuracy data classification with less computations. Adding metadata further gives evidence to the assertion and helps improve the overall detection accuracy. The results of the experiments indicate the effective use of knowledge distillation in a mobile-based plant disease classification where a lightweight MobileNet model performs comparably with the ResNet-50 model. This structure offers a practical and scalable solution for real-time disease monitoring and identification, allowing farmers to make timely decisions with a smartphone.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Age Prediction Using Extensive Health and Nutritional Factors
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: With the increasing demand for machine learningin the medical field, this work addresses the growing need for accurate age prediction. Leveraging the NHANES dataset, which includes seven key features such as Body Mass Index and Glucose levels, the proposal utilizes advanced machine learning techniques to train a model that effectively predicts individuals’ ages. After exploring various predictive approaches, a model was selected that demonstrated superior performance, highlighting its potential to enhance healthcare planning, risk assessment, and personalized health interventions. This data-driven approach promises to improve healthcare outcomes and support strategicdecision-making in the medical domain.

articleTitle: Enhancing Airport Security: Integrating PSO-TAM with Deep Learning for Real-Time Threat Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Background: To increase their threat detecting ability in face of mounting security issues, airports are using creative algorithms. Objective: This work merges deep learning approaches with the Passenger Security Optimization with Threat Assessment Model (PSO-TAM) to improve real-time threat assessment. Contribution: This paper addresses the basic problem of the need of a more efficient and effective security model merging new analytics with present airport security technologies. The challenge is especially designing a system that reduces false alarms, increases threat detection accuracy, and provides security workers with fast and valuable information. Results and Findings: PSO-TAM routinely delivers superior accuracy, precision, recall, and F-measure even if it also shows lowered loss values. This implies that PSO-TAM not only raises the accuracy of threat predictions but also reduces false alarms, therefore enabling more consistent and strong security responses. Combining PSO with the TAM has demonstrated to be very beneficial in optimizing the classification parameters and changing to varied data volumes.

articleTitle: Transforming Logistics Operations with Intelligent Automation Using a Naive Bayes Perspective on Warehouse Management
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Intelligent automation has revolutionized logistics operations, especially warehouse management. This study provides an in-depth investigation into improving inventory management through the use of artificial intelligence using Bayesian inference. Errors and inefficiencies define the current problems with traditional inventory control systems. About naive bayes algorithms, particularly in the field of product management, research knowledge is lacking. For this study, data were gathered from performance evaluation of conventional systems, the Naive Bayes algorithm, and previously existing inventory control systems. The revelations and outcomes are: The negative Bayesian approach applied in product management has the potential to raise performance, accuracy, and cost economy according to research findings. The findings of this work show evidence that the Naive Bayes algorithm is a valuable instrument for handling inventory control issues and greatly add to the increasing corpus of knowledge on supply chain automation.

articleTitle: Crafting a Machine Learning Model for Discerning Synthetic and Authentic Images
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This paper shows the development of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model with an attention mechanism and data augmentation for discerning synthetic and authentic images. Given the increase in AI-generated content there is a need for robust methods to identify an image's authenticity. The model employs ensemble learning by using ResNet50 and VGG16 architectures which are combined with a custom CNN. The project has detailed explanations of CNNs, data augmentation, TensorFlow, CUDA, ensemble models and the mathematical concepts underlying these techniques. With a dataset of $\mathbf{2 . 7}$ million images, the model aims for high accuracy in classification tasks.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: CNN-Enhanced Network Security: A Sustainable Approach to Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Cybersecurity remains a critical challenge in today’s digital landscape, impacting various industries while aligning with key Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Notably, it connects with SDG 9, which focuses on fostering innovation and building resilient infrastructure, and SDG 16, which emphasizes promoting peace, justice, and strong institutions. The increasing sophistication and frequency of cyber threats call for novel approaches, as traditional methods of detecting anomalous behavior are often inadequate in addressing these evolving risks. This research introduces an innovative approach to detecting unusual activity in network traffic by leveraging Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The model is trained and evaluated on a comprehensive set of normal and abnormal network events from the CICIDS2017 dataset. The CNN-based approach achieved a notable accuracy of 93.64%, significantly outperforming conventional detection methods. This advancement not only enhances cybersecurity efforts but also contributes to the promotion of SDG 9 by fostering innovative solutions and reinforcing infrastructure. Additionally, the model aids in identifying and mitigating cyber threats, supporting the objectives of SDG 16 by strengthening institutions and ensuring more secure systems. The results, including performance curves, accuracy, recall, F1 score, and confusion matrices, provide a thorough assessment of the model’s effectiveness. These findings underscore the critical role of advanced machine learning techniques, particularly deep learning, in bolstering cybersecurity systems. The capacity of CNNs to detect network anomalies with high accuracy demonstrates their potential to transform cybersecurity practices. This work highlights the need for continued exploration and application of deep learning methods in the face of escalating cybersecurity challenges, which in turn supports the achievement of key sustainable development goals and contributes to the stability and security of digital infrastructures.

articleTitle: Maximizing Return on Investment Through Deep Learning-Driven Marketing Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Deep learning is a subfield of machine learning in which predictions are produced from big datasets by neural networks. Maximum return on investment (ROI) calls both formulation and application of cost-cutting strategies. If companies are to maintain their production and the result of their investments, they should regularly check their expenses and look for ways to reduce costs without compromising their efficiency. Reducing unnecessary costs helps businesses increase the profitability of their capital and improve their return on investment. This model finds consumer behavior patterns using a deep learning algorithm and focuses on the audience most relevant to a given good or service. Constant data analysis and learning from it helps the model to improve targeting strategies, so generating a marketing campaign as successful and effective as could be. The proposed model turned out successful with an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 1. 0 0 \%}$, a precision of 96.02%, a recall of $\mathbf{9 2. 0 2 \%} \%$, and a f1-score from 97.04%. The ability of this strategy to adequately reach the target audience has significantly raised the return on investment (ROI), so increasing the possibility of conversion into customers. Companies can raise their return on investment and achieve more degrees of marketing success by means of deep learning technology.

articleTitle: Diagnosing Floral Diseases Automatically using Deep Convolutional Neural Nets
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In floriculture, quick and precise disease detection is critical to crop health and profitability. Traditional procedures are frequently labour-intensive and inefficient, which highlights the need for new methods. This study solves this issue by using improvements in AI and image processing via Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNNs). The goal was to create a strong deep learning model capable of identifying common flower illnesses using a dataset of $\mathbf{1, 6 0 2}$ high-resolution photos spanning five disease classes: ‘healthy,’ ‘rhizopus,’ ‘powdery mildew,’ ‘rust,’ and ‘blight’. The contribution of this work is the development of an ensemble model that leverages the strengths of the Xception and DenseNet121 architectures to improve classification accuracy. Transfer learning to adapt pretrained models using ImageNet weights for this specific task, thereby enhancing the model’s generalization capabilities. The ensemble learning strategy increased classification accuracy by $\mathbf{3 . 7 \%}$, resulting in a final accuracy of $96.4 \%$, which is significantly higher than utilizing independent models. This model demonstrates the effectiveness of integrating deep learning, transfer learning, and data augmentation, even with minimal datasets. The findings show that this approach has the potential to revolutionize disease detection in floriculture, allowing for more efficient crop health monitoring, higher yields, and increased economic viability. The use of these advanced techniques demonstrates Artificial intelligent rising involvement in agriculture, with this model helping to develop more effective and scalable disease detection systems.

articleTitle: Prediction of Stock Prices using LSTM Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Stock or equity market has a big impact on the economy today. The primary determinant of an investor’s profit is whether the share price increases or decreases. Today’s forecasting techniques combine non-linear and linear algorithms (AR, MA, and ARIMA). (ARCH, GARCH, Neural Networks), yet their primary goal is forecasting the movement of a stock index or the prediction of a single employing the closing price for each day. The suggested approach is a method independent of models. This research paper focuses on the scope of the LSTM network in prediction of stock prices. The model uses the LSTM network which is the upgraded model of the RNN and explores the features of LSTM network provides over the RNN.
