articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Software-Defined Networking Platforms during Denial-of-Service Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Software-Defined Networking has emerged as a transformative technology in modern networking due to its centralized and programmable architecture. This study aims to evaluate the performance of two leading open source SDN platforms, the Open Networking Operating System (ONOS) and Open Daylight. The evaluation focuses on key performance metrics including availability, response time, and packet loss in two custom network scenarios during denial-of-service attack scenarios and examines how well these platforms handle attacks that specifically target OpenFlow protocols, which is used for control plane traffic. The results of this research provide valuable insight into the resilience of SDN solutions during cyberattacks and pave the way for the development of future mitigation strategies using artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques.

articleTitle: Investigating the Effect of Absorber Layer Thickness on Photovoltaic Efficiency in Ca3NI3 Perovskite Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Calcium nitrogen iodide (Ca<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>NI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) has intriguing structural, visible, and electrical characteristics, making it a compelling candidate for developing absorbers in cost-effective, high-performance solar cell applications. Research efforts have extensively examined the potential uses of the perovskite (PSK) substance Ca<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>NI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> as a layer of absorption in heterostructure PV cells. The SCAPS-1D simulator was used to determine the optimal PV values for the Ca<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>NI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> PSC framework with CdS as the ETL. The research was conducted using the 1D-SCAPS program. Thanks to their improved effectiveness and affordability in manufacturing, PSCs are a practical and efficient technology for producing renewable energy. An investigation was conducted to assess the influence of differences in thickness on the device’s efficacy. A device structure consisting of $\mathrm{AL} / \mathrm{FTO} / \mathrm{CdS} / \mathrm{Ca}_{3} \mathrm{NI}_{3}$ has been fabricated. The active layer in this suggested research has a thickness range of 0.2 to $1.1 ~\mu \mathrm{m}$, separated into 10 equally spaced intervals. After adjusting the absorbent layer thickness to its maximum of $1.1 ~\mu \mathrm{m}$, the following PV metrics are observed: PCE - 21.07%, V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OC</inf> $\mathbf{- 1 . 0 2} \mathrm{V}, \mathrm{J}_{\text {SC}} \mathbf{- 2 5 . 4 1} \mathrm{mA} / \mathrm{cm}^{2}$, and FF-80.59%.

articleTitle: Leveraging Gamification for Enhanced Talent Assessment in India’s Science and Technology Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: India’s science and technology sector is at the forefront of innovation, propelling breakthroughs that will define our future. However, these sectors face several hurdles, notably the selection of personnel fitting to the demands. Traditional techniques of talent selection often fall short of capturing the different talents and abilities required for success in this continuously changing environment. Scientific ways of predicting the competence is used only by very few organisations. The selection based on just the technical knowhow doesn’t predict the complex attitude of key positions. This article represents a big effort to transform traditional prospects of talent recruiting and selection in to a scientific way of prediction at India’s most important Research and Development Institutions. Against this context, gamification appears to be a potential approach to predict the competence of recruits. By integrating game design ideas into hiring and selection processes, the organization can select compelling, immersive experiences that not only attract top talents as well as properly assess their capabilities in the Key result areas.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Method for Reliable Malware Detection in IoT using Opcode Category Features
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The number of threats has grown as a result of the Internet of Things’ (IoT) rapid expansion, making effective malware identification and classification techniques necessary. The goal of this project is to improve IoT malware detection systems (MDS) and categorization by utilizing machine learning techniques and opcode category properties. Using neural network methods, the method examines opcode sequences taken out of IoT device firmware. These sequences are converted into features of the opcode category, which are then fed into the CNN model. By means of comprehensive training and assessment, the model acquires the ability to differentiate between benign and dangerous opcode patterns, hence facilitating precise malware identification and classification. The malware identification and categorization system that utilizes CNN technology demonstrates encouraging performance metrics, attaining elevated levels of accuracy, precision, and recall. In particular, the model outperforms other machine learning techniques as well as conventional signature-based methods in identifying and classifying various forms of IoT malware. The results of this study highlight how well CNN algorithms and opcode category features work together to provide reliable IoT malware identification and classification. This method strengthens defense against new hazards in the IoT ecosystem and improves cybersecurity measures by precisely recognizing malicious behaviors within the firmware of IoT devices.

articleTitle: Exploring Deep Learning for Comprehensive Dog Breed Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The breed of a dog can be identified from an image using computer vision and deep learning techniques. With the use of user-submitted dog images, the model will identify the breed of the dog by choosing from among the 70 breeds included in the dataset. Inception, Xception, InceptionResNetV2, and MobileNetV2 are a few of the deep learning algorithms that are used in the proposed work to determine dog breeds. The Xception, Inception, InceptionResNetV2, and MobileNetV2 models exhibit high accuracy rates in the current system, with $\mathbf{9 1. 6 7 \%}, \mathbf{9 0. 9 2 \%}$, and $\mathbf{9 0. 0 3 \%}$, respectively. The usefulness of these algorithms in identifying breeds is evaluated through comparison. The outstanding performance of these algorithms especially Xception, which attained the highest accuracy is highlighted in this research. These models’ efficacy shows how deep learning techniques have made tremendous progress in dog breed recognition.

articleTitle: Stock Prediction Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Machine learning is a novel strategy that processes massive volumes of data. In machine learning, K-nearest neighbours (KNN) and linear regression models are frequently employed for a range of analytical and predictive uses. KNN is a powerful, easy-to-use, and very successful technique for handling classification problems. Based on their proximity to one another, data points are grouped. However, the best method for predictive modelling is linear regression as it creates a linear relationship between the input and output variables. By contrasting these models using publicly accessible datasets, one may ascertain the models’ efficacy in various contexts as well as their advantages and disadvantages. KNN and linear regression are important tools in a data scientist’s toolkit because of how well they handle non-linear data patterns and how well they may give clear insights into data trends. Sophisticated machine learning models like Random Forests, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks are frequently used to forecast future stock closing values.

articleTitle: A Novel Enhanced Prediction of Lung Cancer Histopathological Medical Image Processing Using Hybrid Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Lung cancer is a serious disease that affects human organs. The type and location of cancer will mostly determine the course of medical treatment. Creating an automated method is crucial to the early detection of malignant conditions. On the other hand, conventional techniques are still employed to diagnose illnesses. Due to the accuracy and efficiency limits of traditional screening techniques like CT scans and X-rays, many cases of lung cancer are discovered later on, when treatment is already underway. There are few choices. In this research paper, we implement a neural network hybrid classifier to construct an extremely precise and effective method for lung cancer prediction. To begin with, we create a sizable collection of patient information and medical photos for training and assessment of the CNN and RNN Classifier. A range of imaging modalities, such as CT scans, X-rays, and other medical pictures, are included in the collection. Next, we create and train a CNN classifier to identify lung cancer using a hybrid deep-learning methodology. To achieve an earlier and more accurate diagnosis of lung cancer, the NN classifiers were improved for high accuracy and efficiency. Additionally, datasets for several CT scanning images, including axial, coronal, and sagittal, have been produced. However, compared to the traditional 3D-CNN and regular CNN we can’t get the exact results, but in our approach, we included the CNN model along with the RNN model, if we combined both models, we produced more aesthetically beautiful results and yielded more accurate results regarding diseases. CNN model, which analyzes historical data to detect lung cancer, was unable to yield reliable disease detection findings because they used only the CNN model. The resultant accuracy is obtained by RNN is $\mathbf{9 2 \%}$ and CNN is $\mathbf{9 6 \%}$.

articleTitle: Advancements in Assistive Technology: A Blind Aid Bot for Enhanced Spatial Awareness and Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Independence of people with vision impairments is necessary as they face many hurdles in their daily lives from locating objects to navigating through obstacles. In the current environment, it is still challenging to provide the visually impaired with appropriate guidance and to find solutions to their difficulties. In order to enhance the awareness and day-to-day activities of visually impaired users, this project introduces a software-centred approach called the visual assistant. The software architecture of the blind assistance robot is based on deep learning and can use patterns for object recognition, intervention and optimization. The system uses convolutional neural networks (CNN) and you only look once (yolov5) and is trained on many different urban and indoor environments to ensure robustness and accuracy in different situations. Integration with natural language processing (NLP) makes it intuitive, allowing users to receive messages and send commands with simple voice. Test in a simulated environment to check the effectiveness of algorithms and user interfaces. Preliminary results show significant improvements in reporting accuracy and user confidence when interacting in an unfamiliar environment. Responses from users in the first test show the potential of the blind program to reduce the daily problems of the visually impaired. This paper not only demonstrates the feasibility of software solutions in helping the visually impaired, but also opens up personal development opportunities. Future work will focus on real-world testing and integration of adaptive learning techniques to further improve user interaction and environment-based performance.

articleTitle: Integrating Multiple Machine Learning Algorithms for Bankruptcy Prediction: The Role of Voting Classifiers in Enhancing Predictive Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In financial management, it is an important chore to find businesses that might go bankrupt and so enable preventative measures to avert a financial crisis. In this work, the authors build an innovative model for bankruptcy prediction using a voting classifier, one of the ensemble learning techniques combining traits of several machine learning algorithms for superior predictive performance. Combining logistic regression, decision trees, and support vector machines in the approach generates a more robust prediction. The authors obtained an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 7 \%}$ with the voting classifier after rigorous training and testing on dataset having multiple financial variables. This tremendous degree of accuracy is meant to show how well ensemble methods capture complex patterns and connections inside financial data. The results reveal that the voting classifier not only raises the accuracy in prediction but also offers a dependable method through which likely bankruptcy may be found at an early stage, thereby enabling rapid and smart actions on the part of financial stakeholders.

articleTitle: Optimizing Convolutional Neural Network Hyperparameters for MNIST Image Classification: Insights and Implications
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The recognition of handwritten digits has been among the most enduring fundamental problems explored in the field of machine learning and computer vision. The objective of this work is to design a state-of-art Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for the image classification on the MNIST dataset to resolve issues related to data pre-processing and parameter tuning effectively. The work starts with standardizing the image data and then using one-hot encoding for the models that will improve the generalization and representation. The CNN structure followed in this work includes the convolutional layer, batch normalization, pooling layers, and fully connected layers with an efficient integration of features. To measure such performance indicators as accuracy, the given dataset is divided for training and validation. The results are also preprocessed to control for overfitting and convergence using back propagation with early stop to stop training when significant accuracy improvement is not observed and learning rate decay to encourage the model to search for better weights in the final stages of training. The model’s performance is tested and evaluated by using different epoch intervals and learning rates, and it is shown how critical it is to select the correct default hyperparameters for achieving efficiency. This paper also presents the approach for the practical application of the preprocessing of images and the systematic assessment in enhancing CNN-based handwritten digit recognition.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling of Child Identity Risk using Machine and Deep Learning: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Intellectual disability (ID), a developmental condition often stemming from prenatal or postnatal factors, exerts a profound influence on individuals’ lives and necessitates timely intervention. Conventional screening methods are resource-intensive and demand specialized medical expertise. This study introduces a novel, non-invasive approach to ID screening by meticulously analyzing facial features and vocal characteristics extracted from interview videos.Through the extraction of facial measurements and speech patterns, we devised a Craniofacial Variability Index (CVI) to assess the likelihood of ID. Furthermore, advanced machine learning techniques were strategically employed to augment the predictive accuracy of this index. Our empirical findings unequivocally demonstrate promising results, with an accuracy rate reaching up to 80% when synergizing CVI scores and phonetic features. This research underscores the potential of a non-invasive, AI-powered screening instrument for ID, offering a more accessible and efficient alternative to prevailing practices. Future investigations will concentrate on refining the model and validating its efficacy across diverse populations.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Summarization of Homogeneous Records Using Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In today’s data-driven world, the inefficient and inconsistent recalculation of hierarchical summaries presents a significant challenge for organizations relying on large datasets for critical decision-making. Traditional methods often suffer from delays and data inconsistencies as datasets expand. To address this issue, a novel solution using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) is proposed for asynchronously recalculating hierarchical summaries in uniform records. This approach enhances data accuracy, accelerates processing, and maintains scalability by transforming hierarchical datasets into graph structures, allowing GNNs to capture complex relationships. Additionally, a specialized batching method is introduced to allow for simultaneous updates without locking entire datasets. Extensive testing demonstrates that this method significantly outperforms traditional recalculation techniques in terms of speed, consistency, and scalability, providing a robust and scalable solution for managing large, complex data structures in real-world applications

articleTitle: Revolutionary Dysarthria Analysis Through Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Dysarthria occurs when there are impairments in the muscles necessary for speech, including those in the lips, tongue, voice box, and breathing muscles. This condition can result in unclear speech, even in individuals who are skilled communicators. Dysarthria can range from mild speech difficulties, where speech is hard to understand, to severe cases, where speech is completely unclear. A method for distinguishing between different types of speech involves using recordings and advanced computational techniques such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The strengths of CNNs are leveraged to construct a highly effective model for detecting dysarthria in speech samples. The dataset utilized includes recordings from individuals with and without dysarthria. The results indicate that the CNN model performs exceptionally well, achieving precision, recall, and F1-scores of 0.99 for both categories. With an accuracy of 0.99, the model demonstrates a high level of proficiency in differentiating between speech affected by dysarthria and normal speech. These findings highlight the effectiveness and utility of this CNN-based approach in diagnosing and assessing dysarthria. It offers valuable potential for assisting healthcare professionals and enhancing personalized speech therapy interventions.

articleTitle: Improved SqueezeNet Architecture for Brain Age Prediction using MRI
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Predicting brain age from MRI scans is crucial for understanding neurological development and aging-related disorders. Robust preprocessing methods and flexible model architectures are required because variations in image quality, resolution, and acquisition methodologies can impact deep learning performance. The improved Squeeze Net architecture shown in this work can accurately predict brain age from MRI scans. The approach combines a bilateral filtering procedure for preprocessing to enhance picture quality, and then an Improved Squeeze Net (Imp-Squeeze Net) model for precise evaluation of brain age. The model includes convolutional layers, fire modules, and global average pooling, ending with a dense layer that employs SoftMax activation. Notably, a novel Focal Huber Loss function is introduced to handle the complex data distributions and enhance predictive performance. Comparing the performance of the proposed model to CNN (0.155), GRU (0.151), Bi-LSTM (0.130), RNN (0.157), Bi-GRU ($\mathbf{0} .160$), and LSTM ($\mathbf{0} .158$), a significant reduction in prediction error is observed. When compared to conventional techniques, experimental results show higher accuracy and robustness, highlighting the method's promise in brain research and clinical diagnostics.

articleTitle: Edge Computing in Smart Cities: Enhancing Real-Time Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: One of the most crucial issues that smart cities have to keep addressing as they grow is urban mobility improvement. Maximizing the efficiency of transportation, so lowering congestion, and so optimizing traffic flow can help to solve the growing urbanization and increasing vehicle numbers. This research aims to develop and implement a deep learning method based on DenseNet in order to reach the target of raising the effectiveness of urban traffic management. The unique selling proposition that distinguishes this sector from others is the introduction of modern technologies into a sector that has always depended on conventional methods. The main goal of the work was to apply DenseNet architecture to analyze traffic patterns. Considering the two other strategies, the proposed option has a lot of possibilities. From evaluation criteria-which comprised recall, precision, and F1-score, the proposed solution outperformed the approaches regarded to be state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: Smart Education Ecosystems for Enhancing Learning Experiences through Deep Attention Learning and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Expanding knowledge at a time of fast change in the field of education depends absolutely on the creation of intelligent learning ecosystems. The aim of this work is to investigate the possibilities of using artificial intelligence and deep learning respectively to improve the learning surroundings. Emphasizing the need of developing new approaches, the first part of the presentation addressed the challenges the conventional educational system is today facing. The problem statement is Reality Statement of Mind The current problem is that the surroundings lack personal training and cooperation; hence, course of action must be altered. This research suggests that deep learning be combined with technology to customize instructional content for every and every student. The approach under use is creating an intelligent learning ecosystem with cutting-edge algorithms to investigate student involvement, interests, and learning patterns by means of intricate analysis. The system helps one to focus the learning process as necessary, so improving knowledge and memory retention. Studies reveal that student involvement, learner general, and comprehension have much improved. Applied in the field of education, deep learning and artificial intelligence have the potential to help close the gap and generate a learning environment that is both better and more efficient.

articleTitle: Citadel: A Real Estate Business and Property Purchase Fraud Detection Assistant Smartphone Application Using Flutter and Firebase Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Real estate industry of a country dispatches a extraordinary role by offering opportunities for property development, home ownership, rental, and employment facilities. The current real estate sector assistant works did not investigate an assistance mobile or web application with property purchase eligibility checking, different criteria-based land/flat purchase and developer search features, real estate fraud detection, police help seeking, economic help assistance, roommate search for flat rent, attorney search, property winner contact, real estate help tips, property advertisement submission, and real estate job application features. To gain mastery over the existing shortcomings, this article dispatches a real estate business assistant assistance smart phone application with property purchase eligibility check feature, real estate fraud prediction, property item search and booking, fraud reporting feature, economic help, real estate job application, developer search, roommate search for flat rent, consumer instant help, owner contact, attorney booking, advertisement posting, and property purchase tips features. The proposed real estate assistant application received prodigious feedback from over $\mathbf{6 0 \%}$ of evaluators, indicating its feasibility and usefulness.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Water Dispersal Management System using Suction Motor for Optimized Agricultural Irrigation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Optimizing crop yield and conserving water resources in agriculture necessitate effective water management strategies. This paper presents a prototype system for managing water dispersal using a suction motor, combined with real-time soil moisture monitoring via the Internet of Things (IoT). The system continuously measures soil moisture content using sensors, and an electric suction motor is activated when moisture levels exceed or fall below predetermined thresholds, as signaled by an Arduino circuit board. The motor redistributes surplus water from regions with high moisture to areas with lower moisture, ensuring an even distribution of water and maintaining optimal soil conditions for crop growth. Results from field tests demonstrate the system’s efficiency in balancing soil moisture, as moisture levels in over-saturated areas were reduced from $\mathbf{8 0 \%}$ to $\mathbf{6 0 \%}$, while drier areas saw an increase from $\mathbf{2 0 \%}$ to $\mathbf{5 0 \%}$. Additionally, comparative analysis shows that the water dispersal management system using a suction motor achieves higher efficiency ($\mathbf{8 0 \%}$) in maintaining moisture balance compared to traditional methods and other automated systems. This technology offers an affordable, scalable, and sustainable approach to agricultural water management, significantly enhancing crop output and resource conservation efforts.

articleTitle: Collaborative Platform for Content Creators and Brands Based on Semantic Search
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In today’s changing world establishing strong connections, between sponsors and content creators is key to successful brand promotion. This paper presents a platform designed to enhance connections by utilizing matching methods to help sponsors identify and engage with streamers who align with their brand values and audience demographics effectively boosting the impact of sponsorships. Semantic matching involves evaluating the significance of search inquiries and content to enhance the precision and suitability of these associations. This research investigates the use of matching to improve search capabilities, on the platform. It also examines how this affects the connection, between sponsors and creators while highlighting the benefits and obstacles of this approach.

articleTitle: Predicting Parkinson’s Disease Using Multimodal Data and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Parkinson’s Disease (PD) is a degenerative neurological disease that has significant worldwide implications, impacting a considerable number of individuals across the globe. Timely identification of disease plays a critical role in easy and prior intrusion and improving patient health. The paper deliberates a comprehensive study that leverages Machine Learning (ML) algorithms to generate accurate models for detecting PD. Various ML techniques like decision trees, SVM, random forests etc., are employed in the analysis. The study utilizes a diverse dataset comprising clinical and demographic features of patients, including motor symptoms, medical history, and genetic information. The results display the efficacy of ML algorithms in discrimination between PD and healthy individuals. The models exhibit high accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity in identifying the disease. Furthermore, the predictive models developed in the study showcase promising performance in estimating disease progression and severity. This research’s discoveries add to the expanding knowledge base regarding the utilization of ML in PD’s diagnosis and prognosis.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Soil Contamination Analysis: Green Sustainable Practices
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Soil nutrients have a significant contribution in the health of soil and in productivity of crops. However, traditional methods of analysis of different parameters of soil such as electrical conductivity (EC), pH, organic carbon, moisture content, nitrogen, C/N ratio, phosphorus and potassium (NPK) and soil temperature are time consuming and exhaustive methods. However, with advancement in artificial intelligence, various advanced and digital based techniques can be explored for handling the large number of soil parameters data for better and efficient results. A set of AI techniques including Deep Learning (DL) and Machine Learning (ML) have great potential in advanced technology based agriculture systems. Farmers and soil scientists can identify the amount of nutrients present in agricultural soil by exploiting AI methods particularly ML and DL techniques. These techniques are accurate and adaptable techniques. Accuracy of results can be achieved by ML technique. Generative AI, a subset of AI is playing an important role to enhance the productivity in agriculture domain. In this paper, the authors have shown the application of GAN, a machine learning framework, to generate data that imitates real soil contamination data. This synthetic data can help to augment training datasets for machine learning models.

articleTitle: Enhancing Tumor Detection in Medical Imaging Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: scientific imaging plays a crucial role in detecting and diagnosing numerous sicknesses, including cancer. However, traditional photograph interpretation techniques can be time-consuming and vulnerable to mistakes. Deep knowledge of methods has been increasingly applied in scientific imaging to overcome these barriers for quicker and extra correct diagnosis. Deep getting to know is a subfield of artificial intelligence that uses algorithms to study from and predict vast information units. It has shown the outstanding capacity to enhance tumor detection in scientific imaging, specifically identifying diffused abnormalities that human observers may ignore. This is completed through complicated neural networks that can examine scientific photographs at a pixel stage and examine intricate styles associated with exceptional kinds of tumors. One of the essential blessings of deep learning in tumor detection is its ability to appropriately section and classifies regions of hobby in medical picks, including suspicious loads or lesions. This facilitates radiologists in narrowing down their recognition and making more accurate diagnoses. Moreover, deep knowledge of algorithms can conform and improve with extra data, making them specifically beneficial when traditional photograph analysis techniques are insufficient.

articleTitle: An Examination of The PSO Algorithm’s Sensitivity For Estimating Solar Cell Parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Extracting parameters from photovoltaic cells poses a complex optimization challenge due to its inherent nonlinearity. This study investigates the sensitivity of the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm in estimating solar cell parameters. The evaluation assesses PSO’s exploitation and exploration capabilities, factoring in measurement errors. Performance is compared across six measurement error scenarios using metrics like convergence rate along with root mean square error (RMSE). It is very evident from the results that for case 2, the PSO algorithm achieves the lowest RMSE value of 0.02980, while it produces nearly identical RMSE values of 0.05040 and 0.04915 for cases 1 and 6. Simulation results clearly indicate that the PSO algorithm effectively handles measurement inaccuracies of 1% and 3%.

articleTitle: Predicting Blood Hemoglobin Level With Machine Learning And Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Anemia, a widespread health condition characterized by low hemoglobin or red blood cell levels, remains a significant global concern, especially in resource-limited settings. The current methods for diagnosing anemia often require invasive blood tests, which can be costly and inaccessible for routine monitoring. This study presents a Python-based model aimed at providing a non-invasive, automated method for anemia detection by analyzing the conjunctival region of the eye. Utilizing Haar cascade classifiers for precise eye region detection and OpenCV for image processing, the model efficiently extracts and analyzes the RGB values of the conjunctiva. These values are compared to established thresholds indicative of hemoglobin deficiency, allowing for a preliminary diagnosis. The model, trained and tested with real-world image data, offers a promising solution to early anemia detection, combining rapid processing, cost-effectiveness, and accessibility. The strength of this work lies in its automation, affordability, and potential for application in remote or underserved areas where traditional diagnostic methods are not readily available.

articleTitle: Automated Skin Disease Detection Using GoogLeNet and MobileNet to Enhance the Diagnostic Accuracy with Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Skin diseases affect human health through physical discomfort, emotional distress, and social stigma The high clinical variability and that the diagnostic procedures are subjective and may change over time make it difficult to detect accurately. This paper suggests applying CNN architectures, such as GoogLeNet and MobileNet, for automated detection. The stages involved include image gathering, preprocessing, selection and design of CNN models such as GoogLeNet and MobileNet, intensive training, evaluation, and deployment. The aim of this system is to help healthcare professionals make reliable diagnoses especially in areas where dermatologists are not accessible, thus allowing for more timely treatments.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Based Automated Ceiling Fan Cleaning System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Ceiling fans are commonly utilized devices that must be cleaned regularly to maintain their effectiveness and keep the environment clean. However, cleaning by oneself can be difficult and lengthy, and sometimes it might be dangerous due to the height required. To deal with this issue, an “Automated Ceiling Fan Cleaning System” that streamlines and automates the cleaning procedure while remaining cost-effective. The objective of this technology is to reduce the effort and time required to clean ceiling fans while minimizing the risks associated with hand cleaning. The system combines electrical and mechanical components with IoT integration, allowing wireless control by using Wi-Fi technology. The cleaning brush assembly can safely clean the fan blades by incorporating a linear motion mechanism controlled by an ESP32 microprocessor that receives user commands via Wi-Fi. The system uses essential tools and technologies such as the L298N motor driver, a DC motor for rotating movement, and a cleaning brush to ensure efficient dust removal. Testing shows a $\mathbf{6 0 \%}$ reduction in cleaning time compared to manual approaches and a 30% increase in dust removal efficiency. This work contributes to the field of home automation by delivering a user-friendly, remote-controlled cleaning solution that improves user convenience and safety.

articleTitle: Crop Yield Prediction using Systematic Review Process based Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Machine learning has become indispensable for predicting crop yields, significantly influencing crop selection and management strategies throughout the growing season. Extensive research has investigated various machine learning algorithms in this context. We conducted a systematic literature review (SLR) in order to compile and analyse the features and techniques used in these studies. A thorough search across six electronic databases identified 300 pertinent studies, of which 25 were meticulously selected for in-depth analysis according to specific inclusion and exclusion criteria. These studies were rigorously examined to assess the methodologies and features utilized, providing a foundation for future research recommendations. The analysis highlighted temperature, rainfall, and soil type as the most frequently used features in crop yield prediction, with one particular algorithm emerging as the most commonly applied. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) are the most common deep learning algorithms, followed by Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks and Deep Neural Networks (DNN), according to 25 pertinent publications found via a second search that concentrated on deep learning-based research.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Multimodal Ensemble Techniques for Detecting the Depression Level using Multitudinous Selective Features
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In this modern era, massive population of this world is falling prey to mental illness and psychological diseases rapidly along with other physical diseases. Among all, depressive disorder is becoming major challenging and serious psychological problem. Due to a lack of initial treatment options and resources for depression detection, millions of people struggle with mental illness. It is the primary cause of anxiety disorders, bipolar disorders, sleep disorders, depression, and occasionally, it can result in suicide and self-harm. As a result, recognition and prompt treatment of people experiencing mental health illness is an extremely difficult endeavour but it has paramount importance. The whole purpose of research is to propose deep learning-based model that primarily incorporates audio and textual aspects of patient answers to diagnose depression using the Extended Distress Analysis Corpus Wizard of OZ (EDAIC-WOZ) dataset. The inclination towards this work is to help psychologists and people with depressive symptoms with an accurate detection using artificial intelligence methods so that quick and timely remedial steps can be taken. The proposed model classifies the patients into two groups based on depression level such as the group of people with depressive disorder and others who doesn’t have such disorder by making use of speech spectral and temporal features and textual emotional analysis. This model uses the late fusion ensemble method implemented on the resultant of Audio CNN model and textual Bi-LSTM model. By using optimized methods for pulling out the textual and audio features, this work ensures that relevant characteristics of audio and text to be considered for the study. The conclusion of the research derived from the data set demonstrate the effectiveness of the model by complimenting the conventional diagnostic methods in screening the depression. The novel method is considered to be efficient and scalable solution to monitor the mental health based on depression level. Results reveal that the proposed model outperforms the other models with F1 score 0.98.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence using ANN on Legal Regulations in India: A Comprehensive Overview
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Background: More and more artificial intelligence (AI) has lately been applied in many various disciplines, including the legal one, to increase efficiency and decision-making. Objective: This paper looks at how Indian legal laws could be analysed and understood using artificial neural networks (ANN). Great numbers of statutes, precedents, and interpretations define India’s complex legal environment. Conventional manual legal document analysis is sometimes timeconsuming and prone to human error; so, automated methods that can provide more accurate and efficient analysis are much needed. Methodology: We developed a model utilising ANN to manage this challenge by analysing and classifying legal documents depending on their content, context, and application to particular regulatory systems. The method consists in tagged with domain-specific tags training a neural network on a large collection of legal documents comprising statutes, case laws, and legal commentary. Using modern optimisation techniques including dropout regularisation and backpropagation, the ANN model was modified to increase its generalising capacity. According to the results, accuracy and efficiency have greatly raised themselves as compared to more traditional methods. Results and Findings: In determining legal language, the ANN model achieved an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 2. 3 \%}$, a precision of $\mathbf{9 0. 1 \%}$, a recall of 91.7%, and an $F 1$ score of 90.9%. The model also cut the time required for legal document interpretation, by roughly 45% as compared to traditional methods. Conclusion: These findings demonstrate how fast and consistently artificial intelligence can grasp legal texts, hence transforming legal analysis and regulatory compliance in India.

articleTitle: Purity Unveiled: The Power of Ensemble Bagging in Water Quality
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Ensuring access to clean water is crucial for maintaining public health. Effective management of water resources and the reduction of pollution rely heavily on accurate predictions of water quality. Water quality can be assessed through various indicators, such as pH levels, dissolved oxygen, water clarity, and nutrient concentrations, which vary across different locations. Bagging classifiers, a widely used machine learning technique, are employed to enhance the accuracy and stability of predictive models for water quality. With the application of bagging classifiers, an accuracy of approximately 76% is anticipated. This approach demonstrates the effectiveness of ensemble learning methods in improving water quality prediction models. The proposed methods aim to optimize the assessment process for water quality, contributing to better environmental management and ensuring the availability of clean water for all communities.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Rice Quality Control: MobileNetV2 for Grain Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The classification of rice grains is a crucial aspect of the agricultural sector, particularly in light of challenges such as grain variability, limited computing resources, and the need for real-time processing. Maintaining quality control and increasing yield often rely on the efficient and accurate classification of rice grains. In this study, we explore the application of MobileNetV2, a deep learning model, for rice grain classification. Utilizing the advanced features of MobileNetV2, including linear bottlenecks and inverted residuals, we achieve an impressive accuracy rate of 99%. Despite the model’s effectiveness, we identify several challenges, including variability in grain appearance, constraints on computational resources, and the necessity for real-time processing. We demonstrate that the model remains robust and efficient under real-world conditions by employing strategies such as data augmentation, model tuning, and hardware acceleration to overcome these issues. Specifically, we enhance the model’s resilience to grain variability through data augmentation techniques, optimize the MobileNetV2 architecture for performance in resource-limited environments, and implement hardware acceleration to meet real-time processing requirements. Collectively, these strategies enable us to maintain a high accuracy rate of 99% in classifying rice grains.

articleTitle: Grandeur: A Lifestyle and Career Assistant Mobile Application with Career Prediction, Lifestyle Coach Search, Habit Tracker and Time Management Features
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A proper career guidance and lifestyle assistance system is critical for a person’s personal development, economic stability, and life quality improvement. Existing career and lifestyle research did not reveal an automated citizen assistant system with career prediction, lifestyle coach recommendation, habit tracker, time management recommendation, addiction, sleep, and eating disorder detection, vacation destination recommendation, lifestyle product search, health specialist search, successful career step recommendation, and productivity increase tips. To bridle the current shortcomings, this paper contributes a career and lifestyle assistant mobile application that includes citizen aspiration-based future career suggestions, career helper course search, coach search, addiction issue, eating and sleeping disorder detection, vacation place recommendation, lifestyle product purchase facilities, health specialist contact, habit tracker, recreation item search, and time management features. The proposed lifestyle and career assistant application usability analysis revealed that at least 69% of citizens dispatched applaudable remarks about app’s strength and necessity.

articleTitle: Explainable Artificial Intelligence for brain Tumor Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: As per the growing concern of Brain Tumor diagnosis a model is introduced namely tumor NET XAI, for advantages for enhance efficiency in brain tumor detection this Framework builds on a different data set such as MRI scans which also consists of data cleaning, augmentations and normalization for ensuring quality Normalisation for ensuring quality the ideas about to combining CNNs with random forest for feature extraction and SVM classifiers, models uses IFAV (SHAP, GRAD-CAM and LIME) for understanding it more specifically. It also helps clinicians for better understanding the influences predictions. This approach aims in enhancing to accuracy of Diagnostic field and also clinicians trust in brain tumor detection thoroughly.

articleTitle: Recent Innovations in Patch Antenna Technology for Wearable Biomedical Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The design of different wearable antennas for WBAN communication systems has become a vital activity in the advancement of biomedical applications. These antennas need to be optimized for gain, efficiency, bandwidth, and directivity when mounted close to a human body. It is hard to achieve high performance because the size must be in compact form and bandwidth is limited, and besides, the human body has lossy tissue characteristics due to their high permittivity and conductivity values. In this work, various patch antenna designs will be pursued by comparing performances related to different shapes and configurations. This paper also discusses the inclusion of AMC structures in order to avoid losses in radiation efficiency when operating in proximity to the human body, and it shows how AMC-backed antennas improve their gain and stability. By analyzing split-ring resonator-based AMC designs, this work falls into a new perspective for improving the robustness and efficiency of low-profile antennas in biomedical applications and provides new insights into improved WBAN communication reliability and antenna performance in bodycentric wireless communication environments.

articleTitle: Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence for Improving Employee Retention Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Background: Predictive Decision Support Systems (PDSS) should be highly important if companies wish to preserve a competitive edge over their competitors. On the other hand, human resource professionals are not always able to project based on the statistics under their influence what employees expect. Problem statement: This research intends to address a gap in the body of present information by suggesting novel strategies for employee members to be equipped for occupations in the digital age. One can create a system that forecasts future employee performance needs by aggregating the most current machine-learning approaches with personal data. Real data from many spheres is applied to determine whether the process is efficient and advantageous. Objective: With a novel PDSS technique, Deep Random Forest (DRF), this work attempts to extract currently available data. This research tries to explain how DRF could be able to manage future employment demands by means of an analysis of different datasets including those related to workers hired by the government, companies, and items based on technology. Findings: In terms of accuracy and scalability, the DRF method performs better than numerous other presumably more conventional ways. Human resource professionals can thus utilise this information to direct choices on the design of the digital workforce.

articleTitle: A Neural Approach to Mental Health: LSTM RNNs for Depression Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Depression is a common mental health condition affecting both developed and developing nations, but it is often challenging to diagnose accurately and promptly. Traditional diagnostic methods can be time-consuming and may lead to delays in providing necessary treatment. This study addresses the need for a reliable and efficient machine learning approach to detect depression. It explores the use of deep learning techniques, specifically long-short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural networks (RNN), for identifying signs of depression. After extensive testing, the algorithm demonstrated a remarkable 96% accuracy in detecting depressive symptoms from text data. This research presents an effective approach for depression detection using LSTM RNNs, which excel at identifying temporal patterns in sequential data. The proposed model offers timely assistance and intervention for individuals at risk while also contributing to mental health research, thanks to its high accuracy and potential for improving mental health outcomes.

articleTitle: A YOLO-Based Aerial Monitoring System for Detecting Waste in Water Bodies
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Being a significant environmental issue Water Pollution impacts marine ecosystem and human health as well. Traditional Methods of monitoring water pollution are often time-consuming and labor-intensive. To overcome these problems, an innovative waste detection system for water bodies using aerial images is presented, which employs the YOLO (You Only Look Once) algorithm, that is known for its strength in object detection, made it a subtle choice and resulted in 96% of accuracy. YOLO’s real-time object detection capabilities enable the identification of different waste materials in aerial images with high precision. A User Interface is also made to provide interaction medium. By providing accurate and timely data on waste in water bodies, the system represents a significant advancement in pollution monitoring and improves aquatic environmental health.

articleTitle: Tweeting the Market: Leveraging LSTM for Stock Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Investors and traders constantly seek an edge, a source of insight that can help them predict market movements more accurately. Over the past several years, the emergence of social media and the increase in use of platforms such as Twitter, Facebook, etc. has given birth to a new dimension of market analysis - sentiment analysis and its potential effect on stock prices. The mood dimensions that correlate with market movements can be complex and multifaceted. Only a few researches have studied the effect of social media on stock price predictions. Prior investigations have examined discussions surrounding the COVID-19 virus, its societal repercussions, and its potential sway over financial markets. This research has specifically scrutinized the effect of negative sentiments and their potential repercussions on stock prices of major tech companies like Microsoft, Google, and Tesla. The paper aims to identify the most effective model among ARIMA and LSTM for predicting stock prices by correlating them with sentiments expressed in social media posts. The motive of this paper is to help investors better analyze the market and adjust their strategies accordingly to earn more profits.

articleTitle: Impact of Orthogonal Multiple Access and Non Orthogonal Multiple Access for the Performance of IRS-Aided Downlink Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The rapid expansion of communicating devices has brought with a need of higher capacity, low latency wireless communication systems. Which has led to interest in advanced multiple access techniques such as NOMA. The NOMA technique allows multiple users to transmit over the same channel using power-domain multiplexing and SIC approach. This allows for an increase inconnectivity and spectral efficiency over traditional OMA. However, NOMA suffers from inter-user interference and a decline in performance in multipath environments. In order to eliminate such constraints, IRS emerged as a potential solution. This paper examines, how the IRS can be applied in conjunction with NOMA. Specifically, what effect does it have on user data rates. The Simulation is done for the cases of direct NOMA, IRS-Aided NOMA and OMA with varying number of Reflecting Elements. The results show improvements in data rates, in comparison with conventional NOMA and OMA schemes. Simulation also shows improvement in data rates with increase in Reflecting Elements. Moreover, this paper outlines some crucial research gaps and future directions.

articleTitle: Analysis of a Single-Grade Workforce Using Stochastic Methods with Correlated Egress Clusters and Two Factors Defining Breakdown Points
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This research investigates the challenge of optimizing recruitment timing in a single-grade workforce system that experiences reductions in personnel due to either employee departures or breaks. Employee exits, occurring in random clusters, are modeled using a compound process, with each cluster’s workforce loss represented by exchangeable, exponentially correlated random variables. Break-related exits are classified by the intensity of attrition and modeled as independent and identically distributed hyper exponential random variables. Threshold of breakdown is split into two components: exits and breaks. The paper proposes two stochastic models: Model 1, where all exits are treated uniformly, and Model 2, which differentiates exits into voluntary and involuntary categories. The study applies the univariate CUM recruitment policy to calculate the mean and variance of recruitment time. Using Matlab, numerical illustrations are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed models. The research also explores how different nodal parameters influence key system characteristics, yielding insights into the dynamics of recruitment timing. A major contribution of this work lies in the development of two comprehensive stochastic models that account for both voluntary and involuntary exits, providing a more nuanced understanding of workforce attrition. The use of statistical analysis and Matlab simulations strengthens the findings, offering practical applications for optimizing workforce management strategies in dynamic environments. This study provides a foundation for future exploration into more sophisticated recruitment policies, potentially incorporating AI/ML and deep learning techniques. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification: 60H30, 90B70, 91D35.

articleTitle: Nanotechnology in Biomedical Image Processing Using Ensemble Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Correct identification of the most recent case of pneumonia fever determines successful therapy and management of the condition. Computable tomography (CT) scans can rapidly and precisely classify and evaluate cases of pneumonia fever. Almost every hospital has chest CT scanning available, which lets one rapidly classify pneumonia fever sufferers. Considering the great availability of chest CT imaging, this seems reasonable. The chest CT-based pneumonia fever categorization requires a lot of time with fast spreading infections. Medical staff workers should be able to gain from automated CT scan analysis considering their busy schedules. In the framework of this work, we build a feature extraction and classification system leveraging CT scan inputs. Part of the framework’s training and testing courses is teaching the classifier—in charge of creating a model that exactly classifies entering CT images. This module among others makes up the framework. The classifier in this work is convolutional neural network (CNN) variants. The performance of the present model is evaluated by the simulation; the results show that the suggested method achieves better accuracy than any other classifications.

articleTitle: Signal Processing Techniques for Enhanced Wireless Network Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: With increasing complexity and data rates of wireless communication networks, an effective signal processing technique is significantly required. Memoryless predistortion techniques undoubtedly help to minimise nonlinear distortions in RF power amplifiers. This is so because they guarantee high amplifier output. Methodology: This paper presents a new multichannel wireless signal processing technique to give wireless communication systems memoryless predistortion. The predistortion approach is efficiently applied over numerous channels using wireless signal processing resources. This method lets run in real time with minimum unnecessary hardware overhead. Findings: The experiments reveal that the method based on wireless signal processing is an effective approach for correcting for nonlinear distortions developing in RF power amplifiers.

articleTitle: Advanced Robotics and AI in Manufacturing: Enhancing Efficiency and Precision
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The main purpose of this research work is to manage the workflow in a cloud environment by utilising the Manufacturing Sector (MFS) model along with the integration of a Deep Learning technique known as the Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) algorithm. The LSTM helps to utilize a cloud computing environment to regulate the forecast of future workloads and to supply the resources that are required to consistently maintain a balanced workflow. The input data collection rates collected by robotics devices serve as the foundation for all projections. The data that is input is either stored or processed by virtual machines, which are located in a cloud environment. It is possible that the robotics devices that were utilised in the testing were the same or different. When compared to other deep learning and MFS schedulers, the results of the simulation demonstrate that the MFS-LSTM model is significantly more effective than anything else. The findings indicate that the MFS-LSTM is capable of achieving superior processing capabilities while simultaneously spending less energy and reacting to tasks in a more expedient manner.

articleTitle: Developing an Advanced Tool for Transforming Spreadsheet Data into Interactive Dashboards with Predictive Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In today’s data-driven world, organizations face the challenge of managing vast datasets. This work centres on developing an advanced tool to streamline the conversion of spreadsheet data into interactive dashboards with predictive insights. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies, the tool enables seamless data visualization and analytics, empowering users to extract meaningful insights. With integrated predictive modelling, it enhances decision-making, making it invaluable for professionals seeking efficient data-driven solutions. The tool not only visualizes data dynamically but also predicts future trends through sophisticated algorithms and machine learning. By uncovering hidden patterns, it deepens users’ understanding of data dynamics. Additionally, this research meets the growing demand for intuitive, user-friendly data analytics interfaces. The tool’s design ensures accessibility for users with varying technical skills, while interactive dashboards boost engagement and allow real-time exploration of complex datasets.

articleTitle: Wine Quality Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: As wine tops as one of the most consumed beverages in the world, there have been several studies on improving wine quality over the years. Our paper aims to enhance the predictive accuracy of wine quality certification by leveraging the UCI Red Wine Quality dataset and various machine learning models: Support Vector Classifier, Random Forest, Decision Tree Classifier, and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN). Through meticulous feature selection, key attributes affecting wine quality were identified. Our analysis revealed significant performance metrics across the models, highlighting the potential of machine learning in optimizing wine quality assessments. This data-driven approach underscores its efficacy in enhancing the precision and reliability of wine quality predictions.

articleTitle: Calibration and Testing of Flexi-force Sensor for IoT-enabled Rehabilitation Glove
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The current developments in smart sensor technologies provide the foundation for industry growth and boost any nation’s economy. A smart sensor can be used as a high-precision measuring device in a large range of potential use cases like a smart biosensor can be used for monitoring patient health, diagnose disease, provide personalised therapy etc. To keep ideal levels of precision, smart sensor calibration with specific digital or electronic standards is required. The fundamental principles of building a robust National Quality Infrastructure (NQI) in any nation are calibration, standardization, accreditation and testing. In this study, five smart sensor flexi-force sensor calibrated under the use-case of developing an Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled rehabilitation glove for patients. The flexi-force sensors, effectively measures patient gripping strength at certain level of strength between 0 to 4.4lb. NIIRT performs the calibration of flexi-force sensors at lab with NABL accreditation adheres to stringent guidelines which employ cutting-edge machinery to guarantee accurate calibration outcomes report in India. According to the report, the calibration process demonstrated high precision with an accuracy of ±3 and an uncertainty of ±1. These results confirm the reliability and suitability of the flexi-force sensors for use in developing rehabilitation gloves, enhancing their potential for real-time healthcare applications.

articleTitle: Transforming Oral Cancer Care with Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This research focuses on the application of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to develop a system for detecting oral cancer from tissue images. The system is designed to enhance the speed and accuracy of detection. While traditional diagnostic methods are effective, they are often timeconsuming and require expert interpretation, which can delay the early detection of critical health conditions. Early detection of oral cancer remains a significant global health challenge. The CNN model was trained on a dataset containing both cancerous and non-cancerous tissue images. The model demonstrated strong learning performance with a training loss of 0.5042 and a training accuracy of $\mathbf{9 4. 4 1 \%}$. The validation process yielded similarly promising results, with a validation loss of 0.5030 and a validation accuracy of $\mathbf{9 4. 7 4 \%}$. Upon testing with unseen data, the model achieved a loss of 0.6893 and a test accuracy of $\mathbf{9 2. 1 7 \%}$. These results confirm that CNNs are highly effective in identifying oral cancer from tissue images, enhancing both the accuracy and efficiency of the detection process. The model’s high performance in training, validation, and testing indicates its potential to reliably identify cancerous tissue, which would assist pathologists in making rapid and accurate diagnoses. The improved diagnostic speed and accuracy have the potential to significantly benefit patients by enabling faster identification and treatment of oral cancer.

articleTitle: Sarcasm Detection in English-Hindi Code-Mixed Text Data
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Sarcasm-also termed as verbal irony, when the speaker presents something in a mocking or humorous way such that he or she actually conveys the opposite of what they seem to say. This article has a detailed analysis of sarcasm detection in English-Hindi code-mixed texts based on the difficulties one faces while identifying sarcasm in linguistically complex data. Several machine learning and deep learning methods are adopted and compared, Long Short-Term Memory, Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers, and Support Vector Machines are some of them. In addition, the complexity in the detection of sarcasm is further compounded by the nuance of code-mixed language because the former does not have any tradition that can be adapted to traditional text classification methods. Feature extraction and the subsequent decision-making processes are also factored with broader implications for sentiment analysis. The results of the models analysed underwent a comparative analysis, which showed that the model produced out of the combination of BERT and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) surpasses other models to be used for this particular task with its detection accuracy rate, said to be the best in determining sarcasm.

articleTitle: Recent Advancements in Machine Learning Techniques for Breast Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Emerging critical illnesses pose substantial problems, including breast cancer, which can be efficiently treated if found early. Many instances of breast cancer are managed through early discovery, which reduces the death rate. There is a lot of technological innovation going on around the world. This technology can be used to diagnose diseases more accurately and in less time. Machine learning is one of the most utilized techniques in this field. This research aims to analyze and review numerous significant research articles released in recent times. This research has evaluated the available literature, classified the various Machine Learning approaches, and examined their performance measures. It also examines the used datasets, feature extraction methods, and assessment measures. It examines and discusses various recent machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models developed for breast cancer detection. It evaluates these models using critical metrics such as accuracy, specificity, sensitivity, F-score, precision, and recall. Further, it explains the importance of these investigations, providing insights for future study prospects.

articleTitle: Predictive Maintenance in Autonomous Vehicles Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Predictive maintenance is revolutionizing the management of autonomous vehicles by proactively addressing potential component failures before they occur. This paper presents a predictive maintenance approach using machine learning algorithms to anticipate potential vehicle component failures. By analyzing sensor data, this study aims to reduce vehicle downtime and maintenance costs. The implemented methods include data preprocessing, feature selection, and model training through machine learning techniques such as neural networks and regression models. The results indicate significant accuracy in predicting component failures, supporting proactive maintenance strategies. This study’s findings highlight the model’s potential to enhance operational efficiency in autonomous vehicle systems. Future work may focus on optimizing predictive algorithms to accommodate real-time data processing in dynamic driving environments. These advancements promise to further enhance the capabilities of predictive maintenance systems, ensuring the continued reliability and efficiency of autonomous vehicles.

articleTitle: Rapid Response Drones: UAV-Based Healthcare Delivery for Critical Situations
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Rapid response drones have the potential to be a game-changer for delivering healthcare during crucial moments due to both the time-sensitive nature of primary health services and the high delays and costs involved in land and air ambulances. In remote or disaster-affected regions, timely medical intervention will be severely limited by the dearth of immediate response time, which can take up to 2 hours with existing systems. The paper introduces a novel unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-assisted healthcare delivery system, which aims to deliver healthcare products swiftly and reliably—combining a modular architecture with free video surveillance, autonomous flight controls, real-time delivery slot optimization in urban and rural environments and real-time video surveillance to deliver medical supplies 5-15 minutes. The improvements in response times, carbon emissions, noise levels, and delivery accuracy were found to be significant -95% for the former and $\mathbf{8 0 \%}$ and $\mathbf{8 5 \%}$, respectively for existing systems, but had been only tested in simulation. The results reflect the UAV systems ability to improve operational efficiency and expedite sustainability, offering an option for emergency medical logistics.

articleTitle: Prediction of Software Defects for Quality Assurance and Improvement Based on Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Software defect prediction (SDP) is increasingly vital in today’s software development landscape, where delivering high-quality products on time is essential. Defects in software can lead to significant financial losses and damage to reputations; hence, identifying error-prone modules early in the development lifecycle is crucial. This research aims to leverage machine learning (ML) models to enhance software quality and minimize testing costs. This methodology begins with data collection from the CM1 dataset in the PROMISE repository, followed by comprehensive preprocessing steps, including addressing missing values, removing duplicate entries, and detecting outliers. Feature selection and Z-score normalization further refine the dataset. Then, implement a variety of ML algorithms-Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Naïve Bayes (NB), RF, and ANN-to evaluate their efficacy in SDP. Performance metrics such as precision, recall, accuracy, and F1score are employed for assessment. These findings indicate that XGBoost achieves the highest accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8 \%}$, outperforming other models. This study makes a substantial contribution to software engineering by showing how ML approaches may improve software quality assurance procedures and by giving practitioners practical insights to build defect prediction systems.

articleTitle: SMART UI: Crop Classification in Karnataka Nippani Using Ensemble Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This study helped in enhancing agricultural management, predicting yields, tracking crop health which are all dependent on accurate crop classification. But the conventional methods are labor intensive and time consuming. The goal of this study is to automate crop classification system that uses machine learning and satellite image to accurately classify the crops. Ground Truth data is gathered from data.gov.in website and Random Forest classifier is used to train on data. To be more accurate the algorithm is verified using dataset from specific regions. The Random Forest effectively classified crops with an accuracy of $79 \%$. The outcome shows how well crop classification works when used with machine learning and satellite image together. This study provides scalable algorithm for crop classification, which helps in various agricultural related works like crop health. The future studies should investigate alternative use of real-time data for dynamic classification.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Segmentation in the Marine Atmosphere for Time-Sensitive Contextualisation using Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The work investigates autonomous surface vehicle obstacle avoidance and detection using computer vision techniques. It recognizes boundaries in marine environments by using the temporal context from video feeds from unmanned surface vehicles. The study shows how successful LSTM cells are in the CNN topologies that are currently in use, emphasizing how they might perform better. Nevertheless, datasets and network training techniques are not perfect. The work also uses a benchmarking approach to compare new network configurations.

articleTitle: Enhancing Network Security in Cloud-Integrated IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Rapid growth in the Internet of Things (IoT) in cloud-integrated environments has exposed all critical areas for security vulnerabilities, characterized by increasingly sophisticated cyber threats and complex attack surfaces. Current security frameworks demonstrate fundamental inadequacies in providing protection across heterogeneous technological ecosystems. The research addresses the needs discussed by developing an innovative three-tier security architecture with blockchain authentication, federated deep learning, and adaptive encryption protocols.
