There is an overall objective to enhance network security through a dynamic, scalable framework capable of mitigating contemporary and emerging cyber threats. Experimental validation across 1,500 IoT nodes exhibits impressive performance improvements: 94% fewer unauthorized access attempts, 89% threat detection accuracy, and 76% incident response latency reduction. Such improvements are achieved with minimal computational overhead of 12% due to the proposed architecture. This work is expected to make a significant contribution in the area of cybersecurity research and technological innovation toward a comprehensive blueprint for next-generation security solutions, providing a robust data-driven methodology in securing distributed IoT infrastructures.

articleTitle: Leveraging Deep Learning for Medicinal Plant Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Medicinal Plants are the backbone of Indian Ayurveda and herbal treatments. However, the correct recognition of medicinal plants is essential for their safe and effective use. Traditional methods rely heavily on the expertise of Vaidya’s (Ayurveda practitioners) and herbalists, whose extensive knowledge base can be a tedious task to acquire and error-prone. Additionally, with the growing popularity of herbal remedies, the demand for proper identification methods is escalating. The proposed model builds a robust model based on deep learning for identification of medicinal plants through image processing. It outlines methods involved in data collection, preprocessing, feature extraction, selection, training, and evaluation. The model targets to classify 30 species of medicinal plants with almost 500 images of each species based on plant leaves. The model enables users to easily and accurately identify plants and access information about their medicinal properties and uses. The model has received accuracy of 94 % for testing and 98 % for training data, with improvements observed at different epochs. Model selection focuses on optimizing architectures and hyper parameters through cross-validation and grid search. Training of models is done on the annotated datasets. This work explores the potential of capturing plant images and leveraging algorithms that perform processing of images to draw out key features such as edges, textures, and colors from the image. They might detect parts of the leaf, like veins, shapes, or patterns specific to certain plant types. These features will then be harnessed to train an ML model, empowering it to recognize unknown medicinal plants from new image inputs. By automating the identification process, this research aims to bridge the gap in accessibility and contribute to a more efficient and reliable way of harnessing the power of nature’s medicinal bounty.

articleTitle: Intelligent E-Commerce Chatbot for Personalized Product Recommendations Using Text Mining and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Innovative technology solutions have been developed in response to the growing need for effective and customized client contact on e-commerce platforms. This work introduces an intelligent chatbot system that uses machine learning and text mining techniques to improve user satisfaction and answer customer concerns. Advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) models have been trained on large datasets, allowing for precise user intent interpretation and pertinent product recommendations. A strong recommendation engine is included into the system architecture to aid in decision-making, ultimately enhancing the customer experience by providing individualized, real-time help. The study also highlights the significance of data privacy by using privacy-preserving techniques to safeguard user data. The system’s scalability and performance benefits are highlighted through thorough comparisons with current models. By showcasing the useful uses of machine learning and text mining in enhancing customer contact and service delivery, this study makes a substantial contribution to the development of AI-driven solutions in e-commerce.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Counterfeit Currency Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Counterfeit currency detection is a critical issue posing significant challenges to economies worldwide. Traditional methods relying on manual inspection are prone to error and inefficiency. To enhance detection accuracy, this study explores advanced machine learning techniques, specifically Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models. Existing SVM models struggle with large-scale datasets, and CNN models require extensive training data. There is also a lack of diversity in counterfeit samples and limited use of augmented data in existing datasets. This research compares SVM and CNN models in identifying counterfeit ₹500 Indian banknotes. Using a dataset of genuine and counterfeit notes, features were extracted with a Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) for SVM. ResNet50 architecture was used for CNN. The dataset was augmented to improve robustness. The CNN model achieved training and validation accuracy, while the SVM model also reached high accuracy. These results highlight the potential of both models in providing accurate and automated counterfeit detection, demonstrating their effectiveness and reliability in this application.

articleTitle: A Computational Analysis of Optimization Techniques to Solve Assignment Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the field of combinatorial optimization, numerous methods have been developed to address complex problems, including assignment, scheduling, and resource allocation. This paper presents a comparative analysis of seven prominent optimization techniques: Hungarian Algorithm, Greedy Algorithm, Auction Algorithm, Linear Programming, Genetic Algorithm, Simulated Annealing, and Constraint Programming. We evaluate these methods on computational efficiency, scalability, and practical applicability, focusing on assignment problems. The analysis reveals that Hungarian Algorithm, Linear Programming, and Constraint Programming consistently deliver high accuracy across all matrix sizes, making them ideal for scenarios where solution precision is paramount. Conversely, the Greedy Algorithm excels in speed on smaller matrices but suffers from significant time and accuracy issues as matrix size increases. Additionally, while both Constraint Programming and Genetic Algorithm achieve high accuracy, their execution times rise considerably with matrix size, especially for Genetic Algorithm, which becomes impractical for large-scale problems. Thus, Hungarian Algorithm, Linear Programming, and Constraint Programming are optimal for accuracy-focused tasks, while Greedy Algorithm is preferable for smaller, speed-critical cases.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Super-Resolution and Denoising: Refining Medical Image quality and Diagnostic Textual
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: One of the promising recent advances in medical imaging is indeed the successful exploration of GANs for applications such as image super-resolution and text enhancement. Most GAN-based approaches, however, have been driven for a single modality: enhancing the quality of images or text clarity-while simultaneously eliciting little attention towards the two interrelated aspects. A new dual- GAN framework is therefore proposed to overcome this limitation by combining the merits of both Image Super- Resolution GAN and Text Enhancement GAN. In this merged approach, both the resolution of images and the adequacy of the textual annotation improved to enhance diagnostic accuracy as well as improve the visualization of small lesions and tissue structures in medical images. The system works on the principle of cross-domain benefit sharing; enhancement in either quality, the image, or the text, naturally boosts the quality of the other. The performance of the proposed dual-GAN system is measured through some key metrics, such as Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) and Optical Character Recognition (OCR) accuracy to provide clear evidence of significant improvement in both image and text qualities as compared with other conventional methods. This innovation improves the process of clinical decision-making in the sense that clearer images and text are more accurate. The approach has tremendous potential for much wider practical applications: document scanning, surveillance, astronomy, and microscopy-all applications where textual and visual clarity are important for precision and analysis.

articleTitle: Next-Gen Marketing: Influencers Driving Post-Purchase Satisfaction Through AR Engagement
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This study explores the combined impact of augmented reality (AR) and influencer marketing on post-purchase satisfaction and loyalty in the Indian beauty industry. With the market poised to reach USD 25 billion by 2025, AR and influencers play a pivotal role in creating personalized and immersive shopping experiences. Using Situated Cognition Theory, the research examines how AR engagement and influencer credibility influence consumer behavior, focusing on shopper engagement as a mediator. Data from 282 respondents with prior AR shopping experience show that perceived usefulness of AR and influencer authenticity significantly enhance shopper engagement, which in turn drives post-purchase satisfaction and brand loyalty. The findings highlight the importance of interactive, context-rich AR experiences and trustworthy influencers in building long-term customer relationships. Additionally, the study identifies potential challenges, such as AR and influencer fatigue, and calls for innovative strategies to maintain consumer interest. These insights provide valuable guidance for marketers, AR developers, and influencers aiming to create more engaging and satisfying shopping experiences.

articleTitle: Leveraging Big Data-Driven Strategies for Sustainable Supply Chain Management in Manufacturing firms
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the last decade, the Sustainable Supply Chain Management (SSCM) in manufacturing firms has been greatly improved with the integration of Big Data-Driven Strategies (BDS). Considering manufacturing sustainability goals, its application in supply chain operations is underexplored, but it provides transformational insights into supply chain operations that allow firms to optimally utilize resources, predict disruptions and minimize environmental footprint. The objective of this paper is to determine the integration of the big data driven strategies to make the sustainable supply chain management (SSCM) within manufacturing companies more effective as the need for environmentally and economically efficient operation is increasing due to rapid technological progress. As SSCM is becoming more vital to the manufacturing industry, this research explores the utilization of big data analytics (BDA) for resource usage optimization, disruption prediction and reduced environmental impact, in line with global sustainability objectives. Five main criteria and 16 sub criteria important for BDA implementation on SSCM have been considered for the purpose of enhancing operational efficiency, resource optimization and transparency in supply chain. The research also identifies key gaps in the literature, including in the use of BDA to meet specific manufacturing sustainability goals such as carbon reduction, waste management and resource efficiency. The techniques of these gaps are needed to fill, to suggest BDA frameworks tailored to the industry in accordance with the sustainability targets. The findings of the research propose a comprehensive framework for manufacturing firms to make BDA-driven SSCM strategy environmentally and economically competitive. Nevertheless, empirical research is still required to confirm how these frameworks work in actual industry applications and to further develop solutions adapted to the requirements of individual industries. Future research should include development of data governance protocol, exploring advanced AI and ML technologies, and assessing long term implication of BDA for sustainability by longitudinal studies. This paper offers a foundation for use of big data to enhance SSCM practices as well as overlooked gaps and pathways to accelerate future sustainable manufacturing practices.

articleTitle: Harnessing Artificial Intelligence: Redefining Credit Risk Management for Banks in India
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In recent times, Artificial Intelligence (AI) is adopted in Indian banking sector in areas such as customer lending services, fraud risk and credit risk management. However, AI usage in banks face issues with respect to lack of governance and business strategy, along with fragmented IT systems, sub-optimal core technology, outdated operating models, lack of strategy in talent management, which are the core challenges in Indian banking system for AI adoption. Indian banks have augmented application of AI in varied scales but has no uniformity is its usage. Historical data, statistical models, and expert judgment gave the framework for credit risk assessment. With the introduction of Artificial Intelligence, Credit risk has become an important component of banking risk. In the wake of this scenario, the present study attempts to explore how Indian banks are using AL & ML in their credit risk management practices. The objective of the paper is to identify the various purposes of the use of AI in Indian banks. The study used secondary data sources of select Indian commercial banks to highlight the potential usage of AI and the findings reveal that banks are at different stages of employing AI-based technological applications in credit risk management. Banks encounter challenges such as, lack of governance drive for AI and ML adoption and majorly fail to disclose their annual budget plans for AI and ML. Valuable insights have been evolved through this study that would help the banks, policy makers, government and customers at large to understand the current status of the use of AI, its applications, challenges and opportunities proving that there is a need for quality checks on the data used by banks and rationalization of AI models through a technical certification process.

articleTitle: Measuring E Customer Satisfaction in Online Retail A Comparative Analysis Using Various ML Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Maintaining competitive advantage in the often-shifting arena of online retail increasingly rests on knowing and increasing consumer happiness. As online buying becoming increasingly frequent, retail companies are drowning in massive amounts of consumer feedback data. Maximizing service offerings and enhancing user experience depend on knowledge of consumer satisfaction derived from this data. This paper looks at how different ML methods could fairly assess consumer feedback and project degrees of satisfaction. The primary challenge is exactly gauging consumer happiness from unstructured input data. Two areas where conventional methods frequently fall short are scalability and accuracy. This work underlines consumer input into satisfaction categories by means of RF, NB, and SVM algorithms under evaluation and comparison, thereby addressing this challenge. The study makes use of a dataset comprising consumer reviews and satisfaction evaluations from numerous online retail stores. First treated for missing values, the data is normalized for uniformity. For the RF, NB, and SVM algorithms, this dataset drives testing and training. Accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and other criteria evaluate every approach. RF achieves an accuracy of $\mathbf{8 5 \%}$, NB $\mathbf{7 8 \%}$, and SVM 82% according to preliminary numerical results. RF performs superior in terms of precision and recall especially in handling biassed datasets. Although SVM also performs pretty well, it is rather less good than RF in differentiating between closely related levels of pleasure.

articleTitle: Innovative Hosting with Hoster: Integrating AWS Services, Docker, and Real-Time Data for Scalable Deployment
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The increasing complexity of deploying modern web applications necessitates automated solutions to reduce manual intervention and ensure seamless deployment. Hoster is an automated hosting solution designed with the objective of simplifying the process of launching web applications directly from GitHub repositories. Motivated by the challenges developers face in manual deployment, such as error-prone processes and inefficiencies, Hoster utilizes a robust backend architecture that combines Redis, Docker, AWS services, and Node.js to streamline cloning, building, and hosting projects. To effectively handle and route client requests, the platform's architecture includes a RESTful API server, a Dockerized build server, and a unique reverse proxy. Redis and Socket.io facilitate real-time communication and log tracking, guaranteeing openness and timely feedback throughout deployment. This study examines the strength of the proposed solution, focusing on its scalability, security, and dependability in contemporary web development. Additionally, it delves into Hoster’s design, implementation, and performance. The findings demonstrate Hoster's significant contributions to deployment automation, scalability, and resource optimization, offering substantial implications for real-world applications, particularly in DevOps practices.

articleTitle: Design based Retrieval Augmented Generation Oriented Education Chatbot: Edubot
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Chatbot, a system which focuses on utilizing advanced natural language processing (NLP) techniques. This research aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of Chatbot, including its background, evolution and future application, with the focus mainly on its impact on education. The landscape of scientific research has been transformed by artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning. This research explores OpenAI’s chatbot, which leverages advanced techniques in Natural Language Processing (NLP), Supervised Learning, and Reinforcement Learning to understand and generate text that closely resembles human-written content. As per state-of-art, an interface has been developed along with dataset creation. A small level BOT that would use a self-made database on Pinecone which has been integrated into it. The interface will take the queries from the user and provide a suitable and accurate answer by using the RAG & LLM algorithm.

articleTitle: Adaptive Tutoring Systems: Crafting Personalized Learning Experiences
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The rapid advancement of educational technology has spurred the development of Adaptive Tutoring Systems (ATS) to meet the growing demand for personalized learning in digital environments. This paper introduces the Personalized Adaptive Learning Recommendation System (PALRS), a novel framework designed to enhance learner engagement and performance by delivering customized learning experiences. The system integrates deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms to recommend not only individual courses but also complete learning paths tailored to students’ preferences, learning styles, and real-time progress. Through continuous learner interaction, PALRS refines its recommendations, optimizing the educational journey to suit each user’s needs. The primary objective is to address the limitations of traditional one-size-fits-all learning systems by offering a dynamic, adaptive solution that evolves with the learner. In real-world experiments involving 500 students, PALRS demonstrated a 30% improvement in learning outcomes and a 25% increase in user satisfaction compared to non-adaptive systems. Additionally, learners using PALRS completed courses 15% faster, with a higher retention of knowledge. These findings underscore the potential of PALRS to revolutionize digital education by providing context-aware, data-driven learning experiences. Contributions include (1) the design and implementation of a robust adaptive recommendation system using DRL, (2) a detailed evaluation of its effectiveness in improving learner outcomes, and (3) insights into the scalability of such systems across diverse educational platforms. These results confirm the efficacy of PALRS in delivering highly personalized, efficient, and engaging learning experiences.

articleTitle: A Transformative Impact of IoT and AI by Predictive Analytics on Modern Marketing Strategies: A Study of its Significance & Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: As we are passing through a period of monumental significance with the fusion of IoTs and AI having a profound and transformative impact on various aspects of human activities, this paper develops a model for investigating and measuring the significance of the transformative impact of predictive analytics via AI on modern marketing strategies using IoTs, particularly in the retail industry. The model examines the relationship between predictive factors and the efficacy of changes in marketing strategies through the expansion of product offerings by quantifying the increase in customer purchases and spending, enhancing consumer attraction, and improving the shopping experience and retailer loyalty. The accuracy of the predictive transformations has the potential to outsource products and increase market share without investment in external spaces. The accuracy of the parsimonious mathematical model reconciles real-world qualitative and quantitative behavioral gaps in old and adopted marketing strategies by severity of values, providing more valuable extensions as our understanding of the relationship improves. Also This study provides evidence of the advantageous nature of IoT and AI marketing strategies. Progress in predictive analytics enhances the effectiveness and personalisation of marketing. These pieces of information can be utilised by companies to enhance their return on investment (ROI), increase consumer engagement, and improve their marketing efforts. The report also emphasises significant obstacles and constraints, providing practitioners with an impartial perspective on the deployment of IoT and AI.

articleTitle: Integrating Robotic Process Automation (RPA) with AI and ML for Efficient Banking Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Integrating robotic method automation (RPA) with artificial intelligence (AI) and device getting to know (ML) has revolutionized the banking enterprise, permitting extra green and correct operations. RPA technology automates repetitive responsibilities, even as $\mathbf{A I}$ algorithms offer sensible selection-making competencies, and ML algorithms constantly learn and enhance from statistics. Collectively, they create a powerful synergy that improves client reports, reduces fees, and streamlines techniques. RPA can deal with high-quantity, rule-based duties, which include statistics entry and report processing, liberating human employees to focus on greater complicated and price-added sports. AI and ML can analyze significant amounts of information and offer valuable insights for fraud detection, danger evaluation, and customized guidelines for clients. This integration saves time, reduces blunders charges, and allows for better resource allocation, in the end leading to improved performance and cost-effectiveness in banking operations.

articleTitle: Plant Disease Detection using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This research explores the use of machine learning approaches for accurate identification and detection of major diseases in pulse crops, targeting improvements in early diagnosis and management of infections such as downy mildew, Ascochyta blight, rust, powdery mildew, and anthracnose. These diseases trigger diverse signalling pathways. Specific genes and proteins, are upregulated in response to pathogen invasion, enabling plants to mount targeted defence responses. Understanding these mechanisms highlights opportunities for enhancing disease resistance through breeding and genetic research in legume crops.This paper outlines a procedure for identification of diseases in pulse crops using modern image processing technologies and machine learning techniques. The objective is to build a system that can recognize the common ailments of pulses which would otherwise lead to a huge loss in case of the weeds not being controlled. The system uses a data set of diseased and healthy plants and applies CNN’s to classify and predict disease. The findings achieved very encouraging Level of accuracy thus suggesting further work could extend to practical use by farmers in assessing the health of the crops more conveniently.

articleTitle: Simulating Hybrid Deep Learning Mechanism For Security Enhancement During Blockchain Based Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) Authentication
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In WSN, the processing power, memory, and battery life of sensor nodes are limited. Due to their widespread usage in untrusted situations, WSNs are vulnerable to a variety of threats. The trustworthiness of the data it gathers is also called into doubt due to the challenges in getting a WSN. The authentication process of WSNs allows for verification of the authenticity of data and resources. Authentication examines the data's provenance and permits only approved modifications, protecting data in WSNs from manipulation. On the other hand, ID spoofing attacks and other vulnerabilities exist in existing authentication techniques. Blockchain is just one more exciting new development in the realm of cyber defense. A new blockchain-based authentication method for WSNs was developed in this study. Sensor nodes and the blockchain were integral parts of the study's system design, with users and a private blockchain playing vital roles. A comprehensive security review was conducted on the study's data. The classification of safe and insecure records via blockchain-based WSN has been accomplished using a deep learning model. Following optimization-based filtering, data stored on blockchain is categorized. After optimization, the performance of the attack classification system much improves; general accuracy increases to $\mathbf{9 6 . 9 5 \%}$, precision, recall, and F1-score rises to about 97%. Successful optimization is shown by these changes.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis using Speech Recognition for Improved Customer Operations Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This paper presents the application of advanced speech recognition technologies to transcribe and analyze customer interactions, enhancing both business efficiency and customer experience. Motivated by the need for human-like interaction in automated systems, our work introduces “Humanization through Automation,” a system designed to retain personal touches while optimizing operational efficiency. The approach involves capturing high-quality audio, followed by noise reduction and normalization to facilitate effective feature extraction using Spectrogram Conversion and Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC). The use of Convolutional, Pooling, and Dropout Layers refines detail detection and reduces overfitting, while Fully Connected Layers integrate and analyze features, using activation functions for accurate classification and sentiment analysis. By embedding sentiment detection within Interactive Voice Response (IVR) systems via Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), our system can interpret emotional tones, allowing dynamic responses and connecting customers with suitable representatives based on emotional state. This integration of speech recognition and sentiment analysis not only elevates interaction quality but also strengthens customer relationships, optimizes sales strategies, and fosters organizational growth, transitioning from traditional customer service models to solutions emphasizing efficiency and personalization.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Classification Performance of Fine-Tuned ResNet-50 in Plant Species Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This work proposes a fine-tuned ResNet-50 model-based floral classification system using its strong feature extraction capacity to improve classification accuracy. ResNet-50, a deep convolutional neural network pre-trained on ImageNet, shines in capturing complex patterns because of its residual learning methodology, which helps to build deeper networks. Fine-tuned ResNet-50 shows superior performance in managing demanding picture datasets than standard models since it lowers vanishing gradient difficulties and allows effective learning. The dataset consists of two, 746 photographs in five classes: Daisy (501 images), Dandelion (646 images), Rose (497 images), Sunflower (495 images), Tulip (607 images). Good evaluation and training are made possible in part by this fair sharing. Following lengthy training and validation, the model shown remarkable accuracy of 91% thus proving its practical significance in plant identification and biodiversity monitoring. The results show how effectively deep learning techniques—especially enhanced ResNet-50—in advance of floral classification problems work. Better classification accuracy and efficiency in plant species identification help to enhance ecosystem management by means of which sustainable development goals (SDGs) are achieved and agricultural output is raised.

articleTitle: Interplay Between Diverse Sustainability Factors and Nonprofit Organizational Performance: A Bibliometric Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The United Nations’ 2030 Global Agenda outlines 17 sustainable development goals (SDGs) covering poverty, health, education, human rights, and sustainability. Attaining SDGs by 2030 necessitates significant contributions from nonprofits. Most nonprofits face sustainability challenges and have no clue how to deal with this issue. Researchers have provided valuable insights and global perspectives in the last two decades. However, most existing research focuses only on financial and governance factors as leading causes of nonprofit sustainability. Following these research findings, nonprofits limit their efforts and resources only to these two sustainability factors and fail to identify other sustainability factors and their potential contributions to sustainability in an integrated way; thus, most nonprofits fail to achieve nonprofit sustainability. Ignoring other sustainability factors highlights a research gap. In addition, nonprofits must learn how sustainability factors, performance, and sustainability behave and interplay to achieve sustainability. Instead of following a piecemeal approach, this study aims to identify diverse and dominant sustainability areas, e.g., governance, financial management, partnerships, capacity planning, Information Technology (IT), and data-driven decisions through a literature review and bibliometric analysis using the Scopus database. In addition, this paper explains the relationship between sustainability areas, performance, and sustainability, which is also missing in the existing approach. This information lays the groundwork for an inclusive approach to nonprofit sustainability, offering invaluable insights for practitioners, researchers, and policymakers striving to amplify nonprofits’ impact. The findings are helpful and valuable for all global nonprofits to address the complex sustainability problem and contribute to SDGs without concern.

articleTitle: Hybrid Electric Vehicle: Energy Optimization and Emission Reduction for Sustainable Transportation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This paper discusses the critical challenge in the automotive industry concerning fuel efficiency and environmental effects by looking at the improvement in HEV technology. At a time when concern about sustainable transport solutions is being increased, our study takes up a new hybrid vehicle model that has been optimized for energy use with superior control strategies. This motivation arises from the desire to minimize greenhouse gas emissions and increase fuel economy, both critical objectives in the design of modern vehicles. A detailed background analysis is included to focus attention on present shortcomings in HEV technology, including the relatively low efficiency of conventional powertrain arrangements at lower speeds. Our proposed model based on empirical data and simulation results represents a structured improvement approach for fuel efficiency and a decrease in emissions under certain driving conditions. Quantitative performance measures such as percentage increases in fuel efficiency and measured reductions in CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions would thus serve as proof that the model has a noticeable impact. Unlike previous models, the proposed configuration is capable of automatically switching from electric to combustion modes when at speeds below $30 \mathrm{~km} / \mathrm{h}$ to improve fuel economy. We further establish the effectiveness of the model by comparing its performance metrics to other recent studies in the domain. Information regarding implementation includes hardware and software platforms used for simulation in addition to accuracy and loss metrics for validation of the model. Results are presented and discussed in detail with respect to comparisons over traditional hybrid configurations. The paper is concluded by discussing future opportunities for research and the motivation to develop HEV technologies. All equations, figures, and tables are formatted with standardized conventions for clarity and consistency. These shall be addressed in the succeeding paragraphs, as this paper aims to contribute meaningfully to the sustainable design of the automobile providing a base for further HEV development.

articleTitle: Leveraging Influencer Advocacy For Smarter Decision-Making In Smart City Governance
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This study examines the impact of social media influencers on public decision-making in smart city governance. As urban areas adopt advanced technologies, citizen participation in governance becomes crucial. The study explores how influencers can mobilize public support for smart city initiatives. Utilizing Digital Governance Theory and Participatory Governance Theory, the study evaluates the effects of influencer advocacy, smart city platforms, and social media engagement on public decision-making. Data from 308 participants, analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM), reveal that influencer advocacy significantly boosts public participation and informed decision-making. Social media engagement emerges as a key moderator, enhancing the influence of both advocacy and governance platforms. The findings highlight the importance of credibility, authenticity, and engagement strategies for influencers in building trust and public involvement in governance. The study offers practical insights for policymakers, planners, and influencers, stressing the need for transparency and strategic communication to encourage inclusive urban development. Further research is advised to explore the evolving role of influencer advocacy in smart cities, addressing challenges like advocacy fatigue and the impact of new digital platforms.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics in Assessing Employee Retention Rates: An Analysis of Effectiveness and Accuracy of Different Predictive Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A high rate of employee turnover is a curse to organizations, and therefore it is surprising that the study of employee retention has received so little attention. Employee turnover is a common problem that companies begin to complain about and to show their discomfort. Yet predictors and scientific insights exist, as do solutions. Predictive analytics makes use of several statistical models to provide insights into future events and improve decision-making support. Human resources are beginning to use predictive analytics tools. Predictive analytics works by learning from data and statistics in order to provide insights that help companies make better decisions. This paper studies and evaluates the effectiveness of different predictive models using respondents from a sample of colleges before passing the examination stage. The results provide optimistic support for the usefulness of predictive analytics and also make policy recommendations on how managers can improve employees’ attitudes towards the organization and retain them while working independently before passing the examination stage.

articleTitle: The Deep Learning Based Analysis and Prediction of Apple Scab Disease in Apple Plants using ResNet-50 Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Apple scab, caused by the fungus Venturia inaequalis, primarily affects the apple trees and the crab apples. It first emerges as dark, and velvety spots on leaves, fruits, and occasionally young twigs. This disease typically is revealed in thespring and thrives in the cool and moist environments. The fruit plantations with infections develop lesions that may break and deform, and infected leaves may become distorted and prematurely fall off. To control apple scab, the resistant varieties should be planted, pruning should be done to improve the air flow, and fungicides should be applied at key points during the growing season to protect new growth and mature fruit. This study introduces a deep-learning classifier designed to distinguish between two types of image data, one showing the apple leaves affected by apple scab disease and the other showing healthy apple leaves. The images undergo de-noising to improve quality. The cleaned data is then used to train ResNet50 networks, achieving high precision. In summary, this research aims to develop a highly accurate image classifier for detecting apple scab disease, achieving an accuracy rate of 90.67%.

articleTitle: An Intrusion Detection System for Battery Exhaustion Attack in Mobile Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A battery power exhaustion outbreak is a kind of Denial of Service (DoS) assault in which an assailant tries to quickly trench the battery of a mobile or any other handheld instrument. In this work novel algorithm is utilized for an interruption finding structure to detect the threats. The planned work deliberates the system performance, power utilized, and memory restrictions of portable or mobile figuring strategies. This interference exposure structure services a linear regression model to predict power consumption based on numerous characteristics such as central processing unit load and disc admittances, empowering us to regulate the power utilized per progression and later classify progressions that are possibly battery exhaustion attacks.

articleTitle: Traffic Signal Violation Handling Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Accidents are occurring more frequently as a result of the sharp rise in traffic infractions including speeding, running red lights, and failing to wear helmets brought on by the quick increase in the number of vehicles. These issues are difficult for current traffic management systems to handle well, especially when it comes to giving emergency vehicles priority in emergency situations. The goal of this research is to use computer vision and machine learning techniques to create a reliable, automated system for identifying and managing traffic signal violations. In addition to facilitating enforcement procedures and precisely identifying offenders, the system will have a dedicated module that guarantees emergency vehicles may go quickly and unhindered across junctions. The suggested strategy is anticipated to greatly improve road safety and traffic flow by lowering infractions and speeding up emergency response times. The initiative offers a thorough method for updating traffic control and enhancing urban mobility by emphasising on promoting responsible motorists through data-driven traffic management techniques and public awareness campaigns.

articleTitle: Advancing Age Estimation from Facial Images Using Deep Learning Approaches and Ethical Considerations
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Estimation of age from facial images is an important application in various fields, like biometrics, forensics, and personalized healthcare. The proposed work investigated the use of a machine learning approach to predict human age from facial features only, obtained from images. Our method used Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in feature extraction and then combined regression models for age estimation. The used dataset is images of faces from different demographic groups, which makes the model robust and generalizable. All critical challenges related to variations in lighting, facial expression, and age distribution are adequately covered. The preprocessing steps, which include normalization and data augmentation, were properly applied to improve the performance of the models and reduce overfitting. Measures to report on prediction accuracy are also reported by using metrics such as Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD) and Root Mean Square Deviation (RMSD). The approach CNN-based shows a higher accuracy and computation rate compared to the baseline methods. Additionally, it presents practical applications of the models in missing people cases or for age-sensitive services. Ethical concerns such as privacy and control of bias are also of high concern and thus point to the need for clear and equitable use of such technology. This research seriously tests deep learning and shows its effectiveness in improving the estimation of age from facial images, providing important insights in relation to biometric solutions and more.

articleTitle: DL-RF: A Hybrid Deep Learning and Random Forest Approach for Enhanced Brain Tumor Detection and Classification Using MRI Images
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Correct treatment strategies can be identified for patient outcome improvement in the field of neurology by improving the brain tumor detection and classification. Manual MRI analysis, however, is time-consuming and error prone; therefore, automated systems are necessary. In this study, we present a hybrid deep learning and random forest (DL-RF) methodology to improve brain tumor detection and classification from MRI images. The main aim of this research is to design an advanced hybrid model (DL-RF) for improving the accuracy and reliability of brain tumor identification and classification using MRI data. The study combines CNN based feature extraction with RF's classification strength to address the challenges of the traditional methods and obtain high performance metrics in tumor detection. This work is motivated from reducing human error, improving diagnostic accuracy and offering a faster and more reliable early tumour diagnosis method using advanced AI techniques, which utilize the DL-RF model based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for feature extraction to capture the complex hierarchical features along with random forest (RF) for feature selection and classification. The structure of this approach is based on data preprocessing: normalization, noise reduction, image augmentation, to produce high quality training data. In the binary classification tasks, this model outperforms traditional methods such as SVM and KNN with an accuracy of $98.7 \%$, and $\mathbf{9 4 . 5 \%}$ in multiclass classification tasks. The benefits of random forest’s robustness in classification and deep learning’s feature extraction capabilities in combination allow a more precise detection of disjoint critical features compared with other existing techniques. Both quantitative as well as qualitative evaluation of this novel brain tumor analysis method are promising and is therefore a substantial contribution to the field of brain tumor analysis.

articleTitle: Evaluating Machine Learning Based Automatic Quality Assurance of Magnetic Resonance Images in Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is essential for diagnosing and monitoring neurological disorders due to its superior soft tissue contrast and high spatial resolution; however, the slow acquisition process poses challenges to clinical efficiency. Advancements in temporal encoding, compressed sensing, and parallel imaging have improved acquisition speed, but consistent image quality is crucial for accurate diagnosis and treatment. This study focuses on enhancing automated quality assurance (QA) in MRI brain imaging using machine learning (ML) models to improve tumour classification accuracy and reduce manual intervention. A Kaggle MRI brain scan dataset is preprocessed through resizing, cropping, and data augmentation, followed by the evaluation of multiple models, including MobileNetV2, ResNet50, and Random Forest, using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. MobileNetV2 outperforms the other models with a classification accuracy of 96%, demonstrating the potential of lightweight architectures for reliable QA automation. The research contributes to streamlining clinical workflows and improving diagnostic precision by showcasing the effectiveness of AI-driven MRI quality enhancement frameworks.

articleTitle: Smart Safety Helmet for Mining Workers with Environmental Monitoring and Alert System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The Health and Injury Control (HIC) system for miners stands as a crucial requirement due to the high-risk nature of the mining industry. The Smart Safety Helmet has been developed to meet the vital needs through the use of advanced Internet of Things (IoT) technology in mining operations. Continuous monitoring of health parameters, such as heart rate and body temperature, enables the helmet to promptly alert miners regarding any irregularities, thus facilitating improved preventive health measures. This Helmet also includes impact detection sensors that provide immediate alerts, ensuring a quick response in the event of accidents, contributing to injury prevention. Its ergonomic design and focus worker comfort encourage prolonged use without causing discomfort or hesitance in wearing safety equipment. Additionally, essential environmental sensors identify hazardous gases and extreme temperature conditions for enhanced safety protection.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Convolutional Neural Networks for Brain Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have emerged as a powerful tool for picture evaluation, mainly in present-day scientific imaging. With the increasing occurrence of modern mind tumors, accurate and green detection is vital for well-timed analysis and treatment. This examination presents a comparative evaluation of various CNN architectures for mind tumor detection. We first discuss the overall structure of brand-new CNNs, which incorporates multiple layers for function extraction and class. The primary layer plays convolution at the enter picture, accompanied by pooling layers to reduce the spatial dimensions of state-of-the-art functions. This is then accompanied by ultimately linked layers that carry out classification. We have a look at specializes in exclusive CNN architectures, including Alex Net, VGG, Google Net, and Reset, that have proven impressive outcomes in picture class duties. To assess the overall performance of those architectures, we use a public-to-be-had dataset of modern-day brain MRI snapshots with tumor annotations. We preprocess the images to ensure consistency, after which we train the fashions on a subset of ultra-modern records. The closing records are used for testing and evaluating the models’ overall performance in phrases ultra-modern accuracy, precision, don’t forget, and F1 rating.

articleTitle: Investigating the Impact of Heuristic Algorithms on Cyberthreat Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This paper investigates the effect of heuristic algorithms on cybersecurity hazard detection and mitigation. To be able to do so, the authors analyze the performance of two heuristics-based algorithms—the simple Heuristic set of rules (SHA) and greedy Heuristic set of rules (GHA)—on 4 distinct datasets. The datasets contain malicious and non-malicious packets. Effects of the experiments show that each algorithms exhibit extraordinarily correct predictions of malicious packets while as compared to the floor-reality labels, and showcase an excessive level of detection accuracy in detecting threats. The SHA set of rules tested the strongest performance, achieving an accuracy of as much as 95 and ninety-seven percentage on datasets. The authors further take a look at that once both algorithms are utilized in aggregate, the overall performance progressed. The research findings may be generalized in further contexts and assist the notion that heuristics algorithms may be effective in threat detection and mitigation.

articleTitle: Anti-Fraudulent System for Insurance Using Random Forest Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Insurance fraud is a serious crime, placing a heavy and personal burden on individuals, businesses, government agencies, and the general public due to the density between dynamic factors such as health care providers, patients, and services. Increased incidents contribute to increased total costs incurred by insurers, premiums paid by policyholders, and states budgets This article covers a variety of impermissible practices and illegal practices around. The existing system is machine learning model vote classification (VC) with an accuracy of $\mathbf{8 6 \%}$ for anti-fraudulent detection. The proposed system is random forest classification algorithm using machine learning algorithms to detect fraudulent activities. The machine learning algorithms designed to predict whether an individual has made a fraudulent or legitimate insurance claim. First, duplicates and null values are removed from the data set. This method divides the collected data into several decision trees according to attributes such as gender, insurance coverage, frequency of employer’s insurance premiums and then displays a graph representing the divided data for data analysis. The Random Forest Classifier is specifically used for detecting fraudulent insurance policies. After classification, the results are summarized in a classification report, and a confusion matrix is generated to present the detection results for both fraudulent and non-fraudulent claims. The new system achieves an accuracy score of $\mathbf{9 0. 0 0 8 \%}$, demonstrating a robust ability to detect most fraudulent claims accurately.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Road Surface Classification: Integrating Vibration Data and MCNN for Enhanced Pothole Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The existing techniques for categorizing road surfaces mainly rely on visual inspection or image analysis whose reliability and performance are limited in ugly climate ones. The unique contribution of the study is a proposed learning based novel solution that combines accelerometer-based vibration data fed into multiple channels of features to accurately identify potholes and rigid surface irregularities via multi-channel neural network (MCNN). Using motion responses detected by the accelerometer in conjunction with live imagery taken from a Raspberry Pi camera, the system provides accommodating detection of variations under different scenarios. Testing reveals the proposed configuration attains a precision of $\mathbf{9 4. 5 \%}$ and an exceptionally low false positive rate of only $\mathbf{5. 4 \%}$, handily outperforming past solutions. The creative integration of diverse inputs not only strengthens detection capabilities but also enables quick processing, permitting immediate feedback to optimize upkeep, fundamentally changing infrastructure management and ensuring enhanced safety for all road users

articleTitle: An Evaluation of Medical Image Analysis using Image Segmentation and Deep Learning Techniques for Brain-Tumour
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: An aberrant mass of rapidly proliferating brain cells, known as a brain tumour, may develop into various forms of cancer. The segmentation of brain tumours by MRI scans is a challenging but crucial process with several medical analytic applications. Radiologists or clinical specialists are responsible for performing a tedious and time-consuming process that involves identifying, segmenting, and extracting contaminated tumour regions from MRI images. The different anatomical structures of human organs may be imagined via image-processing ideas. The human brain is notoriously difficult for basic imaging techniques to identify abnormal structures. A large number of researchers looked at several rapid and accurate algorithms for brain tumour (BT) detection and classification. Recent advances in DL-based automated systems have allowed for faster and more accurate segmentation of DT. This research makes use of a DenseNet50 model for medical picture classification of brain malignancies that is built on a pre-trained CNN model made possible by DL. The model is available on Kaggle. An optimiser like Adam and a categorical cross-entropy loss function were utilised to train a model. A suggested DenseNet50 model outperformed other comparative advanced DL models and attained an experimental accuracy of 95%. The visual results also highlight the impressive outcomes of the MRI brain tumour segmentation system, which will help doctors automatically detect and treat brain tumours. The results acquired demonstrate the effective identification of tumorous images, which is extremely beneficial for the diagnosis process and future applications.

articleTitle: Optimizing Logistics Operations through AI-Data Processing model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Optimizing Logistics Operations through an AI-data processing model is a state-of-the-art solution implemented to innovate the logistics industry. It is carrier-neutral and operates on a flexible and configurable multi-tenant platform that uses advanced analytics, data sciences, artificial intelligence (AI), sensors/IoT standards to analyze the logistics operations, including Supply chain management, transport/Move/Freight Management System TMS/MFS and Warehouse/Warehousing Execution System WES aid in optimization. This means this model has sophisticated data processing capabilities and can ingest relevant information from various sources like shipments, inventory levels or customer demand. This data is then processed by AI-driven algorithms, which predict & optimize logistics operations in real time. This model aids in curbing operational costs by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting optimal routing, transportation methods, and inventory management strategies. It saves time and money and increases customer satisfaction by delivering goods faster and more accurately. In addition, the AI-Data Processing model is also elastic to market changes and customer requirements, so logic is always well-tuned for maximum efficiency. Since the model has much to offer in terms of its advanced capabilities, it could revolutionize logistics and alter how supply chains are managed at businesses.

articleTitle: GANs for Synthetic Environmental Data Generation (Air Quality) for Low-Resource Regions
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Due to the significant expenses and logistical difficulties involved in deploying monitoring equipment, many areas, especially those in developing nations, lack adequate environmental data. This work presents a novel approach that uses Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) for creating artificial environmental data. The model of GAN is trained for generating synthetic data for under-monitored or unmonitored areas by utilizing high-resolution environmental data from well-monitored regions. The paper discusses the generation of synthetic data and its comparison with real data based on statistical properties. The analysis reveals that the characteristics of the created data closely align with the actual data. With the help of this synthetic data, researchers and policymakers will be able to make more informed decisions by having precise estimations of important environmental indicators like air quality.

articleTitle: Assessing the Applicability of Adversarial Machine Learning Approaches for Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Adverse machine learning (AML) is a rising area of study that uses system-mastering algorithms to perceive malicious hobbies or to discover malicious adversaries in cybersecurity settings. This research domain combines device-gaining knowledge with game principles to assess and expect the behavior of adversaries. This paper discusses the capacity of using AML tactics for cybersecurity and provides an overview of existing research study findings and safety literature to help the dialogue. Specifically, the paper investigates the security challenges posed by using AML techniques, together with the technical regulations and pointers, to ensure their relaxed and effective deployment. Moreover, the paper offers recommendations and future instructions for furthering studies on AML in cybersecurity. Typical, the evaluation highlights the significance of assessing the applicability of AML techniques for security applications, in addition to its capability to enhance the effectiveness of security systems.

articleTitle: Kidney Stone Detection using Image Segmentation and Radial Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Kidney stones are a common urological issue that affects millions of people worldwide and, if left untreated, can cause significant discomfort and consequences. To avoid catastrophic results and enhance treatment regimens, it is critical to adopt early detection and exact diagnosis. New medical imaging methods have made it much easier to diagnose and treat kidney stones. Nonetheless, we have a long way to go before we can correctly and precisely identify these stones, especially in tough settings when the stones are small, hidden, or located in hard-to-see regions. This paper presents a unique method for identifying kidney stones that combines cutting-edge image segmentation algorithms with radial transform techniques. The suggested technique intends to overcome some of the shortcomings with current detection methods to improve the reliability and accuracy of stone recognition in medical imaging.

articleTitle: A Secure and Robust Framework to Mitigate Active Attacks for Cloud in Collaborative Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The IDSs’ capacity to identify assaults or cyberattacks is hampered by their singular point of view. This makes it necessary for several IDS nodes to exchange attack characteristics. For the purpose of efficiently sharing these assault characteristics, researchers devised a cooperative intrusion detection system. Although this method was helpful, there is no guarantee that the shared data will be secure. More precisely, there is growing worry over preserving the consistency and integrity of shared data. We present a blockchain-based Framework that guarantees the consistency and integrity of shared attack features in proposed system. This is accomplished by the suggested architecture by identifying and stopping compromised IDS nodes and false feature injection. It also guarantees the involvement of heterogeneous IDS nodes, makes it easier for IDS nodes to communicate scalable attack features, and is resilient to new and exiting public IDS nodes from the network. We assess the latency and security assessments. The outcome demonstrates that the suggested method is scalable, and it can identify and stop malicious feature injection, manipulation, and deletion in addition to compromised IDS nodes.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches to Optimising Factory Layouts for Enhanced Operational Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Factory layout planning (FLP) is one of the most significant decisions that have to be taken by an organization while establishing and designing a manufacturing unit. Traditional approaches to FLP, which rely on manual and computational methods, struggle to cope with the increasing complexity of modern manufacturing systems, characterized by diverse product types, shorter life cycles, and smaller batch sizes. Objective: To address these challenges, this paper seeks to utilized Reinforcement Learning (RL) to facilitate the automation of factory layout optimization by looking at material flow, transportation time, and productivity rates. Provide a case study based on RL for Factory layout. Methods: A novel RL-based framework is developed, where an RL agent dynamically allocates functional units within a grid-based factory layout. The framework is compared with both manual and conventional computer-aided approaches. In addition to RL, machine learning (ML) techniques such as supervised and unsupervised learning are also evaluated for layout optimization. Results: RL has a superior performance to the traditional model; the results depict a massive improvement in transport duration and enhanced workflow. This flexibility is inherent in RL to solve complex FLP without having to rely extensively on analytic models that may not be feasible when the problem space changes often. Conclusion: This research demonstrates that RL is a powerful tool for optimizing factory layouts, capable of dynamically responding to system changes and leading to continuous improvements in operational performance.

articleTitle: Vision Transformer Approaches for Diabetic Retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The focus of this paper is to identify how deep learning can be utilised in identifying diabetic retinopathy, a serious complication of diabetes which causes blindness. In this paper, an end-to-end system is proposed for diagnosing the early signs of disease using CNN to analyze images. Cropped Retinal - CNN - Early Diagnosis of the First Stage of the Disease. The overall performance of the proposed system is determined using accuracy, precision, and usability that are far much better than the conventional method of diagnosing the syndromes. Five models are explored under this study which includes Vision Transformer (ViT), Convolutional Neural Network, MobileNetV2, YOLO and Hybrid model (ViT+CNN). five levels of Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) are explored viz., No, Mild, Moderate, Severe and Proliferative DR. From these five models, the hybrid model achieved a $\mathbf{9 4 \%}$ of accuracy on the DR dataset. More future work includes the expansion of the expressed model and the inclusion of real-time image processing for clinical use.

articleTitle: 2D Wound Image Segmentation Using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The purpose of wound segmentation is to accurately identify and delineate wound areas in images, enabling precise analysis of metrics like size, shape, and spread. This aids healthcare professionals in assessing wound severity and monitoring treatment progress. This research focuses on developing an automated wound image segmentation tool using the Deep learning Algorithms. The objective is to enhance wound assessment accuracy by precisely identifying and segmenting wound areas in digital images. Three models are employed to find the effectiveness in segmenting the wound which includes U- Net, DeepLabV3+ and Mask-CNN. The deep learning models are trained on a massive dataset of wound pictures and masks; they then provide segmented outputs, which are examined for wound characteristics and severity. The U-Net model has obtained better performance in segmenting the wound with an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 2. 3} \%$. This work seeks to incorporate advanced capabilities into a user-friendly interface for practical use in clinical settings. Initial results demonstrate promising segmentation accuracy, with plans for further enhancements in future.

articleTitle: An Empirical Overview of Stress Detection Based on Photoplethysmography Signal Using Various Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The rapid speed of modern life and the shift towards cognitive work have contributed to a rising prevalence of mental stress across all professions. Many sedentary occupations, particularly in fields like Information Technology (IT), causes prolonged periods of intense mental effort that can significantly elevate stress levels. Extended exposure to such mental stress is linked to an increased risk of serious conditions, such as cardiovascular diseases and mental health disorders. Consequently, there is a critical need for non-intrusive tools capable of detecting mental stress. Early detection is essential for preventing stress-related health concerns and continuous observation of stress levels. Numerous methods are currently available for stress detection, but they face limitations like inaccuracies due to individual differences and environmental factors as well as difficulties with real-time monitoring. In this discussion, several techniques are explored that offer better insights with stress detection, providing valuable perspectives for future researchers. This survey discusses various deep learning techniques, highlighting their advantages and limitations. It also suggests potential improvements to tackle these limitations in the future. Initially, this survey categorizes Deep Learning techniques into five techniques: Long ShortTerm Memory (LSTM), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Transfer Learning (TL), Attention-Based Mechanisms, and Transformer-based approaches are discussed in depth. Subsequently, it identifies research gaps in traditional Deep Learning approaches to guide future innovative model development. The study reviews 25 research papers focusing on various methods for stress detection using DL. Finally, this survey evaluates performance metrics, datasets, techniques used for research, and model achievements. CNNs emerge as the predominant approach, and Python is frequently used for stress detection in DL. Additionally, accuracy is highlighted as a key analytical metric.

articleTitle: SAGA-Integrating AI for Enhanced Recruitment: A System with Audio-Video Proctoring and Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: AI has transformed recruitment, overcoming logictical issues and interviewer prejudice. The COVID-19 epidemic compounded matters. Advanced AI interview systems use natural language processing and computer vision algorithms to assess candidates’ verbal and non-verbal cues using audio and video. Systems have uniform standards, high integrity, security, and scalability. In addition, speech, sentiment, face, and emotion detection are provided. Online learning and telemedicine could be added to recruitment apps. These technologies improve feedback quality and transparency for safe, efficient, and balanced global change.

articleTitle: Smart Music Recommendation System Integrating NLP and Hybrid Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In an era where technological growth gives a massive amount of knowledge in music, intuitive and personalized music delivery forms the cornerstone for better user experience and satisfaction. The increasing reliance on voice-driven interfaces can be leveraged to create newer music recommendation systems. This paper explores the development of the Smart Music Recommendation System, which will use natural language processing (NLP), speech recognition, and hybrid algorithms to recommend music to the user based on his mood input through voice. The system leverages Google Speech Recognition API for real-time voice interaction ensuring a seamless interaction between the user and the system. The system additionally detects the user’s emotional state from voice commands, while search algorithms are employed to fetch and recommend songs. A hybrid recommendation approach combines content-based filtering for emotion-specific playlist generation for every mood for an enhanced listening experience. An exceptional feature in our system is offline download using Yt-dlp to any local device and playback processes using an automated threading mechanism. The system proposed here was tested and gave efficient performance in voice interaction, song suggestion according to mood, and coordination with external platforms for retrieving and playing songs.

articleTitle: IoT-Driven Healthcare: A New Era of Connected Care
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: With science and technologies taking quantum leaps, the Internet of Things (IoT) has come out as a revolutionary force in global connectivity, bridging the physical and digital realms through sensor and actuator interfaces. Even in the healthcare sector, it enhances medical efficiency and patient care. It connects devices and enables intelligent data-driven systems. This study works towards delving into IoT’s fundamentals and its deployment in the healthcare domain. It presents the outline of IoT’s structure which includes a variety of technologies like sensors, embedded intelligence, RFID, and nanotechnology. It illustrates how these technologies facilitate connectivity and data exchange between interconnected devices. The paper emphasizes the relevance of the Internet of Things in healthcare. This comprises wearable ECG monitoring, applications in home mobile healthcare systems, and fog-computing architecture for preventive healthcare. Altogether, the paper focuses on expanding the importance of IoT in restructuring healthcare and improving the quality of life.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Guided Telescope Control System using Jetson-Nano
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: It has been in human nature to explore the vastness of the cosmos ever since time immemorial. The quest began with ancient men staring at the celestial bodies and now advanced telescopes are able to reach the edges of the universe. Notably, recent introduction of AI technology and its combination with conventional telescope techniques significantly transformed the world of astrophysics and astronomy, making them more progressive and efficient. This article describes new approach for the telescope control, which include a voice interface, automated tracking of stars, advanced technologies for astronomical image processing and attaching familiar names to datasets of celestial objects. The purpose of the system is to enable scientists, astronomers, and other users interested in the study of space to operate it easily and provide accurate results. In combination with data from Stellarium and well-known star maps, this AI-based system of telescope control improves the experience of the users making the universe more navigable.

articleTitle: VADER: A Lightweight and Effective Approach for Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Sentiment analysis (SA) has become an essential field in text mining, aiming to computationally interpret subjective information such as opinions and emotions. This paper surveys recent advancements in SA, motivated by its growing applications across domains like politics, sports, and real-time event analysis. Key findings reveal that emerging techniques, such as transfer learning and emotion detection, have significantly improved SA’s adaptability and accuracy. Research survey organizes these studies by method and application type, with visual aids to enhance usability. This synthesis provides researchers with a comprehensive resource for understanding SA trends and supports future research directions to extend SA’s practical impact.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality based 3D Mario-style Game Using Procedural Content Generation and Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The rapid growth of machine learning has created new potential for improving the gaming experience, particularly in virtual reality (VR) situations. This study addresses the difficulty of developing dynamic, engaging virtual reality games by integrating procedural content generation (PCG) and reinforcement learning (RL). The motivation originates from the desire to create adaptive gaming systems that respond to individual player behaviour, improving immersion and variability in games. The major goal is to look into how PCG can be used to automate the production of game elements, as well as how RL, notably Q-learning, may be used to alter game mechanics in real time in response to player interactions. The primary contribution of this work lies in integrating these advanced techniques inside a VR framework and evaluating their influence on the gamer.

articleTitle: Intelligent Edge Computing for Real-Time Tumor Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Sensible part Computing (IEC) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for computing, putting records evaluation and selection-making abilities in the direction of the records supply. In healthcare, IEC allows real-time and personalized assessment of scientific facts, taking into consideration more efficient diagnosis and treatment of illnesses. Mainly, using machine getting-to-know (ML) strategies in IEC has proven promising in improving ailment detection and analysis. One of the most pressing challenges in healthcare is the well-timed detection and remedy of tumors. Conventional approaches to tumor detection frequently involve more than one imaging exam and lengthy wait times for outcomes, primarily due to delays in remedy and probably erroneous prognosis. With the software of ML, IEC can revolutionize tumor detection with the aid of allowing real-time analysis of clinical pictures for the identification of potential tumors.ML algorithms and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are well-suitable for tumor detection as they can successfully analyze and perceive styles in scientific pics. These algorithms may be trained on massive datasets of medical images that may then be deployed on area computing gadgets for actual evaluation. This allows for the rapid detection of tumors and offers an opportunity for early intervention and treatment.
