articleTitle: Automating Product Classification in E-Commerce through Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: An efficient product category classification has now emerged as a vital element of the rapidly developing world of e-commerce and online retail, providing better control over inventory and enabling customized presentations for each customer. This paper presents the investigation into using machine learning techniques to automatically classify products based on textual descriptions. Using a large, annotated dataset, authors collect information by extracting relevant information from product descriptions and use advanced methods in both machine learning and natural language processing in showing well the classification of categories of products. The study also includes the critically important data gathering, preprocessing, and feature extraction phases that are vital in harvesting subtle semantic-related information hidden in descriptions of products. The process involves careful selection and implementation of complex algorithms, such as Naive Bayes, Random Forest, and Linear SVM, best suited for dealing with product categorization-specific problems. Thus, training and validation procedures play a vital role in optimizing the model parameters so that the model can perform robustly on unseen data and hence generalize effectively to new products. The model, deployed on an e-commerce platform, provides real-time category prediction as new products are added into the system. It regularly updates and maintains itself so that any variations in the product catalog or changes in the structures of language used over time in describing products are incorporated within the model. It has addressed issues such as data incompleteness and inconsistency and therefore offers integrated methods that may lead to improving the accuracy of predictions. The system is flexible and adaptive and capable of learning and evolving over time, according to new categories that may arise and different contexts of operations. The results do reflect significant strides in creating large-scale, efficient machine learning solutions for e-commerce, automating the process of product category prediction and the further efficiency enhancement of online commerce platforms.

articleTitle: Influencer Narratives Influencing Follower’s Travel Intent: A Digital Journey
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This research employs cognitive-effective system theory (CAST) and transmedia storytelling theory (TST) to construct a framework that explains how influencer digital storytelling impacts consumer travel intentions in e-commerce settings. The investigation collected data from 322 participants who engaged with travel influencer content and booked trips through e-commerce platforms, using an online survey and SmartPLS 4.0 for data validation, empirical assessment, and hypothesis evaluation. Results indicate that influencer credibility and compelling narratives positively affect destination visualization, awareness, and travel intentions. The study emphasizes the crucial mediating roles of destination visualization and awareness in connecting influencer storytelling to e-commerce engagement. These findings contribute to enhancing digital marketing tactics, improving consumer engagement, and optimizing travel booking processes. By introducing novel variables within the CAST and Transmedia Storytelling frameworks, this study advances the understanding of influencer-driven marketing in the travel industry, underscoring the dynamic nature of digital marketing and its effects on consumer travel behavior.

articleTitle: Improving Road Safety via Advanced Monitoring and Intelligent Emergency Response Systems: Leveraging IoT and AI
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Road accidents remain a critical global issue, exacerbated by factors such as driving under the influence of alcohol, health-related driver incapacitation, and delays in emergency response. This study aims to address these concerns through the development of an intelligent driver safety system that integrates multiple sensor technologies. Specifically, the system focuses on detecting intoxication through alcohol sensors, monitoring driver health through heart rate analysis, and ensuring rapid emergency response in the event of accidents. Leveraging the Internet of Things (IoT) and advanced sensor technologies, the proposed solution accurately identifies the root causes of accidents and analyzes potential seasonal trends to inform preventive strategies. Additionally, real-time accident detection and automated alert mechanisms are integrated to minimize response times for emergency services, thereby reducing fatalities and injuries. The system is designed to enhance overall road safety by providing proactive monitoring of driver behavior and physical condition and enabling swift post-accident intervention. This study presents a comprehensive approach to improving road safety and reducing accident-related fatalities by combining intelligent detection, health monitoring, and immediate emergency communication.

articleTitle: Advancing Cloud Gaming: Addressing Latency Challenges through Research and Innovative Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Cloud gaming is changing the gaming industry by offering high-quality gameplay without needing powerful local hardware. However, common problems like high lag, network congestion, and inconsistent Quality of Experience (QoE) limit its broader use. This document addresses these challenges through an in-depth analysis of a large-scale latency dataset gathered from 189 players interacting with 9 servers across North America, South America, Europe, and East Asia. Utilizing several models, such as Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and Linear Regression, we predict latency patterns and identify the elements influencing performance declines. Our results reveal significant regional variations in server performance and show that cloud gaming performance may be significantly enhanced by hybrid configurations that include the best features of both platforms, such as adaptive Quality of Experience (QoE) models and local computation through edge nodes. Three key contributions are provided by this research: (1) a data-driven model for predicting latency in global cloud gaming networks; (2) a detailed analysis of leading platforms to ascertain their advantages and drawbacks; and (3) the proposal of a novel hybrid framework based on data-driven resource allocation techniques. These contributions lay the groundwork for improving user experience across a range of network configurations and optimizing cloud gaming systems.

articleTitle: Emerging Threats of Internet of Things (IOT): Leveraging the Impact of Digital Stress on Employee Well-Being
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This paper aims at analyzing the novel risks arising from the Internet of Things (IoT) in wearing environments and looking at digital stress more closely. That advanced connectivity and easy control over IoT has positive impact on connectivity and productivity but has negative effects on technostress because technology has become persistent as well persistent demands on employees. Basing on the concept of technostress, this study stands to reason that IoT is accompanied with possible risks in as much as we ass, From the above, this study aims at determining the challenges employees experience among them digital stress which is known to affect the mental state and overall production of employees. This paper uses bibliometric, epistemological, and substantive analyses to systematically scrutinize and categorize stress factors related to the IoT. With these analyses, this paper offers a framework that defines specific IoT-induced stressors, which might serve as a starting point for subsequent quantitative studies on reducing digital stress when working with IoT in organizations. In the end, this framework will help organizations to cope with the digital stress, increase employee efficiency and promote proper mental health in the context of the digital interconnectedness of the world.

articleTitle: Prediction of Psychological Issues Relating to Infertility Women under ANFIS
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Many women find that infertility is a huge psychological barrier influencing their general state of mind and mental health. Psychological issues and infertility can interact in a complex manner that usually results in emotional turbulence, anxiety, and depression. Over 15% of couples globally suffer from infertility, which has major psychological implications for women. Good mental health care and intervention depend on an awareness of and prognosis for psychological disorders in infertile women. Problem Statement: The problem of conventional methods of assessing psychological distress in infertile women are often lack accuracy and adaptability. This work addresses the desire for a more accurate predictive model by describing complex, nonlinear relationships between variables by mixing neural networks with fuzzy logic. Examined a dataset of demographic information from a cohort of women undergoing reproductive therapies, psychological tests, and stress related to infertility using ANFIS (Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System). Findings: The model was trained and evaluated using this data to predict psychological stress levels depending on identified stressors and personal factors. With a root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.12 and a correlation value of 0.89 the ANFIS model presented a clear improvement in prediction accuracy over conventional statistical methods. These results reveal that ANFIS can fairly depict the nuances of psychological issues in infertile women and offer perceptive study for customized mental health support.

articleTitle: E-Impulsive Buying in fashion e-Markets: The Role of UI Design
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: With the advent of 3G to 4G to 5G technology, e-commerce is mushrooming day by day. Increased investment in e-commerce companies as a result of technological advancements has leveled the playing field for new businesses to establish their bases and created innovative patterns to challenge conventional behavior. The increased use of e-commerce platforms, enhanced internet access, and shifting consumer behaviour have all contributed to an increase in eimpulsive buying in India. In this study, SOR Model was adopted where visual attractiveness, model display, perceived ease of use and navigational structure acted as stimulus, positive emotions as organism and e-impulsive buying as response. This study adopted SMART PLS 4.0 software to analyse the data given by 250 respondents. The results indicated positive relationship between visual attractiveness, model display and perceived ease of use with positive emotions and positive emotions increasing the chances of e-impulsive buying.

articleTitle: A Study on Deep Learning Based Anomaly Detection Technique in Natural Language Processing Textual Data
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Anomaly detection is used to identify outliers in datasets. Anomaly detection has been in use for the past four decades for the purpose of extracting out the anomalous parts from data has been used for decades to identify and extract anomalous components from data. However, identification and study of the pattern of outliers can come in handy when making future business decisions, or improve the precision of the learning model. In detail, the current demanding of anomaly detection is investigated, with some principles of anomaly detection are also outlined and some applications which are highlighted. The following is a research paper current work proposing the application of supervised as well as unsupervised learning for effecting the prognosis of the anomaly detection. We also utilize NLP (Natural Language Processing) and for this, it uses the word Embeddings technique which treats words as highdimensional space. Here they pick up the semantic level, and words, which mean similar things, will be close in the vector space. The process begins with clean-up of the dataset and moving the features that are of value out of the pre-processing step using sophisticated techniques like word embeddings and sentiment analysis. The proposed methodologies demonstrate superior detection performance compared to existing methods in the literature. Anomaly detection is of course the most relevant to our work, used most notably in fraud detection, semantic analysis and text data error correction.

articleTitle: Task Scheduling Techniques in Cloud and Fog Computing for Health Care
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Rapidly influencing the Internet’s future, the Internet of Things (IoT) is emerging as a crucial technology in several industries, most notably healthcare. IoT is essential for managing conditions like high blood pressure, diabetes, and heart disease in domains like mobile health and remote patient monitoring. Any latency in data transport between the cloud and the application is undesirable in these applications, where real-time data processing is essential. We suggest combining fog computing with sensors and cloud computing to solve this. By lowering the amount of data sent between sensors and the cloud, this method improves system efficiency by enabling more effective data collection and processing. Numerous jobs of various priority and length are generated by wireless sensor networks (WSNs) utilized for monitoring in the healthcare industry and submitted to fog computing systems at the same time. To guarantee that jobs are appropriately prioritized, with priority taking precedence over task duration, an efficient task scheduling algorithm is necessary. This study suggests using a unique technique called Tasks Classification and Virtual Machines Categorization (TCVC), which ranks tasks according to their significance, to improve the performance of static task scheduling algorithms. Depending on the patient’s health, the assignments received through IoT will be divided into three categories: high, medium, and low relevance. The MAX-MIN scheduling algorithm will be subjected to the TCVC method in order to assess the efficacy of this approach. The influence on algorithm complexity, resource availability, Total Execution Time (TET), Total Waiting Time (TWT), and Total Finish Time (TFT) will be evaluated using the CloudSim simulator.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis on Enhancing Security Through Object Detection using YOLO G
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Traditional security measures often struggle with the timely detection of weapons, making integrating technologies like YOLOv5 (You Only Look Once version 5) vital. This model processes video feeds quickly, allowing security personnel to react promptly to potential threats, thereby potentially saving lives. The focus on integrating such advanced algorithms into surveillance systems can lead to more effective monitoring of public spaces, addressing the rising concerns regarding gun violence and security threats. The application of YOLOv5 in weapon detection significantly enhances public safety by utilizing its advanced deep-learning capabilities for real-time surveillance. YOLOv5 is highly regarded for its ability to balance speed and accuracy, critical for immediate threat identification in security scenarios. This research work explores an innovative method for weapon detection utilizing the YOLO framework, significantly enhancing security in public spaces. As concerns over gun violence grow, the ability to rapidly and accurately identify weapons in real time becomes essential for prevention. The YOLOv5 framework, recognized for its efficiency in object detection, was trained on a custom dataset that included various types of weapons, such as firearms and knives, in diverse settings. Data augmentation techniques were employed to improve the model’s robustness.

articleTitle: Enhancing Data Security with Hybrid Cryptography and Steganography
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the era of rapidly evolving digital threats such as cyber-attacks, ensuring robust data security is most important. The conventional security mechanisms involves algorithms often fails to address emerging vulnerabilities in data protection, specifically in cloud and wireless communication systems. The proposed paper investigates multilayered innovative approach to enhance data security by integrating Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm with Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) as hybrid cryptography. The research aims to address gaps in conventional systems, where single-layered defenses frequently prove inadequate against sophisticated attacks. The proposed research integrates hybrid cryptography with steganography technique which makes secret information unpredictable for unauthorized person or access. The proposed model exhibits significant improvements in data security metrices, with minimal Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 0.00005 and a Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) exceeding 81 dB, far surpassing prior studies. The proposed methodology provides enhanced security, while maintaining minimal visual distortion, therefore, favorable for the IoT and mobile devices constraints environments.

articleTitle: Federated Learning Meets IoT: A Novel Approach to Cardiovascular Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease is one of the most significant causes of mortality worldwide, considering the lives of millions of humans each year. The chance of getting cardiovascular disease rises as people’s life style and their physical health declines. Prediction of this risk can now be achieved by early identification and treatment with the use of ML and AI-based predictive models. With regard to the prediction of cardiovascular disease events in conjunction with IoT devices along with ensemble models combined with federated learning model is suggested to get more performance. This paper explores various methodologies to predict cardiovascular events, emphasizing federated learning (FL) and its application in CVD detection. This paper also reviews the advantages and challenges of federated learning in healthcare along with IoT wearables features & applications.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of EfficientNet-V2 and InceptionNet-V2 for Accurate Kidney Disease Detection Using CT Scans
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A comparative analysis has been performed on two deep learning models for the classification of kidney disease, namely EfficientNet-V2 and InceptionNet-V2. The performance evaluation is done with respect to four types of conditions: Tumor, Cyst, Normal, and Stone. In this study, a dataset of 2,490 images was used. The classification performance of each model was measured by their precision, recall, and F1-score. EfficientNet-V2 yielded an overall accuracy of 89% with a macro-average F1-score of 0.86, while performing exclusively better in detecting cysts: precision of 0.90, recall of 0.95, and F1-score of 0.93. Tumor detection is strong, with an F1-score of 0.91. But the model is relatively less effectual in classifying a kidney as normal, for which it had given an F1-score of 0.77. InceptionNet-V2 achieved 85% accuracy with an average macro F1-score of 0.81. It performed comparatively poorly in classifying normal conditions, reaching a low recall of 0.54 and an F1-score of 0.63. The case of cyst detection had slightly lower results than those from EfficientNet-V2, which yielded an F1-score of 0.89. These results show that both models behave well for the problem, but EfficientNet-V2 gave higher accuracy and good overall performance, especially in tumor and cyst case detection. These results indicate the hope of advanced deep learning techniques improving the current medical diagnostic process of kidney disease.

articleTitle: PalmSense: Real-Time Anemia Detection Using Deep Learning on Palm Images
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Anaemia does pose a challenge to the health sector of the world, especially in resource poor settings where most diagnostic techniques are invasive, expensive, and inaccessible. This study aims to develop a very accurate, non-invasive anaemia detection solution using deep learning models on palm images. Such tests, like blood tests, cannot be implemented in many lowresource settings. It is for this reason that the current research gap, particularly as regards the diagnostic capability of palm images using state-of-the-art deep learning methods, falls within the opportunity that may be contemplated here. This work used the ConvNext Tiny model, trained over a dataset of images taken from the palms of people in Ghana using transfer learning and heavy preprocessing of data, other CNN models including ResNet and VGG16. The results showed that the accuracy for ConvNext Tiny was 96.8% and rendered the highest data accuracy and also provided high speed compared with all other models. This approach promotes early detection of anemia, and not only is this a cost-effective method, but it is also accessible enough to be used in such sites of improving healthcare delivery where resources may be scarce.

articleTitle: Optimizing Marketing Strategies: Predicting Customer Personality using Advanced Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the competition of modern marketing, it is highly important to foresee the correct personality profiles of customers because this may further improve the result of marketing campaigns. Therefore, in this research, three major models of machine learning are used, including Random Forest Classifier, Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Gradient Boosting Classifier, to discuss the challenges of predicting customer personalities. This study is helpful in finding unique customer segments and appropriate marketing strategies. These algorithms are valid to use for classifying customer personalities, and then determine the efficiency of it using the context also proves that through the more complex applications of such approaches, the efficacy of targeted marketing might be enhanced appropriately. Therefore, even more advanced deep learning techniques would be used at the next stage of research to further improve the forecasting accuracy and applicability in various marketing scenarios.

Author Keywords: Random Forest Classifier Support Vector Machine (SVM)

articleTitle: A Qualitative Evaluation of Multiple Quantum Computing Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: With the exponential growth of data and computational needs, traditional computing approaches find them- selves increasingly limited. While quantum computing emerges as a revolutionary alternative that promises solutions beyond the constraints of classical architectures, the proliferation of quantum computing frameworks presents developers with the daunting challenge of selecting the most suitable option. This study exhaustively scrutinizes nine prominent quantum computing frameworks: Cirq, TensorFlow Quantum, Qiskit, Quantum Development Kit (Q#), PennyLane, Amazon Braket, XACC, ProjectQ, and Forest. Thereafter, a comparative study is con- ducted addressing the characteristics, strengths and weaknesses of each framework, providing a nuanced understanding to guide developers in making informed choices. The study bridges the gap in quantum computing literature by offering a detailed exploration of diverse frameworks, thus facilitating the adoption of quantum computing methodologies in a rapidly evolving technological landscape.

articleTitle: Next-Gen Dermatology: Effective Skin Lesion Classification Using EfficientNetV2B0 for Early Detection of Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A common condition needing early identification is skin cancer; this work uses EfficientNetV2B0 for precise lesion classification.The practical application of the EfficientNetV2B0 model for the classification of skin lesions into benign and malignant categories is thoroughly investigated in this research work. Carefully selected to offer a balanced portrayal of both classes, the dataset used in this study consists of high-resolution photographs of skin lesions. Using its compound scaling approach to reach state-of-the-art performance with less parameters than conventional models, the EfficientNetV2B0 architecture was chosen for its demonstrated efficiency and accuracy in image classification applications. Over several epochs, the training process produced an outstanding training accuracy of 96%, which matched a validation accuracy of also $\mathbf{9 6 \%}$. With an accuracy of 1.00 for benign lesions and 95% for malignant lesions, together with a perfect recall of $\mathbf{1 0 0 \%}$ for malignant instances, the precision and recall measures confirmed even more the efficacy of the model. These findings highlight the great possibility of the model for practical uses in dermatology since they provide a consistent instrument for early skin cancer diagnosis and identification. The results imply that the EfficientNetV2B0 model is not only efficient but also quite effective, which opens the path for more investigation on best machine learning approaches for medical image interpretation.

articleTitle: Infectious Disease Detection and Drugs Recommendation Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This paper introduces a machine learning system that combines Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, and Random Forest algorithms to analyze patient data, focusing on symptoms and case histories to predict likely diseases and recommend effective treatments. The objective is to improve early disease detection and personalized medication recommendations, reducing side effects and enhancing clinical judgment. Extensive medical data trains these models, enabling integration with electronic health records to support clinical decisions, which strengthens healthcare delivery. This work contributes to the field by providing a model that increases diagnostic accuracy and offers a tailored treatment plan for individual patients, marking a step towards enhanced personalized healthcare.

articleTitle: SeLCM: An Efficient and Robust Malware Detection Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In today’s era, all aspects of life are digitized and therefore prone to digitized attacks. These days there are various criminal activities that are intended to harm the user in one or the other way. Most of them are based on the internet, computers, or specifically computational resources. These may include phishing, cyber fraud, social engineering, cyberstalking, DDoS attacks, malware, and many more. Some of these crimes target networks or devices, and one of them is malware. In this paper, we have discussed different types of malwares, their comparison, and various malware detection techniques. We have also considered static, dynamic, and hybrid malware analysis in later sections of the paper. Finally, we have proposed a naïve model for malware detection. This research's implications for malware detection with hybrid approaches are discussed.

articleTitle: Enhancing Supply Chain Efficiency through IoT Integration: A Detailed Examination of the Chances and Difficulties
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The adoption of Internet of Things (IoT) technology in supply chain management has brought about noteworthy transformations, boosting productivity, visibility, and evidence-based decision-making. This research investigates the primary reasons for implementing IoT in contemporary supply chains, tackling issues such as limited real-time monitoring, suboptimal inventory control, and the necessity for preemptive risk management. The investigation delves into the capabilities of IoT-driven solutions, including sensor technology, RFID systems, and data analysis tools, to confront these obstacles by enabling constant surveillance and anticipatory maintenance, taking into account the impact of innovative technologies such as blockchain and artificial intelligence. The results underscore the considerable effect of IoT in establishing robust, flexible, and eco-friendly supply chains, providing valuable insights for businesses aiming to improve their operational effectiveness in an increasingly digital landscape.

articleTitle: Load-balancing in Cloud Computing Environment using Hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization and Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Load-balancing is one of the most important parts of cloud computing, ensuring optimized resource use, reduced response times, and high availability. The traditional Round Robin, Throttled, and Least Connection algorithms fail to adapt to dynamic workloads and, therefore, are unable to provide optimal solutions for resource imbalances. This paper represents a hybrid load-balancing algorithm generated by using both PSO and ACO algorithms to overcome such limitations. The proposed Hybrid PSO-ACO algorithm exploits PSO’s strong ability for global search and ACO’s good efficiency for local optimization for the dynamic resource allocation over multiple servers. Key contributions are: robust framework developed for adaptive load distribution; improved effectiveness in task scheduling; and reduction in system bottlenecks. Through simulation, the combined hybrid approach shows drastic improvements in throughput, make span, response time, and resource utilization compared with traditional algorithms, and thus promises to be a good solution for effective load-balancing within cloud computing.

articleTitle: Extensive analysis of IoT Architecture and Access Control Policies in Fog Enabled Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Cloud technology provides solutions to a variety of software platform and data accessibility issues. However, as the industrial revolution 4.0 progresses, innovations such as healthcare 4.0 smart buildings, IoT enabled transportation services, and many other new paradigms necessitate more secure data management solutions. Meanwhile, Fog Computing (FC) arises as a supplement to cloud computing, providing a variety of solutions to issues such as low latency and real-time data transfer. However, security concerns remained, and to address such issues, a regressive access control mechanism approach study was necessary. This article addresses methods to access control mechanisms for preserving privacy and confidentiality during communication in a cloud-fog computing environment. The research goal is to investigate various access control approaches used in the recent past for fog computing enabled environments.

articleTitle: Platform Design for Supply Chain based on Blockchain enabled IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Military blockchain systems are crucial for ensuring secure and resilient operations, particularly in handling sensitive data and withstanding sophisticated cyberattacks. However, existing blockchain models face challenges related to interoperability, onboarding, maintenance costs, and data storage inefficiencies. Current systems lack standardized protocols for seamless communication across different blockchain environments and are expensive to implement, requiring specialized technical expertise. Furthermore, the unbounded nature of data storage on the blockchain can quickly escalate into an unmanageable issue, limiting scalability and long-term efficiency. To address these issues, this project points to create a decentralized, private, and permissioned blockchain model particularly optimized for military applications. By presenting controlled access and permission layers, the proposed model improves interoperability whereas lessening onboarding and support costs through mechanized and streamlined smart contract processes. In addition, advanced data management and archiving techniques are employed to optimize storage, ensuring long-term scalability and efficiency. This solution will not only address the current limitations but also set a new standard for secure and cost-effective blockchain deployment in military environments.

articleTitle: Navigating the Nexus: Women Entrepreneurs Digital Financial Literacy, Perceived Risks and the Technology Acceptance in P2P Lending Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The emergence of fintech platforms is transforming how individuals access financial services. Boosting women’s financial literacy and digital competencies will contribute in nations economic growth. However, SMEs women entrepreneurs struggle with financial literacy and due to lack of digital financial capability and perceived risk, fail to adopt fintech tools to make informed financial decisions. Against this back ground the study aims to inspect the impact of perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use on the usage amongst women towards adoption of peer-to-peer lending platforms in India with digital financial literacy and perceived risk as antecedents affecting the endogenous variables. Primary data through online questionnaire was collected from the women in SMEs. SmartPLS 4.0 was employed to analyse the data and a comprehensive model was designed and tested using structural equation method. The statistical output highlights the digital financial literacy significantly impacts women entrepreneurs’ usage intent of P2P lending platforms with perceived risk having least influence. The study provides valuable insights to various stake holders of P2P lending platforms to understand the apprehensions of women entrepreneurs in availing credit from P2P platforms and device strategies to combat difficulties.

articleTitle: A Review of Machine Learning and Emerging Technologies in Chronic Pain Management
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Chronic pain affects millions globally, significantly diminishing quality of life, mental health, and productivity. Traditional pain management struggles with accurate diagnosis, effective long-term care, and personalization. This review examines recent technological advances in chronic pain treatment, focusing on machine learning, wearable tech, and digital health interventions. By synthesizing recent studies, this review highlights both the strengths of technology-driven interventions and areas requiring further research, aiming to provide actionable insights for advancing chronic pain management through innovative, patient-centered approaches.

articleTitle: Optimizing Lung Cancer Diagnosis Through Dimensionality Reduction and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Globally, lung cancer is a major contributor to cancer-related deaths, making it one of the most fatal forms of the disease, primarily because diagnoses are often made in advanced stages due to the lack of early symptoms. Detecting diseases at an early stage is vital for increasing survival rates, as it significantly enhances treatment effectiveness and patient outcomes. Advances in diagnostic methods, including low-dose CT scans and machine learning models, are essential for detecting lung cancer earlier and improving survival chances. This study presents a system designed to address the challenge of using CT scan images To ensure prompt and accurate identification of lung cancer, a critical tool for identifying potential tumors. The proposed approach integrates UMAP for dimension reduction, which helps in managing the high-dimensional nature of CT scan images, and leverages transfer learning with fine-tuned EfficientNetB3 to enhance classification accuracy and efficiency. Dataset balancing is achieved through augmentation techniques to address class imbalance, a common issue in medical imaging datasets. Refining the parameters of the EfficientNetB3 model with pre-trained ImageNet weights, the model converges faster and delivers superior results. Additionally, a custom callback mechanism dynamically adjusts the learning rate as per the validation loss trends, aiding in the prevention of overfitting and ensuring effective optimization throughout training. The model records an accuracy level of $\mathbf{9 6. 3 \%}$, indicating its potential for accurate lung cancer detection. These results underscore the effectiveness of combining UMAP for dimension reduction, transfer learning, data balancing, and dynamic learning rate adjustments in overcoming the challenges of lung cancer diagnosis through computed tomography (CT) scan data.

articleTitle: The Transformative Impact of AI on HR Functions in the Manufacturing Industry: Navigating Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and automation is causing a notable change in the manufacturing sector, which is about to go through another major change. The several ways that artificial intelligence and automation have affected human resources (HR) in the manufacturing sector is the focus of this research paper Its goal is to throw attention on the chances and difficulties still to arise. This research project employs a mixed-methods approach, combining qualitative interviews with executives from manufacturing firms and human resource professionals with quantitative questionnaires. The results show a scene in which artificial intelligence and automation have already started to change manufacturing industry human resource roles. The automation of jobs like payroll processing and candidate screening for employment has made workforce reallocation and chances for upskill possible. After the study ends, a set of suggestions relevant to legislators, manufacturers, and human resource managers is offered. This emphasizes the need of proactive human resource plans that see artificial intelligence and automation as tools to improve the workforce rather than as tools to replace it. Given the manufacturing sector is becoming an ecosystem shaped by artificial intelligence, this paper provides insightful analysis of the changing function of human resources in controlling the human-AI workforce, so influencing the future of employment in the manufacturing sector.

articleTitle: Leveraging Predictive Analytics of Age Demographics for Engagement and Revenue Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This Research introduces a data-driven approach utilizing machine learning to predict income based on age. Leveraging the Python programming language and libraries such as pandas and sci-kit-learn, the model employs a Gradient Boosting Classifier, Random Forest Classifier, XGBoost Classifier, Support Vector Classifier and Neural Network Classifier. to discern patterns from a provided dataset. The dataset, representative of individual age-income relationships, is split into training and testing subsets to facilitate model validation. Employing hyperparameter tuning, the Random Forest Regressor is trained on the training subset to optimize predictive accuracy. User interaction is integrated, allowing for age input for real-time income prediction. The model’s performance is assessed using an evaluation metric. This research demonstrates the feasibility of employing machine learning techniques for predicting income based on demographic attributes, with potential applications in financial planning and market analysis.] This paper introduces a novel method using machine learning to predict website engagement based on user age. Implemented in Python with NumPy for efficient array operations, the algorithm prompts users to input their age, validating it within 18 to 64 years. Error handling ensures data integrity. The system encapsulates the age input in a NumPy array, feeding it into a pre-trained model to predict website engagement time. The model leverages prior training data to make predictions, providing valuable insights into user behaviour. It gracefully handles age inputs outside the dataset’s range, acknowledging model limitations. Future work may refine the model with additional features for improved accuracy. Overall, this methodology demonstrates machine learning’s efficiency with $\mathbf{9 6 \%} \%$ accuracy in predicting user behaviour based on demographic attributes, with potential applications in web design and content optimization.

articleTitle: Cyberbullying Prevention Mechanism: Integrating AI and Social Media Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Background: Originally used in the modern era to describe the behavior of one person or a small group purpose-fully and forcefully harassing a victim using technology meth-ods, the word cyberbullying (CB) first surfaced. Given CB, which is growing increasingly common, the victim could experi-ence either psychological or physical agony. Though very few studies on these technologies have been done, this creates the av-enue for automated detection systems. This is thus because low datasets or significant feature reduction in CB identification have made these investigations impossible. Methodology: This work presents an integrated model combining engines of social media engine feature extraction and classification. For this model, raw text is the input. Seeking for normal behaviors (CBs), the feature extracting engine considers context, psycho-logical aspects, user comments. The classification engine of a re-current neural network (RNN) orders an output. An evaluation system that either rewards or penalizes the output classified helps one to obtain a categorization. Reinforcement learning (RL) is performed to support the evaluation since it increases classification performance. Findings: To find whether the RNN-RL model produces accurate results, several measures—includ-ing f-measure, recall, precision, and accuracy—will be com-pared to each other. Simulations will assist us success in this re-gard. The results of the simulation show that in degree of classi-fication accuracy the RNN-RL beats traditional machine learn-ing classifiers.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics in Automotive Consumer Behaviour: An Insight into Personal use 4-Wheeler Purchase Decisions
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The automobile industry has experienced a tectonic shift as a result of the proliferation of data and the implementation of predictive analytics, which have revolutionised the comprehension of consumer behaviour. This research, “Predictive Analytics in Automotive Consumer Behaviour: An Insight into Personal Use 4-Wheeler Purchase Decisions,” examines the transformative potential of predictive analytics in comprehending customer preferences and purchasing behaviours within the 4 -wheeler automobile industry. The research is motivated by the pressing necessity for automotive marketers and manufacturers to analyse extensive data sets in order to anticipate consumer preferences, enhance product alignment, and optimise sales strategies. The objective is to develop a comprehensive model that employs predictive analytics to identify behavioural patterns, thereby shedding light on critical factors such as economic circumstances, brand reputation, technological features, and post-purchase interactions. This study underscores the potential of predictive analytics to provide actionable information, enabling automobile businesses to adopt solutions that resonate with specific customer segments, thereby enhancing consumer satisfaction and market competitiveness.

articleTitle: From Classical to Quantum: Evaluating Machine Learning Enhancements
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Quantum computing has been a source of hype in the past few years—especially in its application to machine learning (ML) use-cases. This paper compares QML algorithms to traditional ML for a variety of classification problems yielding an overview on potential applications that quantum technologies can either complement or provide superior performance. The paper begins by outlining the fundamental principles of quantum computing required for its application in machine learning. This article will highlight key ideas such as quantum parallelism and the use of quantum interference in n-computing efficiency. The conversation turns to Quantum machine learning Algorithms, in comparison with Classical algorithms without any further ado and specific quantum algorithmic extensions which are available for the problem of machines. These quantum algorithms are analyzed in terms of computational speed and accuracy, leveraging qubits to potentially accelerate learning processes and achieve improved results. Both the prospects and challenges of quantum algorithms for practical ML applications, by combining empirical data with insights from theory. The study also investigates how these limitations of quantum computing today such as qubit coherence, error rates and scalability are likely to impact the practical deployment of QML. In the final sections, the paper discusses next steps and future directions for quantum machine learning with a focus on potential milestones that could lift current obstacles to merge more deeply classical and quantum tools of data analysis. The article provides an in-depth data-driven perspective on the emerging intersection of these two fields with a view towards their potential future impact within quantum machine learning.

articleTitle: Enhancing Job Satisfaction and Retention in IT Companies Through HR Analytics-Driven Employee Engagement
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Employee retention and satisfaction are critical to organizational success in the highly competitive world of IT (Information Technology) enterprises. Job satisfaction, loyalty, and turnover rates may all be considerably increased by using Human Resource (HR) analytics to promote employee engagement. This research looks at employee engagement, job satisfaction, as well as retention intentions in the IT industry using a quantitative survey approach supported by descriptive and inferential statistics. Data was gathered from 500 workers in a variety of jobs inside IT companies using a stratified random sample technique, offering a thorough summary of the major variables affecting employee happiness and engagement. Descriptive statistics were used to show trends in employee satisfaction, while inferential statistics were employed to examine the relationships between work-life balance, career development opportunities, leadership quality, as well as employee retention. The value of HR analytics in enhancing retention is also examined in the research, with conflicting views found. According to the survey’s results, employee satisfaction fluctuates, with $\mathbf{2 0 \%}$ to $\mathbf{3 0 \%}$ of workers reporting high levels of satisfaction in areas like work-life balance and career advancement and a significant portion staying unhappy or indifferent. Additionally, $\mathbf{3 0 . 0 0 \%}$ of respondents agree that HR analytics significantly affects retention, although many workers think its full potential has not yet been reached. Future studies might examine how to further improve employee engagement and retention tactics in IT organizations by integrating machine learning algorithms with sophisticated HR analytics technologies.

articleTitle: A Novel Deep Learning Approach for Real Time and Accurate Sign Language Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Sign language translation is a vital technology for facilitating communication between people who cannot understand sign language and others who have hearing impairments.. While several models have been developed for sign language translation, many face limitations such as inadequate accuracy, inability to handle complex signs, and lack of real-time translation capabilities. This paper presents a Sign language translation system designed help reduce the gap in communication between the deaf and hearing communities. The primary objective is to develop an efficient and accurate translator that creates animations in sign language from spoken language, making communication in real-time more accessible for those who are hard of hearing. The system combines Long Short-Term Memory networks for recognition of speech and Convolutional Neural Networks for image-based sign generation, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 98%. Through Natural Language Processing (NLP), the recognized text is filtered and matched with predefined sign language phrases. If a match is found, the system plays an animation corresponding to the phrase; otherwise, it displays each letter individually. This dual-mode approach ensures flexibility in translation, catering to both common phrases and unique words. The high accuracy and adaptability of this system demonstrate its potential as a powerful instrument for improving accessibility and inclusion in daily communication. Results from experiments show that the suggested model performs better than current methods in terms of accuracy, robustness, and real-time performance. Through rigorous evaluation on benchmark datasets and user studies, the model achieves significant improvements in sign language translation accuracy, effectively closing the communication gap between the general public and those who are hearing impaired. In conclusion, the proposed sign language translation model represents a promising advancement in the field, offering enhanced accuracy and real-time capabilities compared to existing approaches. This technology has the potential to significantly increase the deaf and hard of hearing community’s accessibility and inclusivity in various contexts, including education, healthcare, and everyday communication.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis on Food Supply Chain Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Blockchain technology can revolutionize SCM by looking at its adoption within the agriculture industry. Much of the long-standing problems in traditional SCM systems relate to inefficiencies, a lack of transparency, product counterfeiting, and cybersecurity flaws that disrupt consumer safety and trust. This paper focuses on the integration of blockchain technology in SCM and its main application in the agricultural sector. This innovation, by providing better information exchange between the stakeholders and secure record-keeping with higher traceability, holds great promise for promoting higher trust and responsibility within the supply chain. However, several barriers exist-including legislative uncertainty, interoperability problems, and even a general lack of awareness among the participants in the industry that are creating a delay in the mainstream adoption of the blockchain. Further, this paper also analyzes the future perspective of SCM and Blockchain. Real-time insights, improvements in operational efficiency, and process optimization are better achieved through integrating blockchain technology with IoT and AI. Utilizing these cuttingedge technologies can lead to a major boom in improving food safety, authenticity, and general customer confidence levels in the agriculture supply chain. The last aspect of this research is showing exactly how important it is that these cutting-edge technologies be applied to solve the problems with contemporary supply chain management in the agriculture industry that employs blockchain in the Food Supply Chain to deliver a complete picture of farmers, goods, and merchants. This model provides a blockchain technique and smart contract for checking and certifying many attributes at each stage of the food supply chain.

articleTitle: AI-driven Credit Scoring System for Real-Time Credit Card Approval in Banking
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The AI-driven Credit Scoring System for Real-Time Credit Card Approval in Banking is an advanced system that leverages the power of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms to completely transform the credit card approval process within the banking industry. The innovative system automatizes and simplifies the old credit scoring methods, giving an accurate real-time approval for a credit card. It then processes this data, including the financial history and customers’ spending habits, along with credit, it scores in machine learning algorithms from which it would generate a unique credit score tailored to each applicant. That score is continually refreshed, so their decision can be made using the freshest information possible. The system processes an applicant’s risk profile. It identifies their creditworthiness using AI algorithms, eliminating manual review while reducing the time and resources needed to approve a credit card. This speeds up and improves the decision-making process for both bank staff and customers. Additionally, the AI-powered Credit Scoring System continues to learn and improve on new data so that banks can always provide up-to-date credit scoring to reflect market trends accurately. Additionally, for the banks — This technology not only enhances customer experience but also lowers trust risk (i.e. lower defaulting probability).

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Contextual Bug Detection and Automated Fixes in Software Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Modern software systems are becoming more and more complicated, which calls for sophisticated techniques to ensure code quality and dependability. The subtleties of complex software systems are difficult for traditional techniques to problem discovery and fixing to handle as they frequently rely on manual code reviews and static analysis tools. With a new focus on context-aware bug identification, this research explores the use of deep learning models to automate the detection and correction of problems in software code. The suggested models are made to find issues in the context of the software system by using a huge dataset of code annotated with bug information and associated remedies, together with metadata like project architecture, dependencies, and runtime circumstances. Various neural network architectures, including transformers and graph neural networks (GNNs), are explored to capture both the syntactic and semantic aspects of code while considering the contextual interactions between different code modules. This context-aware approach enhances the model’s ability to detect bugs that may arise from the interaction between components, runtime behaviors, or specific usage scenarios often missed by traditional methods. Additionally, the integration of these models into continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines is examined, enabling real-time bug detection and automated patch generation. The proposed system aims to improve code quality, reduce debugging time, and minimize human intervention, accelerating the software development lifecycle. Preliminary results demonstrate that the inclusion of contextual information significantly improves the accuracy and relevance of bug detection and fixing, paving the way for more robust and self-healing software systems.

articleTitle: Bilinear Pooling with Hierarchical Structure for Precise Visual Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Computer vision is continuously advancing in the field of accurate visual representation. Deep learning architectures such as ResNet50 and pooling algorithms have been crucial to this process. In this study, a pioneering approach called Bilinear Pooling with Hierarchical Structure is introduced to enhance the visual recognition accuracy. Using ResNet50 the method incorporates hierarchical pooling using the ReLU activation function. This new combination improves both feature representation and the accuracy with which complex visual details are captured. Through the hierarchical organization of pooling the layers, multi-scale contextual information is efficiently extracted. Through training, it is shown that the proposed framework is effective in producing notable performance improvements. The results highlight the potential benefits of this method.

articleTitle: Optimizing Tag-Based Image Search: A Social Re-Ranking Strategy for Enhanced Relevance and Diversity
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The paper introduces a social re-ranking system for tag-based image retrieval to optimize search results’ relevance and diversity. It tackles the challenge of ensuring that the top-ranked images are relevant and diverse by accounting for visual, semantic, and social dimensions. The retrieval process begins with images sourced based on user-contributed tags, likely triggered by a user-entered search query. Following this, the images are ranked according to the contributions of the users who uploaded them, with users contributing more significantly to the query ranking higher. This step suggests that images from these top-ranking users are considered more relevant to the search. An additional re-ranking occurs Within each user’s set of images, designed to maintain diversity and prevent numerous similar images from the same user from dominating the results. The selected images from this intra-user re-ranking phase form the final output, offering a mix of relevant and diverse content. This process likely involves indexing images using associated tags and metadata. The method’s performance and efficiency are validated through experimental tests on a Flickr dataset. Overall, this approach offers a comprehensive solution to critical challenges in tag-based image retrieval on social media platforms, as it thoughtfully integrates both inter-user and intra-user considerations to enhance the user experience with more relevant and diverse results.

articleTitle: Intent to Invest in P2P Lending Platform: An Extended Technology Acceptance Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Peer to peer lending platform is a part of micro financing, used by people to lend and borrow small loans. There has been a significant progress and growth in the P2P lending marketplace in recent years. However, investors carry apprehensions about investing in the platform and it becomes imperative to understand the investment intentions of the lenders in the P2P market. This study attempts to identify the dynamics impelling investors intent to invest in Peer-to-Peer lending platform in India using extended Technology Acceptance Model. Structured questionnaire as primary source of data collection was used to achieve the objectives and exploratory factor analysis has been employed to ascertain the dominant constructs affecting the investors intent. Trust propensity and perceived risk showed a significant impact on intent to invest on P2P platforms. The study contributes a significant theoretical framework to the decision-makers and other associated stakeholders of the P2P lending platforms.

articleTitle: Chronic Kidney Disease Classification Using Machine Learning Methodology: Investigating Predictive Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is one of the most acute health disease globally, as it generally progresses so silently until the advanced stage is reached. There is a need for timely detection and intervention for adequate management and improvement in patient outcomes. This study explores whether it is possible to accurately classify CKD using machine learning techniques. We used the two most commonly used classification algorithms-KNN and SVM-to classify a vast dataset based on several clinical parameters. The performances of the models were evaluated utilizing standard metrics such as accuracy of $\mathbf{9 5. 3 4 \%}$ for SVM and $\mathbf{9 0. 6 9 \%}$ for KNN, precision of $\mathbf{9 4. 7 3 \%}$ for SVM and $\mathbf{9 2. 4 6 \%}$ for KNN, F1-score of $\mathbf{9 5. 3 8 \%}$ for SVM and $\mathbf{9 0. 6 9 \%}$ for KNN and Recall of $\mathbf{9 6. 1 5 \%}$ for SVM and $\mathbf{9 2. 3 0 \%}$ for KNN. Our findings clearly demonstrate that SVM outperforms KNN in classification performance metrics. The superior performance of SVM can be attributed to its ability to identify optimal decision boundaries, even in complex and high-dimensional datasets. This work contributed to the growing body of literature on machine learning applications in healthcare. By applying advanced algorithms and robust evaluation techniques, we have developed a promising predictive model for classification for CKD. These findings could assist healthcare professionals in the earlier detection of those at risk of progression so that early intervention can be applied, with a corresponding better chance of influencing treatment decisions.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Enhanced Pneumonia Detection Using Deep Learning Techniques on Chest X-Rays
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Pneumonia is one of the leading causes of morbidity and mortality all over the world. Its early and appropriate diagnosis is extremely important for effective management. Traditional detection of pneumonia from chest X-rays heavily relies on the proficiency of expert radiologists, which is very time-consuming and prone to variability. This article presents an advanced deep learning approach for enhanced capabilities in pneumonia detection from chest X-ray images. This paper proposes a new CNN architecture optimized by extensive hyperparameter tuning and data augmentation techniques for improving accuracy and robustness in pneumonia detection. Our model was trained and validated on a large labeled dataset of chest X -ray images, outperforming conventional methods in detection performance. The results have shown improved accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity in the detection. We also discuss how different deep learning methods, such as transfer learning and ensemble methods, affect the performance of the models. The current study has shown the potential of deep learning for the automation and augmentation of pneumonia diagnosis, thus fostering the development of more efficient and reliable diagnostic tools in clinical practice.

articleTitle: Leveraging IoT for Enhanced Industrial Automation: Innovations and Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The IoT is a relatively new and exciting field in computer science that is expanding rapidly worldwide. Background: IoT has seen substantial growth due to advancements in wireless networking, enhanced sensors, and IoT platforms, as well as the convergence of cloud and edge computing. Objective: The paper aims to assess the innovations in IoT, evaluate their applications in industrial automation, and identify key challenges and opportunities for further research. Methods: The review covers recent advancements, such as the application of Federated Learning for enhancing IoT security, the use of large-scale blockchains for data integrity, and the integration of digital twins and containerisation in robotics. Key areas of industrial application, including predictive maintenance, supply chain management, and real-time environmental control, are explored. Results: The findings highlight significant improvements in cost savings, reliability, and safety through IoT in industrial automation. However, challenges such as network generalization, real-world applicability, and efficient resource usage remain. Conclusion: More effective and dependable systems might be the result of future research that tackles these issues and increases the influence of IoT technology in industrial automation.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Approaches for Multiple Sclerosis Detection and Monitoring: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Multiple Sclerosis (MS) is a chronic disease of the central nervous system in which it is affected through inflammation and damage of the myelin sheath to some degree of disability. Diagnosis and follow-up should both be accurate since they enable clinicians to manage the disease and treatment plans. Manual and qualitative approaches towards segmenting the multiple sclerosis lesions have major disadvantages of being time consuming and present a high intra-observer variability, which draws the need for new and more accurate methods. Significant advancement has been made in Medical Imaging particularly Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) in combination with Artificial Intelligence (AI) based approaches in the recent past. This paper briefly reviews updated development in the AI based methods to diagnose the MS, with a focus on enhancing the diagnostic reliability and follow up the disease course. This work looks at various categories of Machine intelligence approaches, including the basic Machine learning and advanced Deep learning models to analyse the application of the models in medical image analysis. Furthermore, the survey explores the issues related to data variation and class imbalance and underlines the necessity of the public dataset and appropriate measurement tools to develop these technologies. Future improvement strategies are proposed to improve the model’s precision, transportation, and clinical interpretability to apply these sophisticated approaches as an accurate therapeutic trial in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Ripple Effect: Examining the Interaction Between Cyberattacks and Environmental Damage
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Cyberattacks are increasingly targeting critical infrastructure, leading to significant disruptions not only in digital systems but also in environmental management and sustainability. This paper examines the ripple effect of cyberattacks on environmental systems, highlighting both direct impacts-such as damage to monitoring and control systems and indirect consequences, including the exacerbation of ecological degradation. Through detailed case studies of recent incidents, we analyze the vulnerabilities of essential services like water supply, energy production, and waste management. Additionally, we explore risk assessment methodologies and propose frameworks for integrating cybersecurity and environmental resilience, emphasizing the need for holistic strategies to mitigate potential threats to both technological and ecological systems.

articleTitle: The Smart Prediction of Stroke Risk with Artificial Intelligence based algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Stroke is a main cause of lengthy-term incapacity and a primary contributor to mortality internationally. Therefore, as it should be predicting strokes in a timely manner is critical for powerful preventive care and medical control. The use of artificial intelligence (AI) primarily based algorithms to expect stroke chance is a promising technique in this regard. Algorithms such as deep learning networks, Naϊve Bayes classifiers, Random Forests, aid Vector Machines and Bayesian networks are increasingly utilized in clinical programs, such as accurately assessing stroke threat. Such algorithms are able to extract features from clinical statistics and massive statistics that may be used to predetermine the threat of stroke accurately. This fact may be used to inform preventive care and to come across sufferers that require on the spot medical interest. AI-based stroke danger prediction algorithms normally outperform conventional strategies with the aid of presenting greater correct effects and identifying diffused relationships between hazard elements. AI-based totally stroke threat prediction algorithms contain the implementation of numerous strategies, inclusive of pre-processing of the records, which involves data cleansing, normalization, and reduction; characteristic engineering, which involves selecting and processing applicable statistics on chance factors; and model selection, which includes identifying the most suitable model for prediction.

articleTitle: Eco-friendly Smart Sensor Adjustment using Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Today’s networking and telecommunications industries greatly benefit from the growth of highly sturdy and energy-effective Internet of Things through communication sensors. Device efficiency may be increased while sensor energy consumption is reduced by calibrating sensors to use less power. Reinforcement learning (RL), which has garnered significant interest from researchers, is being widely applied to achieve intelligent automation in several academic disciplines today. Resource optimization has not received much attention in research, despite the Internet of Things using a large variety of sensors. By investigating a revolutionary approach to power conservation with the use of reinforcement learning, the creative study aims to produce a novel generation of Internet of Things with standardized power sources to optimize source consumption. A closed-grid, numerous power source controlling system for sensor consumption has been revealed. Our recommended strategy, which uses Deep Q learning, can help Internet of Things sensors optimize their operation. This study focused only on energy-effective sensor and simulation results show that the planned approach works well.

articleTitle: Enhanced Emotional Speech Analysis Using Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In an era of increasing digital communication, this application meets a critical demand for accurate, automated emotion analysis in fields such as psychology, social sciences, marketing, and customer feedback. By employing a deep learning model trained on an annotated dataset of diverse emotional expressions, the application delivers a reliable and efficient emotion classification solution. Users can easily input text or audio for analysis via a user-friendly web interface. Audio input is first transcribed to text, after which all text undergoes preprocessing to enhance recognition accuracy by minimizing noise. The system displays predicted emotions intuitively, offering insights into the emotional undertones within the text. Its high accuracy, flexible design, and compatibility with audio input make the application a powerful resource for understanding complex emotional patterns in language, contributing both academic and practical value across sectors and advancing the capabilities of digital emotion analysis tools. The Emotion Classification Web Application, developed with Python and Flask, provides an advanced tool for analyzing and classifying emotions from both typed and audio-converted text inputs, achieving a high accuracy of 96.75% using a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) model with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) capabilities.

articleTitle: Hand Gesture Desktop Control with Python
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: With the rapid progress of technology, traditional presenting styles sometimes fail to engage audiences effectively. The search for new ways to improve user engagement has been spurred by the growing need for interactive and user-friendly presentation technologies. To create an interactive presentation system, this project makes use of computer vision and hand gesture detection. The system records live video input from a webcam and process it using OpenCV for image processing and the CvZone library for hand tracking, enabling smooth slide navigation and annotation. The main goal for this is to create a user interface that is controlled through hand gestures, which would allow speakers to control their slide presentations. This not only helps with how session agendas are managed, but it also provides a better experience for the audience. In addition, the system eliminates the need for traditional input devices like keyboards and remotes making it a more user-friendly and intuitive way to control presentations. The idea for this project originates from the necessity to improve communication quality under different conditions (for instance, for educational purposes or business dives), with the intention that interactive presentations can adequately enhance people not only learning and understanding but also their involvement in audience life. By combining real-time video processing with the ability to track hand movements, we aim to provide a novel way of interacting in space that is both dynamic and user-oriented.

articleTitle: Enhancing Intrusion Detection Systems through Advanced Feature Engineering and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This study investigates enhancing intrusion detection systems (IDS) through machine learning and advanced feature engineering. I evaluate classification algorithms, including k-nearest neighbors (KNN) and support vector machines (SVM), on the ADFA-LD 12 dataset, finding that SVMs, especially with two-sequence feature spaces, outperform other methods. A detailed analysis of linear and sigmoid kernels shows that the two-sequence space improves detection accuracy, with recursive feature elimination identifying optimal performance with fewer than 240 features. One-class SVMs, used for outlier detection, perform poorly. The study underscores the potential of SVMs and suggests further research into scalable algorithms and improved kernel methods for unsupervised detection.

articleTitle: IoT-Enhanced Machine Learning Approach for Early Detection and Prediction of Urinary Tract Infection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Millions of people worldwide suffer from urinary tract infections (UTIs), which are a common and recurring health problem. In order to limit possible health problems and stop the spread of disease, early identification and prompt management are essential. In order to overcome this issue, the Internet of Things and machine learning techniques are combined in the novel approach presented in this study. The suggested method continually monitors real-time vital signs and urine biomarkers using IoT-enabled wearable and smart sensors. Principle Component Analysis feature selection approaches are used to optimize the pertinent data inputs in order to improve the accuracy of UTI prediction. A centralized ML-driven processing unit is used to perform complex ML algorithms, such as the Ensemble Bagging Decision Tree Classifier classification model, to analyses and decipher the patterns of the gathered data. The technology reliably recognizes and anticipates UTIs, sending early warning signals to patients and medical professionals. In order to improve patient care and public health outcomes, our ML-IoT fusion in UTI detection offers a non-intrusive and proactive technique. The suggested EBDTC technique outperforms the existing approaches with an accuracy rate of $\mathbf{9 6. 2 5 \%}$. The results of the study demonstrate how disruptive technology has the ability to successfully treat common health issues, expanding the area of healthcare diagnostics.
