articleTitle: Revitalizing Cultural Heritage Through Augmented Reality: Lessons from the Ashoka Pillar
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Augmented Reality(AR) technology may assist cultural asset conservation and enhancement, using India’s Ashoka Pillar as a case study. Augmented reality may view historical relics like India’s Ashoka Pillar. The work will produce augmented reality software to mimic the Ashoka Pillar’s complex construction and highlight its cultural worth. We want to make cultural history more engaging, accessible, and participatory for local and global audiences. Multidisciplinary AR app development engages consumers with interactive, aural, and visual elements. Tool integration, system optimization, and UX design were done in Unity 3D, Blender 3D, Photoshop, and Vuforia. This technique explains immersive app development technological issues and frames augmented reality development concerns. This study synthesizes scholarly works on AR and cultural preservation and comprehension. ARdriven heritage market trends, difficulties, and potential are covered in this literature review to build new solutions. Contributes in numerous ways. Augmented reality can enhance tourist experiences, engage cultural assets, and sustain heritage sites. This study underlines the necessity for scholars, developers, cultural organizations, and local communities to collaborate on augmented reality for cultural preservation and education. It offers realistic recommendations for scholars, professionals, and public officials preserving historical treasures with immersive technology. This research shows how AR technology maintains, educates, and celebrates culture, for future generations.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Interpret Multiclass Skin Disease Using Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Skin diseases represent a major public health issue, where accurate diagnosis before treatment is crucial. Despite this, the complexity of multiclass skin disease classification compounded by the absence of large and comprehensive datasets, presents challenges in developing reliable diagnostic models. Current solutions are normally not explainable, resulting in healthcare professionals not trusting models. To address these challenges, a novel approach incorporating Explainable AI is proposed to improve both the interpretability and performance of skin disease classification. Using over 10,015 dermatoscopic images across 7 disease classes, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), including XceptionNet and ResNet50, are applied after thorough research of existing works. The performance is then assessed through accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. The experimental results show that XceptionNet achieves superior accuracy with 82.2% compared to ResNet50 provided a better accuracy score of 78.2%. To enhance interpretability, Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) are incorporated as visual aids, which highlight the regions of the image that contribute most to the model’s predictions, making the predictions more comprehensible than using Black-box deep learning. This approach not only improves classification accuracy but also enhances trustworthiness through increased transparency. Future work will focus on image overlay in real-time video feed, improving data collections to make the models stronger, and designing a multiple-object occupancy deep learning model for applications with higher complexity.

articleTitle: Performance Metrics Analysis for Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Evaluating an Information Retrieval (IR) model is a multi-faceted process that requires selecting the right quantitative metrics to assess performance. The selection of evaluation metrics in IR depends on specific tasks, relevant standards, and desired characteristics. To thoroughly assess an IR system’s performance, a combination of metrics is necessary. This study explores the effectiveness of deep learning (DL) models in semantic and personalized information retrieval (SIR), focusing on BERT and other large language models (LLMs) that provide context-sensitive embeddings and advanced language comprehension capabilities. Through a detailed analysis, this paper demonstrates how DL models can significantly enhance accuracy and relevance in IR, using evaluation metrics critical for assessing model performance. Metrics like recall, precision, and F1-score are key in capturing model accuracy and coverage; for example, a recall of $\mathbf{1. 0}$ indicates complete retrieval of relevant instances, while a precision of 0.6 reflects a $\mathbf{6 0 \%}$ accuracy in positive predictions, balancing these measures at an F1-score of 46.15%. Ranking and prioritization metrics, such as Mean Average Precision (MAP) and Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG), evaluated at 91.67% and 95.1%, respectively highlight the models’ capabilities in prioritizing relevant results effectively. In personalized and semantic search, selecting the right evaluation metrics is essential to maximize DL model potential and improve the user experience. Recent LLM advancements, like GPT-4, are instrumental in capturing nuanced meanings and understanding complex user queries, which enhances the accuracy of search engines. Continuous optimization of these models through tailored metrics can improve IR systems’ contextual relevance and accuracy, fostering greater user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Investigating Fault-Tolerance Techniques for Protecting Cyber-Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Cyber-physical systems (CPSs) gift a unique set of protection demanding situations because they rely on a huge and various set of digital additives. To protect CPSs from cyber-attacks, fault-tolerance techniques, inclusive of redundancy and diversity, can help to mitigate the chance of assault. The purpose of this study is to analyze the capability advantages of several fault-tolerance techniques and provide a comprehensive assessment of their effectiveness in securing CPSs. It is going to examine the impacts of different techniques on system safety, security, availability, and reliability. Furthermore, the paper will present a standard dialogue of the ability trade-offs and costs associated with distinctive fault-tolerance techniques and provide tips for deciding on the maximum appropriate method to satisfy the required level of security. This research will offer treasured perception into the relevant subjects, facilitating the development of at ease CPSs.

articleTitle: A Secure Framework of Internet of Production for Data Exchange
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The Internet of Production (IoP) is changing the manufacturing industry by helping companies work more efficiently, increase profits, and speed up product delivery. However, ensuring secure communication among different stakeholders in various supply chains is a major challenge that affects data sharing and collaboration. This study presents a strong framework that uses blockchain technology to improve secure communication among these stakeholders. The motivation for this research comes from the growing need for better security measures in the IoP, especially as the amount of data being exchanged increases. At the heart of this framework is a new algorithm designed to enhance both security and efficiency in data exchanges. Testing with the Automated Validation of Internet Security Protocols and Applications tool shows that the algorithm is safe from replay and man-in-themiddle attacks. Additionally, an analysis using the Burrows-Abadi-Needham method confirms that it provides mutual authentication among stakeholders. Performance analysis indicates that the algorithm achieves faster execution times ($\sim 18$ milliseconds) compared to existing methods, while its communication time is transitional ($\sim 5152$ bits), marking a significant improvement in the field. This work significantly contributes to the field by providing a secure and efficient solution for cross-domain communication in the IoP.

articleTitle: Technology Readiness and Its Impact on the Intention to Use the Metaverse for Banking Services
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The present study investigates the role of discomfort, insecurity, as inhibitors and innovativeness, optimism as contributors in the technology readiness of the prospective bank customers impacting the usage intent of banking services on metaverse, by employing technology readiness model. Statistical tool SmartPLS 4.0 was applied to analyse the primary data collected through structured questionnaire to project an integrated model demonstrating the technology readiness dynamic elements influencing the usage intention of banking on metaverse. The study findings highlight the statistically significant correlation of innovativeness and insecurity influencing usage intention and insignificant association of optimism and discomfort affecting bank customers usage intention of banking on metaverse. The study offers valuable insights to bankers, policy makers and associate stakeholders to assess the apprehensions of customers to use metaverse in availing bank services and devise strategies to combat difficulties.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Algorithms in Predicting Mental Disorders
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Mental disorders include a range of psychiatric diseases, involving stress, trauma, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), neurocognitive disorders, panic disorder, obsessive compulsive disorder (OCD), autism spectrum disorder (ASD), substance-addictive disorder, bipolar disorder, neurodevelopmental disorder, schizophrenia, and sexual dysfunctions. These are related to unfavorable health behaviors like disturbed sleeping patterns, poor diet, poverty, unemployment, some unusual life events, and higher addiction rates. Of late, depression, anxiety, and bipolar disorders are ruling the world and have become more prominent among the youth belonging to high-income nations. Depression is the most common disease in clinical practice, leading to occupational, social, interpersonal, and financial problems. However, Machine learning (ML) is becoming the main cause of the Big Data insurgence. It has captured applications in diverse domains, for instance, industries, pharmacy, medicinal chemistry, waste treatment plants, social networking, management, robotics, digital advertisements, physiological signal monitoring, electronic health record (EHR), medical & pathological imaging, and smart sensors. These techniques are computer-based equipped on automation, development, adaptation, prediction, and interpretation of the result by the machine. In this context, this review pertains the recent literature information about the real time prediction of various types of mental disorders using machine learning approach. Adaboost predicted depression with $\mathbf{9 2. 5} \%$ accuracy and 93.6 % specificity. Moreover, XGBoost was applied for post stroke depression. Otherwise RNN could be utilized depression from EEG brain wave data. While SVM was explored for androgenic alopecia, However, RF model was evaluated for anxiety.

articleTitle: GREEN GUARDIAN: IOT Driven Water Management for Sustainable Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Water scarcity is the most persistent problem on earth, especially in agriculture, due to inefficiency in its usage which reflects on the health and productivity of crops. This paper aims to propose a Smart Irrigation System that could save water better and consume resources much better. The system includes capacitive moisture soil sensors; temperature and humidity sensors with IoT-based protocol communication that relays conditions live. The methodology uses machine learning algorithms to generate predictions over time for the water requirement of different species of plants according to their seasonal behaviours. This led the tests to decline water intakes between 30 and 40, thus furthering the view of a sustainable agriculture way of life. This system has an intercommunication interface with the smartphone, meaning it can be set from afar and its scheduling changed with minimal on-site manual monitoring. This technology can easily scale up to work on a range of crops and climatic conditions, hence highly applicable in agriculture. It also does not interfere with already laid sprinkler and drip irrigation systems as such; hence it is easy to adapt the already existing infrastructure. Further studies will be on AI-based models of weather forecasting that will even improve their level of accuracy. Intelligent irrigation systems help to save water through proper health and increased productivity in agriculture because this corrects many and severe problems in the agricultural sector.

articleTitle: TuneTalk: Fusion of Music and Integrated Voice Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In an era where digital communication and entertainment converge, there is a growing need for platforms that offer seamless integration and enhanced user experience. TuneTalk is designed to bridge this gap by combining voice communication with music streaming into a unified platform. Motivated by the fragmentation between communication tools and entertainment apps, TuneTalk addresses key challenges such as the lack of synergy between music and conversation, user privacy, and interface complexity. The core objective is to streamline interactions, allowing users to effortlessly switch between calls, texts, and music, while maintaining a cohesive and secure experience. The platform's unique contribution lies in its personalized music recommendations, robust encryption for secure communication, and a simplified, user-friendly interface. TuneTalk not only enhances convenience but also redefines how users engage with communication and entertainment, offering an all-in-one solution that caters to modern digital lifestyles.

articleTitle: LSTM Neural Networks for Brain Signals and Neuromorphic Chip
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) is a type of RNN architecture commonly employed in natural language processing, speech recognition, and various sequence modeling applications. A normal recurrent neural network (RNN), which features a simple architecture of input, hidden state, and output, an LSTM is distinguished by a more complex structure that incorporates supplementary memory cells and gates. This architecture allows the LSTM to selectively retain or discard information from previous time steps. The fundamental component of these devices is a memory cell, which has two input gates, one output gate, and a forget gate. These gates manage the inflow and outflow of data, allowing LSTMs to choose to retain or eliminate information. The articles concentrate on the hardware chip design of the LSTM-like mechanism in neuromorphic systems, which incorporates two LSTM layers and processes eight neurons together with their weights in Xilinx ISE 14.7 and simulates the design for logic verification test cases. LSTM networks could inspire neuromorphic technologies that process time-sensitive information and memory like the brain. The novelty of the work is in the scalable hardware chip design and its performance is synthesized on the FPGA that supports the frequency 570.00 MHz. The design has shown the optimal performance in terms of parameters such as delay, frequency, memory, flip flops, and IoBs onVirtex-5 FPGA for scalable LSTM that is tested up to 64 neurons. The hybrid architecture is based on two intermediate LSTM layers processing 8 neurons in a single slot.

articleTitle: Influencers as Strategic Gatekeepers: Leveraging Business Intelligence in the OTT Market
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The shift from conventional television broadcasts to over-the-top (OTT) digital streaming services has significantly transformed media consumption habits in India. As OTT platforms gain popularity, influencers have emerged as pivotal gatekeepers, shaping content preferences and influencing subscription decisions. This study explores the role of influencers in mediating content on OTT platforms through the lens of Two-Step Flow Theory, with a particular focus on business intelligence applications. Utilizing a qualitative research approach employing the Gioia method, the authors analyzed the experiences and opinions of 20 participants to understand how influencers impact consumer behavior on OTT platforms. The findings reveal that influencers significantly affect content discovery, trust, and subscription intentions by acting as intermediaries between OTT platforms and consumers. Key themes identified include content curation, interpretation, social proof, and cultural representation, aligning with the Two-Step Flow Theory. This advances the theoretical framework of influencer-driven marketing within the digital media landscape. It offers practical insights for OTT service providers to enhance user engagement and retention strategies through data-driven approaches.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Aggregation Network with Edge Guidance for Sturdy Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are essential for medical picture segmentation in clinical analysis and illness detection. On the other hand, noise levels and intraclass variability are considerable in medical photos, but interclass differences are negligible. It is difficult to extract strong contextual information and combine discriminative characteristics for fine-grained segmentation. Current techniques are unable to produce precise mask edges, resulting in fuzzy borders and decreased segmentation precision. In this research, a new A Hierarchical Aggregation Network with Edge Guidance that maintains precise spatial features and gathers rich contextual information is presented. The Efficient Fusion Attention Module is used by the proposed model to highlight important spatial and channel information, the Adaptive Hierarchical Feature Aggregation Module to maximize feature fusion, and the Inter-layer Edge-aware Module to improve edge prediction accuracy. Experimentally and qualitatively, the proposed method will perform better than six other cutting-edge segmentation techniques.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Accurate Histopathological Classification of Lung and Colon Cancer Using CNN and EfficientNetB3 Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This research work suggests a quick way to sort histopathological pictures of lung and colon cancers by using two deep learning models: a custom CNN and EfficientNetB3. In this respect, the proposed models were trained using a large dataset of both cancerous and benign tissues and tested for accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The CNN model showed an overall accuracy of $\mathbf{9 9 \%}$, demonstrating its capability in differentiating between various types of cancers and benign conditions. EfficientNetB3 further optimized the performance, yielding $\mathbf{9 8 \%}$ accuracy with well-balanced metrics for all the classes with a high score in recognizing lung and colon adenocarcinoma and benign tissues. Robustness and good generalization on unseen data are further indicative of their potential clinical diagnostic utility. Steps for the future: rank pruning of slight misclassifications and application extension to other cancers than those under consideration by incorporating additional data and using advanced techniques, including transfer learning for real-time diagnostic support and detection at earlier cancer stages in healthcare.

articleTitle: InvestMate: A Hybrid AI-Driven Financial Chatbot for Personalized Stock Predictions and Investor Education
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In order to assist new traders in making wellinformed inventory investment decisions, this paper provides InvestMate, a sophisticated conversational chatbot pushed via artificial intelligence. In contrast to conventional economic consulting systems, InvestMate meets the getting to know and selection-making needs of newbie traders by using fusing interactive education with individualized advice. In order to offer personalized stock guidelines which are consistent with each person’s monetary targets and possibilities, the chatbot algorithms for short-and medium-term predictions. This combination enables the chatbot to provide consistent, datadriven insights across varying collects user inputs consisting of funding quantity, target term, and threat tolerance. To achieve robust prediction accuracy, InvestMate employs a dual-model approach using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for long-term forecasting and Random Forest investment horizons, whether the user is planning for a few months or several years. The two-model strategy ensures a balance between capturing historical patterns with LSTM’s sequential memory capacity and leveraging the robustness of ensemble methods, as found in the Random Forest model, for more immediate, shorter-term analysis. In addition to offering inventory tips, InvestMate actively promotes economic literacy by means of teaching customers in key ideas like marketplace indicators, threat control, diversification, and fundamental studies. The chatbot’s prediction models are trained on an extensive dataset containing 1,962 CSV files of stock data from the National Stock Exchange (NSE), encompassing stocks up to March 15, 2024. This comprehensive dataset allows InvestMate to learn from diverse market conditions and adapt its recommendations to current trends and patterns, enhancing reliability and relevance. In addition to helping new investors make better investment decisions, InvestMate also acts as a friendly investment coach, bridging knowledge gaps for people unfamiliar with the stock market complexity by providing an interactive, educational tool that builds confidence and practical knowledge for inexperienced investors.

articleTitle: Next-Generation Movie Recommendations: Integrating User Data and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the realm of digital entertainment, where the abundance of choices can overwhelm consumers, movie recommendation systems emerge as indispensable tools. These systems act as personalized guides, leveraging sophisticated algorithms to sift through vast repositories of films and suggest tailored options based on individual preferences. By analyzing user behavior and historical data, these systems predict and recommend movies that align closely with each user’s cinematic tastes, akin to having a knowledgeable friend who understands your movie preferences implicitly. This personalization not only enhances user satisfaction by simplifying the selection process but also fosters deeper engagement with digital platforms, where users spend more time exploring content curated to their liking. As the digital landscape continues to evolve, these recommendation systems not only streamline user experiences but also play a pivotal role in shaping how audiences discover and enjoy movies, making them an integral component of modern entertainment consumption. Movie Recommendation Systems are vital in today’s digital age, transforming how users discover and enjoy content. By leveraging advanced algorithms and data mining techniques, these systems provide personalized and engaging experiences. They navigate the vast sea of available content, offering tailored suggestions that enhance user satisfaction and foster deeper engagement. As technology continues to evolve, these systems will play an increasingly important role in shaping the future of digital entertainment, making them indispensable tools for both users and content providers

articleTitle: Innovative Approaches to Road Surface Type Classification A Synergy of Vibration Data, Machine Learning, and MCNN-Based Pothole Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The existing road monitoring systems, which rely on manual inspections and simple sensors, are labor-intensive, unreliable, and unable of processing complicated multi-dimensional data. Consequently, it usually takes time to reveal that there is an issue with the road and to solve it, which may be dangerous if there is a threat to road users. It is suggested in the paper to integrate the vehicle-based sensors of vibration, machine learning, and the Multi-Channel Convolutional Neural Network in order to classify road surfaces and detect potholes in real time. The system can process the vibration data obtained with the help of feature extraction procedures, reducing the dimensionality using PCA and classification with Random Forest and the MCNN model. The method in question outperforms the previously existing systems with 92% accuracy, 89% precision, 91% recall, and, the maximal F1 score of 90%. The results of how the system works with all roads results in even a more accurate system: 94% smooth, 89% rough, and, 90% potholes. In addition, the system largely overcomes the disadvantages of the previous ones by almost entirely excluding the false positives and false misses in the detection of a road pavement defect; therefore, only the most efficient way a road maintenance barrier can be applied due to the massively high accuracy and ease of real-time processing.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Classification of Grape Leaf Diseases using EfficientNetB0 and InceptionV3 for Enhanced Vineyard Management
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This work proposes an effective deep learning method for the classification of grape leaf diseases, which aims to contribute to early detection and management in vineyards. This implementation of transfer learning used two pre-trained models, EfficientNetB0 and InceptionV3, both initiated on ImageNet weights and fine-tuned on a four-class categorization dataset consisting of images representing Black Rot, ESCA, Healthy, and Leaf Blight manifestations in grape leaves. Data augmentation techniques included random flipping and zooming to improve model generalization. Categorical crossentropy loss and the Adam optimizer were set during training. These models are evaluated on accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics. EfficientNetB0 outperforms InceptionV3 by a margin, with an overall accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8 \%}$, while InceptionV3 achieved 92% accuracy. EfficientNetB0 had a better performance in precision, recall, and F1-score for all classes than others. That would actually indicate its higher performance in detecting grape diseases. By pointing out the potential of EfficientNetB0-which can give reliable classification-the tool for vineyard disease management would be appropriate. This is a research study that has contributed toward advances in the field of auto-detection of a disease by presenting an accurate, efficient, and scalable solution which helps boost vineyard productivity through early intervention with effective disease management strategies.

articleTitle: Leveraging Deep Learning for Comprehensive Plant Disease Classification: A Pathway to Sustainable Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Crop disease classification is a valuable tool in sustaining food security and agriculture the objective of this research was to identify an advanced deep model in the form of recurrent neural networks and convolutional neural networks which could be proved relevant in classifying crop diseases. It outlines methods involved in data collection, preprocessing, feature extraction, selection, training, and evaluation. Gather a large dataset of crop images. Techniques such as data augmentation and normalization are used to enhance the model’s generalization ability by preprocessing. The best performing RNN architectures and CNN models have obtained a validation accuracy of $\mathbf{9 3. 5 3}$ and $\mathbf{9 1. 3 2}$ for training respectively, with improvements observed at different epochs. Model selection focuses on optimizing architectures and hyperparameters through cross-validation and grid search. Training of models is done on the annotated datasets, and their performance is measured in terms of F1-score, recall, accuracy, or precision. Class imbalance and domain shift as well as limited labeled data are other challenges, but targeted strategies may alleviate their impact towards improving deep learning models to classify crop diseases such that early diagnosis and management may come at a better food security and agricultural sustainability base.

articleTitle: Advanced Techniques in Intrusion Detection for Botnet Traffic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: With the increasing digitization of daily activities, including banking, shopping, education, and investments, various aspects of life have shifted to the online space. However, this transition has led to a rise in malicious cyber activities, ranging from financial theft to identity fraud. As critical services like banking are now fully online, cybercriminals continuously attempt to exploit vulnerabilities to steal sensitive information, leading to identity theft and financial losses. One significant attack vector in this domain is the botnet. A botnet consists of a network of compromised devices controlled remotely by malicious actors. These botnets are responsible for various malicious activities, including spamming, Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks, click fraud, and cryptojacking. The decentralized nature of botnets makes them challenging to detect, as they employ advanced evasion techniques like encryption and rapid IP changes. These features allow botnets to scale quickly and execute large-scale attacks, making them an ongoing threat to both individuals and organizations. This paper explores various Intrusion Detection System (IDS) techniques, including machine learning-based anomaly detection and behavioral analysis, that can enhance botnet detection. By addressing the evolving nature of botnet attacks, these techniques provide more effective countermeasures, improving cybersecurity defenses against this persistent threat.

articleTitle: Integrating Machine Learning in Air Quality Prediction Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Air pollution is described as the contains of dangerous substances in atmosphere that are emitted by natural sources or human activities and can harm humans, animals, and the environment. Sulfurous anhydride, carbon monoxide, Dioxide of nitrogen, trioxygen, carbon monoxide, and volatile organic compounds are some of the most common air contaminants. The development of tools for tracking and reducing air pollution is greatly supported by this analysis, which is important for both public health and environmental sustainability. To improve model performance, particular attention is paid to feature engineering and data pre-treatment methods. The study employs machine learning models, including Decision Tree Classifier, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, K-Nearest Neighbors, Random Forest, and SVM, to ascertain the most effective approach for accurate air quality forecasting. The key contribution of this work lies in its ability to provide a practical decision-making framework that can guide authorities in implementing focused interventions and optimizing resource allocation for pollution control. The hybrid approach utilized in this study surpasses traditional methods, offering a more precise tool for air quality forecasting. This model not only addresses the need for improved predictive performance but also acts as a useful tool for public health and environmental agencies seeking to minimize the harmful effects of air pollution.

articleTitle: Optic Vision: Modified U-Net Techniques for Detecting Diabetic Retinopathy through Segmentation of Exudates
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a significant complication of diabetes that can lead to permanent vision loss if not identified early. This study aims to develop and evaluate a U-Net-based architecture specifically for the segmentation of exudates in fundus images, improving automated DR analysis. We designed the model with additional convolutional layers and dropout techniques to enhance feature extraction and reduce overfitting. The model was trained on the Indian Diabetic Retinopathy Image Dataset (IDRiD) for 100 epochs, utilizing binary cross-entropy loss and optimizing with the Adam optimizer. Performance evaluation included validation accuracy, validation loss, and Intersection over Union (IoU) metrics, with post-processing applying Otsu thresholding at a value of 0.2324 for exudates. Our method achieved a validation accuracy of 1.0 and a validation loss of 0.0178, indicating exceptional segmentation performance. These results suggest that our approach significantly enhances the detection of crucial retinal structures, facilitating earlier identification of diabetic pathologies and demonstrating superior performance compared to existing studies in retinal lesion segmentation. Future work may explore the model’s application to larger and more diverse datasets.

articleTitle: Predictive Modelling of Anaemia Using Clinical And Laboratory Data
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Anaemia is a widespread medical condition which is characterized by a deficiency of red blood cells or hemoglobin that leads to various health issues. Early diagnosis and the efficient monitoring of anaemia are essential for treatment and prevention of health risks from anaemia. Generally, diagnosis of anaemia involves collection of clinical data from patient and laboratory tests, which are expensive and time-consuming process. With the advancements of machine learning techniques, there are different ways to automate the diagnosis process, which enables faster and accurate anaemia detection based on hematological data. This paper proposes a machine learning system for anaemia detection using Logistic Regression. The objective of this work is creating a web-based platform which predicts anaemia in individuals based on key medical data like gender, hemoglobin levels, MCV (Mean Corpuscular Volume), MCH (Mean Corpuscular hemoglobin), MCHC (Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin Concentration), aiding for healthcare professionals with better accurate diagnostics. It also addresses the need for accessible and cost-effective tools for settings of resource limited. Even the system offers an automated, faster and non-invasive diagnostic approach.

articleTitle: Exploring the Intersection of VLSI and Embedded Systems: Technological Advancements and Future Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In this study, we look at the present and future of embedded systems as well as VLSI (Very Large Scale Integration) technology to see how the two work together. In particular, very large scale integration (VLSI) technology has altered the landscape of consumer electronics and medical diagnostics by enabling the integration of millions of transistors onto a single chip. Whereas bigger systems rely on embedded systems for their operation, the latter perform tasks that are unique to their settings. One area that has benefited greatly from VLSI technology’s incorporation into embedded systems is the automotive industry, which uses it to power cutting-edge electronic systems like navigation and voice recognition. Communication device development, 5 G evolution, and beyond have all relied heavily on this integration, demonstrating VLSI’s significance in the field of future communication technologies. Trends in very large scale integration (VLSI) technology that are yet to come include developments in semiconductor manufacturing, AI, and new fields like neuromorphic engineering and quantum computing. Embedded systems stand to benefit from these developments, which should increase their efficiency, power, and adaptability to new uses. In particular, this research looks at how very large scale integration (VLSI) and embedded systems can change sectors including consumer electronics, healthcare, and the automobile industry in the future. For a full picture of how these technologies will influence the future of technology, it also discusses the pros and cons of integrating them.

articleTitle: ELEVATE: An AI-Driven Virtual Companion for Nurturing Mental Health Support for Students
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This study introduces Elevate, an AI-powered virtual companion crafted to support the mental health of students from all walks of life, with a focus on those preparing for high-stakes exams like IIT, NEET, and JEE. Mental health challenges among students are a growing global concern, and in India, limited access to counseling often leaves students to manage stress, anxiety, and depression alone. Elevate bridges this gap by offering free, personalized mental health support using the Gemini AI API. Leveraging advanced natural language processing (NLP), discourse structures, and preprocessed Kaggle datasets, Elevate tailors its guidance to individual needs. Key features include real-time sentiment analysis, motivational support, and customized study plans, fostering resilience and overall well-being. By prioritizing inclusivity, Elevate ensures accessible mental health resources for underserved communities. With robust data privacy measures, it exemplifies how pre-trained AI frameworks can address societal challenges. Elevate empowers students of all ages to thrive academically and emotionally, setting a new standard for AI-driven mental health support in education.

articleTitle: Extraction of Valuable Insights of WhatsApp Chat Using VADER
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is one of the captivating fields, it focuses on understanding emotions and attitudes expressed in text or symbolic language. In this fast-developing digital environment, communication is vital and needs to be swift and efficient. Communication via instant messaging has gained wide popularity. WhatsApp is one such tool which is a commonly used platform to communicate effectively with individuals or to a group in realtime, share documents, images, audio and videos, and also other file formats. The research analyzes WhatsApp chats, and offers insights into group conversations on diverse topics. A unique feature of this research is the ability to analyze group chats while focusing on providing individual insights of each member, fostering collaboration and information sharing. Additionally, it accommodates both 24-hour and 12-hour clock formats for chat compatibility. By exporting chat files and employing natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning techniques, the research provides various insightful plots and graphs, depicting message counts, emojis, images, and more. Leveraging Python modules such as NumPy, pandas, matplotlib, and Vader lexicon, the research paper achieves efficient and accurate analysis. It empowers businesses and individuals with a comprehensive understanding of their conversations, facilitating informed decision-making.

articleTitle: Tele-health and Remote Health Services in Assisted Living
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A critical role for tele health and remote health services to improve care in assisted living communities. There are many benefits of these technologies increasing access to care, enabling timely interventions through remote monitoring, reducing costs and improving family involvement. Nevertheless, the effective application requires solutions to some pertinent hurdles like digital literacy among senior citizens, and data protection infrastructure need as well as adherence to legislation. Tele health in assisted living refers to the delivery of healthcare services remotely, using technology such as video consultations, remote health monitoring and medication-management applications. The aims of this manuscript are to enhance care access for residents, minimize hospitalizations, and promote proactive health monitoring. The applications for assisted living are virtual consultations, remote monitoring and medication management. AI and predictive analytics can help with more proactive monitoring, and tailoring the care as per individual capabilities based on predictive health data. Seamless integration between tele health and EHRs could help facilitate healthcare workflows. Enhancements to platforms could help enable more powerful and easier interactions with family members or caregivers. The Gaps in adoption between emerging and developed economies reflect digital health infrastructure and affordability needs in lower-resource regions. Closing these gaps could meaningfully accelerate the attainment of health equity across the world.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Calorie Burn Estimation for Enhanced Physical Activity Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The rapid pace of technological advancements has created a multitude of prospects and challenges, especially in regard to mental health and personal fitness. More often than not, the fast pace of modern living forces people to make unhealthy food choices that are more readily available, leading to increased caloric intake, which represents one of the primary causes of the growing rates of obesity. This situation strongly emphasizes the urgent need for effective control over calorie intake and expenditure along with other resources to promote healthier lifestyle habits. The study takes a comprehensive approach to these issues by propounding intricate methods in machine learning designed to calculate caloric expenditure incurred during various phases of physical activity. It primarily helps people by providing information to maintain consistency in their exercise routines and promote healthy eating habits. The model proposed in this study combined complex algorithms like XGBoost, Decision Trees, and Support Vector Regression (SVR) for a highly massive dataset of over 15,000 data points. Interestingly, XGBoost reflected an observed mean absolute error of as low as 1.48, thus improving the accuracy of calorie expenditure estimation and encouraging users to engage in regular physical activity. This approach is much more impactful than just analyzing caloric intake. The Machine Learning algorithm, as it learns and evolves from experience with its user, can output thematic insights and recommendations that nudge individuals toward active fitness and nutritional oversight management. The findings highlight the impact of technology on constructive behavioral modification and the potential for improving lives as individuals transition to healthier lifestyles.

articleTitle: Cloud Based Virtual Reality Training Platform for Occupational Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The impartial of this schoolwork remained to appraise how effectively simulated realism (VR) can be cast-off aimed at care exercise. user carried out a systematic examination of the works using a variety of information analysis techniques and resources, including Scopus, Google Scholar (via Harzing’s “Publish or Perish”), and Web of Science. The results of our investigation, which was approved obtainable utilizing technologies like VOSviewer, MAXQDA, BibExcel, and CiteSpace, showed that VR-based safety instruction is significantly more successful than conventional approaches and actively engages learners. We also investigated drawbacks such HMD accessibility and linguistic hurdles, and we suggested future study areas. In addition to highlighting VR’s significant potential in safety training, this work offers a model for systematic reviews.

articleTitle: NLP-based Sentiment Analysis on Twitter using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Internet services are generating a huge number of data that is increasing significantly every day. The exchange of ideas and information has exponentially risen with the usage of social media. Web users share more details with their friends and spend most time on social media, and the information obtained from their chat has been used in various applications. Social networking platforms, such as Twitter, Facebook, and Google+ are becoming increasingly popular, enabling users to share opinions on various topics, engage in discussions with diverse communities, and post messages globally. Sentiment Analysis (SA) is applied to Twitter data set for identifying the emotions of users and based on these, several issues can be solved. Twitter is a microblogging site that provides a good environment for SA. Sentiment classification done on Twitter data classifies the emotions in the tweets as neutral, negative, or positive. In this survey, 25 research papers on SA are reviewed. The methods of SA on Twitter are classified as Deep Learning, supervised methods, Hybrid, and other methods. For a reliable evaluation, research papers on SA published between 2015 and 2023 are collected. Finally, the evaluation is achieved based on the datasets, publication year, performance metrics, programming languages, and category analysis. Also, the programming language widely used for execution is Python.

articleTitle: Analyzing Adaptive Intrusion Detection Systems for Improved Network Security
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Analyzing adaptive intrusion detection systems (AIDs) ought to doubtlessly growth network security doubtlessly by imparting businesses with early detection, mitigation, and threat response capabilities. AIDs uses diverse strategies to hit upon malicious conduct, which includes gadget mastering algorithms, signature-based evaluation, and anomaly detection. Moreover, AIDs can take additional action so as to block, quarantine, or alert the perfect events while malicious interest is recognized. This paper examines the modern state of AIDs, its blessings, and disadvantages, and proposes feasible methods to enhance current technology. A dialogue on how device studying can be used to enhance the accuracy of AIDs is blanketed, as well as recommendations for companies while building or deploying a machine. In the end, the paper outlines capability regions of future research that would cause further advances in AIDs and network security.

articleTitle: Integrated Cloud and Blockchain Framework: A Secure Solution for Healthcare Data Management
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Modern healthcare organizations face multiple challenges attempting to protect and manage patients’ information as the number of electronic health records and cyber threats continue to rise. Although modern centralized data storage systems provide improved scalability and flexibility in data storage and organizational access, such systems remain at risks to hackers, Innovative and sneaky ways, and overall manipulation. This research also proposes a solution that integrates the issues above to bring forth the concept of utilizing both cloud computing and blockchain technologies to address these challenges. To this end, the proposed framework is known as the Blockchain-Enhanced Cloud Data Management System (BC-CDMS), where cloud computing is employed as the main data storage model and where blockchain provides decentralized, immutable and transparent data safeguards. Also, access control policies are implemented through smart contracts, while Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) improves system security. The performance test and the experts’ assessments of the system showed that the throughput rate as well as the latency of the system were sufficiently high and some of the most important attributes of security were sufficiently developed in order for the system to be considered capable of handling large volumes of healthcare data. This research also analyses how several functionaries of the BC-CDMS model can improve data secrecy, protect data from unauthorized accesses, and maintain legal requirements as the HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) regulation. The research presents a flexible, secure architecture with great potential to transform the current healthcare data environment through an integration of the best features of cloud computing and blockchain.

articleTitle: Book Recommendation Through Sentiment Analysis Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The rapid increase of digital content in today’s technological age calls for the creation of accurate and individualized book recommendation systems (BRS) to improve user interaction and satisfaction. This paper presents a unique recommendation system that merges traditional collaborative filtering methods with sophisticated sentiment analysis. The objective is to provide customized book recommendations based on user interests and emotional state. The methodology involves analyzing user interactions, historical data, and emotional feedback extracted from user-generated content. By using machine learning and natural language processing, the proposed system effectively captures user sentiment nuances, resulting in improved recommendation accuracy and relevance. The results indicate that including sentiment analysis provides a deeper understanding of user preferences in context, with an observed accuracy improvement of approximately 15% over conventional recommendation methods. This work not only contributes to existing knowledge on recommendation systems but also provides valuable insights for developers and researchers looking to enhance user experiences on digital reading platforms. The findings highlight a significant advancement in customizing book recommendations through the integration of emotional and contextual signals, laying a foundation for future studies in this domain.

articleTitle: Leveraging Advanced Deep Learning Architectures for Precise Knee Osteoporosis Prediction: A Paradigm Shift in Diagnostic Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Osteoporosis is a condition characterized by reduced bone mass and deterioration of bone tissue. It affects the people by increasing bone fragility and a higher risk of fractures. Globally, it affects approximately 200 million people, predominantly postmenopausal women and the elderly. Early detection of osteoporosis is crucial for reducing fracture risks, improving patient outcomes, and lowering healthcare costs. However, traditional diagnostic methods are often invasive and costly, particularly in developing regions. Current methods lack efficiency and affordability, underscoring the need for noninvasive and cost-effective diagnostic solutions. This paper explores the use of various deep learning techniques such as CNN, VGG16, ResNet, DenseNet, AlexNet, and GoogLeNet. Using deep learning models on knee X-ray images, this effort provides a simple, non-invasive approach to early osteoporosis detection. The models are assessed using accuracy metrics, and cross-validation on training, validation, and test datasets is used to validate their performance. The models’ classification performance is also evaluated using F1-scores, accuracy, recall, and confusion matrices. The models are employed to analyze the images, with the aim of improving diagnostic accuracy and enabling early intervention. The overall efficiency is improved by using data augmentation approaches, optimizing the models and implementing efficient preprocessing steps. This study’s primary objective is to develop and evaluate deep learning models that can use knee X-ray images to identify osteoporosis early, offering a quicker, non-invasive, and easier method of diagnosis.

articleTitle: Prognosticating Pneumonia: A Comparative Analysis of Prediction Models Enhanced by and Devoid of Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Pneumonia is a serious condition that requires prompt diagnosis and intervention. Chest X-ray being the primary tool for identifying pneumonia, allows doctors to detect the early onset of the disease to ensure effective treatment and prevent complications. Chest X-ray is chosen in our study owing to low cost and convenience as opposed to other imaging techniques. Conventional diagnostic approaches, while reliable, can be labor-intensive and require significant human resources. To overcome this limitation, implementing deep learning algorithms for automated pneumonia detection can significantly accelerate the diagnosis process. The primary contribution of this research is to employ attention mechanism in a custom and an adapted convolutional neural network model, to evaluate how attention mechanism affects the classification accuracy and other metrics. The data sets of chest X-ray images are injected into the deep learning models to accurately classify the images as either pneumonia or normal cases. Augmentation techniques, such as rotation, and contrast adjustment are utilized to handle the class imbalance in the dataset. The results demonstrate a notable improvement in pneumonia detection accuracy when the attention mechanism is applied, highlighting its potential to enhance deep learning models in medical imaging analysis. This study underscores the efficacy of attention-enhanced CNN models for reliable, automated pneumonia detection, contributing to the broader effort of advancing diagnostic tools through machine learning.

articleTitle: In silico Analysis for Potential SIRT2 Inhibitors
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: SIRT2 is positioned second in class III HDAC family of sirtuins and NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide)dependent in nature. SIRT2 plays a crucial role in neurodegeneration leading to diseases like Parkinson’s disease (PD). Therefore, the need to discover SIRT2 inhibitors aligns itself with potential therapeutic developments for treating PD. As a result of SIRT2 inhibition, $\alpha$-synuclein ($\alpha$-Syn) induced toxicity decreases leading to reduction in cell death. SirReal2 is a native SIRT2 inhibitor. It is situated in the selectivity pocket which is hydrophobic in nature present near the zinc binding domain (ZBD). SirReal2 was taken as the reference ligand for this study. The primary objective was to shortlist better suited compounds for SIRT2 inhibition as potential drug components for Parkinson’s therapy in comparison to what was deduced in previous such studies. Here, a large number of compounds were shortlisted on the basis of structural similarity to SirReal2 which were filtered by ADME analysis. As the next step docking studies were performed to generate binding affinities. This investigation revealed seven such compounds with affinities higher than SirReal2. Extended ADME analysis strengthened the fact that these drug like commercial compounds from ZINC database displayed greater viability for advancement in the pharmacological field. In contrast with the previous studies on this matter, these probable inhibitors were in fact capable of crossing the blood brain barrier making them a better choice. In silico analysis incorporates artificial intelligence (AI) via machine learning (ML) as a part of various computational tools used in the study. Such analysis of compounds can significantly reduce the time and cost of wet lab research. Conclusively, results from this study strongly advocate for the analysis of these probable inhibitors inside living systems.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Detection and Recognition using CNN and KERAS
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A traffic sign detection and recognition system based on CNN with high-accuracy and possibility of real-time implementation for autonomous driving applications has been presented. The Keras framework was used to develop the system, which overcomes limitations of traditional traffic sign recognition methods, commonly found to fail due to environmental variations such as changing light, object occlusions, or damaged traffic signs. It takes advantage of the comprehensive GTSRB dataset and performs data augmentations so as to generalize well to different driving environments. The optimized convolutional and pooling layers in the CNN architecture allow for efficient extraction of salient features, which is crucial as ASL often has similar sign classes that need to be differentiated across variations in scale, illumination, and orientation. The system ensures sign recognition instantaneously and with accurate classification performance, improving safety and efficiency of autonomous driving by providing a fast-accurate real-time recognition of a sign.
